summary_translated: 在线蒸馏（OPD）已成为语言模型的一种有效后训练范式，近期研究已将其扩展至块扩散语言模型（BDLMs）。然而，现有研究几乎完全集中在小块尺寸上，对于将蒸馏应用于具有更大块的学生模型的研究仍不充分。本文研究了这一领域，揭示了两种导致严重训练不稳定的优化偏差。首先，教师与学生之间块边界不匹配引发	extbf{	extit{上下文错位}}，提供扭曲的监督信号，误导学生解码。其次，即使上下文对齐，OPD中存在一种	extbf{	extit{内在优化偏差}}：学生倾向于快速吸收高支持信号，而滞后于低支持更新，从而引发过早自信飙升，使弱学生陷入灾难性过度自信崩溃。为解决这些问题，我们提出了	extbf{Un-OPD}，一种无偏在线蒸馏框架，包含两项创新以稳定BDLM训练。第一，Un-OPD 引入一种边界感知的步过滤策略，消除上下文错位的解码步骤；第二，Un-OPD 通过支持重平衡的置信度校准，调节高支持位置的优化强度，从而规避过度自信崩溃。除稳定性外，我们还引入了一种回放复用机制以降低回放生成开销。在数学推理和代码生成基准上的大量实验表明，Un-OPD 能持续稳定训练并实现更优性能，同时将实际训练时间减少约一半。

summary: ÌròyìnSpeech is a 42-hour, 80-speaker Yorùbá read-speech corpus whose audio has been distributed by ELRA since 2024. This paper describes the release of its text component: 24,905 unique, hand-verified, tone-marked Yorùbá sentences (275,897 tokens; 15,687 types), curated in 2022 as recording prompts. Roughly 11,000 sentences were adapted from openly licensed news material; the remainder were written in-house to broaden coverage beyond the religious translation that dominates existing Yorùbá corpora. Every sentence was checked by hand for tone-mark accuracy, edited for read-aloud clarity and a neutral register, and localised so that non-Yorùbá personal and place names appear in Yorùbá form. Preparing the text for release surfaced systematic Unicode normalisation failures affecting more than 60% of lines (with precomposed and decomposed forms of the same letter co-occurring within single sentences) which we document and correct. The corpus supports diacritic restoration, grapheme-to-phoneme conversion, TTS front-end development and orthographic research, and serves as a validated prompt set for new recording.
title: The ÌròyìnSpeech Text Corpus: 24,905 Curated Yorùbá Sentences for Speech and Language Technology
comment: 8 pages. Data descriptor for the ÌròyìnSpeech Text Corpus, doi: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23138464 . Under review at the Journal of Open Humanities Data
title_translated: ÌròyìnSpeech语音语料库：24,905条精选约鲁巴语句子用于语音与语言技术
summary_translated: ÌròyìnSpeech是一个42小时、80名说话人的约鲁巴语朗读语音语料库，其音频自2024年起由ELRA发布。本文描述其文本部分的发布：共24,905条唯一、人工验证、带声调标记的约鲁巴语句子（275,897个词元；15,687个词类），这些句子于2022年作为录音提示精心筛选而成。约11,000条句子改编自开放许可新闻材料；其余为内部编写，以拓宽现有约鲁巴语语料库中宗教翻译主导的覆盖范围。每条句子均经人工检查声调标记准确性，编辑以确保朗读清晰度和中立语体，并本地化处理非约鲁巴人名和地名使其符合约鲁巴形式。准备文本发布过程中，发现了系统性Unicode归一化失败问题，影响超过60%的行（同一句子中出现同一字母的预组合与分解形式），我们对此进行了记录并修正。该语料库支持声调恢复、音素转写、TTS前端开发和正字法研究，并可作为新录音的验证提示集。

summary: An adequate conversational answer may differ from a short or incomplete benchmark reference. To measure adequacy against the recorded history we prefer source-aware grading, in which the judge checks the reference against the full source before assessing system-blinded answers; original reference-only grading is reported alongside. With a local Qwen 3.8 27B Q4_K_M reader and a 24,000-token evidence ceiling, MemStrata CL1 scores 475/500 (95.0%) on LongMemEval-S and 1,400/1,540 (90.91%) on LoCoMo categories 1-4 under source-aware GPT-5.5 adjudication, against 463/500 (92.6%) and 1,205/1,540 (78.25%) under reference-only grading of the same answers. It preserves a retrieval backbone and adds nonduplicated, dated, speaker-attributed source spans. A same-reader full-history control with about 4.7 times the evidence scores 464/500 reference-only and 470/500 (94.0%) source-aware; neither difference is decisive. Keyword-only selection at the same budget scores 425, and a matched-reader Letta arm 438. On LongMemEval-M, where the packet holds about 1.6% of each history, MemStrata CL1 scores 427/500, with losses concentrated in multi-session and temporal questions. On 300 BEAM-1M questions it outscores dense retrieval, 0.738 to 0.706 (Wilcoxon p = 0.011). A same-seed replay of unchanged requests changed 1.5-2.3% of labels. On identical packets GLM 5.3 flash is non-inferior within 3 points (462 versus 463); Muse Spark 1.3 did not show non-inferiority on 269 questions. None of four pre-registered interventions met all of its registered advancement or feasibility criteria. Signed read-side artifacts support inspection but do not regenerate the private retrieval pipeline. The superiority of source-aware grading to human adjudication is not established, and development exposure, automated-judge dependence and the absence of held-out data preclude an independent-replication or leaderboard claim.
title: MemStrata: 95% and 90.91% Source-Aware Accuracy on LongMemEval-500 and LoCoMo-1540 with a Local Qwen 3.8 27B Q4_K_M Reader
comment: 29 pages, 23 tables, 1 figure. Ancillary files contain per-question grades and reproducible analyses, plus explicitly labelled exports from audited follow-up reports
title_translated: MemStrata：在本地Qwen 3.8 27B Q4_K_M阅读器上实现LongMemEval-500和LoCoMo-1540的95%与90.91%源感知准确率
summary_translated: 充分的对话回答可能不同于短或不完整的基准参考答案。为了衡量回答相对于记录历史的充分性，我们采用源感知评分，即裁判在评估系统盲答前先对照完整来源核对参考答案；同时报告原始仅参考评分。使用本地Qwen 3.8 27B Q4_K_M阅读器和24,000词元证据上限，MemStrata CL1在源感知GPT-5.5裁决下，LongMemEval-S得分为475/500（95.0%），LoCoMo类别1-4得分为1,400/1,540（90.91%），而相同答案在仅参考评分下分别为463/500（92.6%）和1,205/1,540（78.25%）。该方法保留了检索主干，并添加了非重复、带日期、带发言者归属的源片段。使用相同阅读器的全历史控制实验（证据量约为4.7倍）得分为464/500（仅参考）和470/500（94.0%）源感知；两者差异不显著。在相同预算下仅关键词选择得分为425，匹配阅读器Letta arm得分为438。在LongMemEval-M上，当数据包仅包含每个历史的约1.6%时，MemStrata CL1得分为427/500，损失主要集中在多会话和时间相关问题。在300 BEAM-1M问题上，其表现优于密集检索（0.738 vs 0.706，Wilcoxon p = 0.011）。相同种子重播未更改请求时，标签变化率为1.5%-2.3%。在相同数据包上，GLM 5.3 flash表现不劣于3分内（462 vs 463）；Muse Spark 1.3在269个问题上未表现出非劣性。四个预先注册干预措施均未满足所有注册的进步或可行性标准。签名阅读侧伪影支持检查但无法重建私有检索管道。源感知评分优于人类裁决的结论尚未确立，且因开发暴露、自动裁判依赖及缺乏预留数据，无法独立复现或申请排行榜。

summary: Rubric-based reinforcement learning (RL) provides interpretable rewards for aligning large language models (LLMs) by evaluating responses against query-specific evaluation criteria. To construct rubrics at scale, a straightforward approach to LLM-based rubric generation is to prompt an LLM to generate a rubric directly from the query. However, rubrics directly generated by LLMs are vulnerable to reward hacking, since omitted or underspecified criteria allow the policy to obtain high rubric rewards with low-quality responses. Existing LLM-based rubric generation methods improve the granularity and coverage of the generated criteria but do not proactively guard against reward hacking. To address this limitation, we propose RubricArmor, an adversarial framework that exposes and mitigates potential reward hacking at the rubric generation stage before it occurs in subsequent RL. Specifically, RubricArmor performs adversarial evolution, in which an attack step and a repair step alternate over multiple rounds. The attack step simulates the reward hacking of the policy by constructing adversarial responses that satisfy the current rubric but fail to properly complete the task. The repair step then revises the rubric to detect the response defects exposed by the attack step while preserving other valid criteria. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RubricArmor outperforms competitive rubric generation baselines and translates into more effective downstream rubric-based RL.
title: RubricArmor: Adversarial Evolution Improves LLM-Based Rubric Generation
title_translated: RubricArmor：对抗进化提升基于大语言模型的评分标准生成
summary_translated: 基于评分标准的强化学习（RL）通过评估响应是否符合查询特定的评价标准，为对齐大型语言模型（LLMs）提供可解释的奖励。为了大规模构建评分标准，一种直接的方法是提示LLM从查询中直接生成评分标准。然而，由LLM直接生成的评分标准容易受到奖励操纵的影响，因为遗漏或描述不充分的标准允许策略以低质量响应获得高评分。现有的基于LLM的评分标准生成方法虽然提高了生成标准的粒度和覆盖范围，但并未主动防范奖励操纵。为解决这一局限性，我们提出RubricArmor，一种对抗性框架，在后续RL阶段之前暴露并缓解评分标准生成阶段的潜在奖励操纵。具体而言，RubricArmor执行对抗性进化，攻击步骤与修复步骤在多轮中交替进行。攻击步骤通过构造满足当前评分标准但未能正确完成任务的对抗性响应，模拟策略的奖励操纵行为；修复步骤则根据攻击步骤暴露的响应缺陷修订评分标准，同时保留其他有效标准。大量实验表明，RubricArmor优于竞争性的评分标准生成基线，并转化为更有效的下游基于评分标准的强化学习。

summary: Large language models remain vulnerable to jailbreaks, and automated red teaming is the standard way to find jailbreaks in large language models at scale. Current methods either draw more samples at test time through search, rewriting, and tree expansion, or train a stronger attacker offline with reinforcement learning. Both share a limitation: once an attack on a specific target behavior begins, the attacker's weights are frozen. Any signal it gathers about the behavior stays in its context window and is discarded afterward. The attacker never adapts its proposal distribution mid-attack, so success depends almost entirely on the sampling budget, and under a budget affordable at scale, many behaviors remain unbroken. We propose Red-TTT, which updates the attacker's parameters during the attack on each behavior. At each round, the attacker samples a group of candidates, scores them against the victim's replies, and takes a policy-gradient step before drawing the next group, so what it discovers about the current victim is consolidated into weights rather than accumulated as context. We also adapt the training objective to red teaming, where success is judged by the single best sample rather than the average. Red-TTT requires only sampling access to the victim and integrates into existing attack pipelines with no other changes. Against the Best-of-N baseline, Red-TTT raises attack success rate from 55.9\% to 72.4\% on average at a budget of 120 samples, improving over the baseline in every configuration and cracking many behaviors previous method cannot. The code is available at https://github.com/SaFo-Lab/Red-TTT
title: Red-TTT: Test-Time Training for Automated Jailbreaking Large Language Models
title_translated: Red-TTT：用于自动化越狱大型语言模型的测试时训练
summary_translated: 大型语言模型仍易受越狱攻击，自动化红队测试是大规模发现此类攻击的标准方法。现有方法要么通过搜索、重写和树扩展在测试时抽取更多样本，要么使用强化学习离线训练更强的攻击者。两者均存在一个共同局限：一旦针对特定目标行为的攻击开始，攻击者的权重即被冻结。其收集到的任何关于该行为的信息仅保留在上下文窗口中，之后即被丢弃。攻击者无法在攻击过程中动态调整其提议分布，因此成功率几乎完全依赖采样预算。在可规模化承受的预算下，许多行为仍无法被攻破。我们提出Red-TTT，它在每次行为攻击过程中更新攻击者的参数。每轮中，攻击者采样一组候选样本，根据目标模型的回复对其进行评分，并在采样下一组前执行策略梯度步进，从而将对当前目标的发现固化为权重而非累积为上下文。我们还调整了训练目标以适应红队测试场景，其中成功由单个最佳样本决定而非平均表现。Red-TTT仅需对目标模型的采样访问权限，可无缝集成至现有攻击流程而无需其他修改。相较于Best-of-N基线，Red-TTT在120次采样的预算下平均将攻击成功率从55.9%提升至72.4%，在所有配置中均优于基线，并破解了此前方法无法攻破的多个行为。代码已公开于https://github.com/SaFo-Lab/Red-TTT。

summary: Verifiable instruction-following benchmarks often express each constraint through one fixed template. We test whether scores remain stable when the operational requirement is unchanged but its wording varies. We introduce WISE, a matched evaluation suite and reporting protocol instantiated on exact word count, keyword inclusion exactly once, and an inclusive 8--12 word range. Across 100 matched tasks, up to thirteen models from seven providers, and repeated generations scored over the complete visible output, wording alone produces substantial compliance shifts. In an avoidance-family panel, five avoidance and exclusion forms fall below the positive baseline, while constructional controls also shift compliance substantially: in the nine-model control panel, compliance is 54.9% for the original positive form, 48.2% for a longer positive form, 36.7% when the target appears later, and 33.8% for AVOID1. A strict JSON-structure probe shows wording sensitivity beyond counting, with a different direction of effect. Effect sizes, failure directions, weakest forms, and model rankings vary across realizations. Under the most disruptive exclusion form, the top-ranked model changes and 24.1% of strictly ordered model pairs reverse. Human validation further shows that unanimous agreement on an exact-count interpretation can coexist with substantially different model behavior. WISE supplements conventional scores with mean and worst-form compliance, wording gaps, failure profiles, and ranking stability.
title: When Verifiable Counts Depend on Wording: Auditing Wording Robustness in Instruction Following
title_translated: 可验证计数依赖于措辞：指令遵循中的措辞鲁棒性审计
summary_translated: 可验证的指令遵循基准通常通过固定模板表达每个约束条件。我们测试当操作要求不变但措辞变化时，得分是否保持稳定。我们引入WISE，一个匹配的评估套件和报告协议，应用于精确词数、关键词恰好出现一次以及8–12词范围的包容性要求。在100个匹配任务、来自七家厂商的最多十三个模型及重复生成的完整可见输出上，仅改变措辞就导致显著的合规性变化。在规避类面板中，五种规避和排除形式得分低于正向基线；结构控制也表现出显著的合规性变化：在九模型控制面板中，原始正向形式的合规率为54.9%，较长正向形式为48.2%，目标词位置靠后时降至36.7%，AVOID1形式仅为33.8%。严格的JSON结构探测显示，措辞敏感性超出计数范畴，且影响方向不同。效应量、失败方向、最弱形式及模型排名在不同实现中各不相同。在最具破坏性的排除形式下，排名最高的模型发生变化，24.1%的严格排序模型对发生反转。人工验证进一步表明，对精确计数解释的一致认同可以与显著不同的模型行为共存。WISE在传统得分基础上补充了平均值与最差形式合规率、措辞差距、失败模式及排名稳定性。

summary: A large part of political discourse on social media is built and expressed at a level of claims: i.e. declarative, typically single-clause statements, which convey a particular interpretation of reality and can range from factual to evaluative. Moreover, rather than occurring randomly, claims coalesce, recur in patterns, and come to be associated with different world views. When paired with structural computational tools such as Social Network Analysis, claims can be a powerful unit of analysis to study political phenomena such as echo chambers or polarisation. In this paper, we present a pipeline that uses a large language model (LLM) to inductively extract and catalogue claims from large social media corpora, and apply it to two different Twitter datasets: one relating to the 2020 US presidential election and the other to the 2022 FIFA World Cup. We comprehensively evaluate the approach by measuring the pipeline's recall and precision against manually annotated samples, run ablation studies isolating the contribution of its various components, and perform a qualitative error analysis. We discuss the value of the approach in the context of Computational Social Science research, and illustrate its capabilities by presenting the claims catalogue obtained from each dataset.
title: Inductive Claims Extraction at Scale
title_translated: 大规模归纳式主张提取
summary_translated: 社交媒体上的政治话语很大程度上以主张的形式构建和表达：即陈述性、通常为单分句的语句，传达对现实的特定解读，涵盖从事实性到评价性等多种类型。此外，主张并非随机出现，而是聚类、反复出现并关联于不同的世界观。当与社会网络分析等结构性计算工具结合时，主张可成为研究政治现象（如回音室或极化）的强大分析单元。本文提出一个利用大型语言模型（LLM）从大规模社交媒体语料库中归纳提取并编目主张的流水线，并将其应用于两个不同的推特数据集：一个是2020年美国总统选举相关数据，另一个是2022年国际足联世界杯相关数据。我们通过测量流水线在人工标注样本上的召回率和精确率来全面评估该方法，开展消融研究以隔离各组件的贡献，并进行定性错误分析。我们讨论了该方法在计算社会科学研究中的价值，并通过展示每个数据集所获得的主张目录来说明其能力。

summary: Generative large language models (LLMs) inherit undesirable behaviors from pre-training, including demographic bias and toxic generation, that often emerge only after deployment and affect a small subset of inputs. A repair should eliminate the identified defect, preserve the model's overall functionality and, ideally, provide correctness guarantees. Existing approaches address this only partially: gradient-based fine-tuning lacks per-instance guarantees and becomes unstable with few defect samples; model editing assumes explicit knowledge replacement rather than behavioral correction; and constraint-based repair is largely restricted to discriminative models with unique target outputs. We present FORGE, a framework for targeted behavioral repair of generative language models that separates defect localization, weight editing, and behavioral verification into independent stages. Its core is a repair abstraction that converts localized defective generation into explicit optimization objectives, enabling verification-oriented repair techniques to operate on autoregressive generation. FORGE is editing-mechanism agnostic: we instantiate it with (1) a constraint-based quadratic optimization method that provides per-sample repair certificates and (2) a null-space projection editor that minimizes interference with the original model distribution, both under the same localization and verification protocol. On five open-source LLMs, FORGE consistently achieves larger reductions in bias and toxicity than gradient-based fine-tuning with minor perplexity degradation. The two backends exhibit complementary performance across architectures, which a lightweight causal probe traces to where toxicity-related signals concentrate. FORGE also remains effective with only a handful of defective examples, where conventional fine-tuning often oscillates or fails to converge.
title: FORGE: Verification-Gated Behavioral Repair for Generative Language Models
title_translated: FORGE：生成式语言模型的行为修复验证门控机制
summary_translated: 生成式大型语言模型（LLMs）在预训练过程中继承了不良行为，包括人口统计偏差和有毒内容生成，这些行为往往在部署后才显现，且仅影响一小部分输入。修复应消除已识别缺陷，保持模型整体功能，并理想情况下提供正确性保证。现有方法仅部分解决了该问题：基于梯度的微调缺乏实例级保证，且在缺陷样本较少时变得不稳定；模型编辑假设显式知识替换而非行为修正；基于约束的修复主要局限于具有唯一目标输出的判别模型。我们提出FORGE，一种面向生成式语言模型的定向行为修复框架，将缺陷定位、权重编辑和行为验证分为独立阶段。其核心是一个修复抽象，将局部缺陷生成转化为明确的优化目标，使面向验证的修复技术能够作用于自回归生成。FORGE与编辑机制无关：我们以（1）基于约束的二次优化方法实例化，提供样本级修复证书；（2）零空间投影编辑器，最小化对原始模型分布的干扰，两者均采用相同的定位与验证协议。在五个开源LLM上，FORGE始终比基于梯度的微调带来更大的偏见和毒性降低，且困惑度下降轻微。两种后端在不同架构上表现出互补性能，轻量级因果探针揭示了毒性相关信号集中位置的差异。FORGE在仅有少量缺陷样本时依然有效，而传统微调常出现振荡或无法收敛。

summary: Test-time compute has become a central way to improve code generation: systems sample multiple candidate programs and use verifier-visible evidence to select the final output. This paradigm implicitly assumes that the verifier provides a corrective signal independent from the generator. We challenge this assumption under misleading task premises. When the generator and verifier share a false premise, they become coupled through a mistaken belief: the generator produces premise-consistent shortcuts, while the verifier supplies evidence that fails to expose them. Consequently, the selector may choose a hidden-test-wrong candidate even when a hidden-test-correct program exists in the pool. We call this failure mode Verification Trap. Across three code-generation benchmarks and five code models, false premises consistently degrade first-sample correctness, reduce selector-chosen correctness after 64-sample test-time selection, and amplify recoverable mis-selection. Mechanistically, verifier-written tests inherit the premise-level blind spot, reshaping verifier-visible candidate space away from hidden-test correctness. These traces make Verification Trap predictable before hidden execution: a lightweight gold-free predictor using verifier-visible features reaches 0.846 AUROC. Our results identify decoupled evidence as a key mitigation axis: coupled scaling provides limited recovery, whereas premise-agnostic robustness auditors recover substantial oracle headroom.
title: Verification Trap: Understanding Test-Time Selection Failures under False Premises in Code Generation
title_translated: 验证陷阱：理解代码生成中虚假前提下的测试时选择失败
summary_translated: 测试时计算已成为提升代码生成性能的核心方法：系统会采样多个候选程序，并利用验证器可见的证据来选择最终输出。该范式隐含假设验证器提供的信号独立于生成器。我们挑战了在误导性任务前提下的这一假设。当生成器与验证器共享一个错误前提时，二者因错误信念而耦合：生成器产生符合前提的捷径，而验证器提供的证据无法暴露这些捷径。因此，即使池中存在隐藏测试正确的程序，选择器仍可能选中一个隐藏测试错误的候选。我们称这种失败模式为‘验证陷阱’。在三个代码生成基准和五个代码模型上，虚假前提持续降低首次采样的正确率，减少64次采样后选择器的正确率，并放大可恢复的误选。机制上，验证器编写的测试继承了前提层面的盲点，重塑了验证器可见的候选空间，使其偏离隐藏测试正确性。这些特征使得验证陷阱在隐藏执行前即可预测：仅使用验证器可见特征的轻量级无金标准预测器达到0.846 AUROC。我们的结果指出解耦证据是关键缓解方向：耦合扩展仅提供有限恢复，而前提无关的鲁棒性审计器则能显著恢复原始指标空间。

summary: The repetition count that works best for a small language model may not remain best at a larger scale. We study this effect in pretraining with a finite target corpus mixed with generic data at a fixed target fraction. On Wikipedia-derived data and Proof-Pile-2, the ranking of measured repetition counts changes with model size, and a 520M Proof-Pile-2 experiment confirms that reducing repetition from sixteen to eight improves loss while using fewer training tokens. We use loss curves from several smaller models to retain a short list of promising repetition counts for evaluation at a larger scale. On PubMed and Caselaw, candidate sets fixed before target-model training retain the lowest-loss measured count on the original evaluation grids at both 200M and 520M. This supports candidate retention as a practical alternative to exact point prediction. We also relate the pruning regression to an empirical scaling model with two opposing repetition-dependent loss terms. A first-order expansion in log model size yields the linear form used by the selection rule, providing a scaling-based interpretation of the candidate-selection procedure.
title: Selecting Repetition Counts Across Model Scales in Data-Constrained Pretraining
title_translated: 在数据受限预训练中跨模型规模选择重复次数
summary_translated: 对小型语言模型效果最佳的重复次数在更大规模下可能不再最优。我们在固定目标语料占比的有限目标语料与通用数据混合的预训练设置中研究了这一现象。在维基百科衍生数据和Proof-Pile-2上，测量的重复次数排名随模型规模变化；一项520M的Proof-Pile-2实验确认，将重复次数从16降至8可在使用更少训练token的同时降低损失。我们利用多个小型模型的损失曲线，保留一组有前景的重复次数用于大规模评估。在PubMed和Caselaw上，训练前固定的候选集在200M和520M模型上均保持原始评估网格中的最低损失计数。这支持了候选保留作为精确点预测的实用替代方案。我们还将剪枝回归与一个包含两个相互抵消的重复依赖损失项的经验缩放模型相关联。在对数模型规模的一阶展开中得到线性形式，为选择规则提供了基于缩放的解释。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) progressively revise their predictions across Transformer layers, yet we typically observe only the final output, discarding the trajectory through which it is formed. We introduce Belief-Trajectory Energy(BTE), a model-grounded measure that characterizes an input through the layerwise predictive revisions it induces in a model. By mapping intermediate states into a shared predictive space, BTE provides a principled measure of belief change that can be summarized as either a scalar or a structured depth profile. Theoretically, we show that local BTE corresponds to predictive revision under the Fisher-Rao geometry, while the sequence of revisions captures information beyond the initial-to-final belief change. Empirically, scalar BTE provides a model-relative signal of difficulty across diverse reasoning tasks, while richer BTE representations support human-LLM review detection and fine-grained generator attribution, reaching up to $0.998$ macro-AUROC and $95.6\%$ eight-way attribution accuracy. Further analysis shows that BTE develops throughout pretraining and is selectively reshaped by targeted training, demonstrating that the resulting measurement reflects what the scoring model has learned. Together, our results establish belief trajectories as a principled model-grounded signal and suggest a broader perspective in which learned models can themselves serve as instruments for characterizing the data they process. More demonstrations can be found at https://yingjiahao14.github.io/BTE-web/.
title: Belief-Trajectory Energy: Measuring the Path to a Prediction
title_translated: 信念轨迹能量：衡量预测的路径
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在Transformer层间逐步修正其预测，但我们通常只观察最终输出，忽略了其形成过程。我们提出信念轨迹能量（BTE），一种基于模型的度量方法，用于刻画输入在模型各层中引发的逐层预测修正。通过将中间状态映射到共享的预测空间，BTE提供了一种原则性的信念变化度量，可总结为标量或结构化的深度轮廓。理论上，局部BTE对应Fisher-Rao几何下的预测修正，而一系列修正捕捉了初始到最终信念变化之外的信息。实证上，标量BTE在多种推理任务中提供了模型相对的难度信号；更丰富的BTE表示支持人机LLM审查检测和细粒度生成器归属，最高达到0.998宏AUROC和95.6%的八分类归属准确率。进一步分析表明，BTE在整个预训练过程中发展，并被定向训练选择性重塑，证明该度量反映了评分模型所学内容。综上，我们的结果确立了信念轨迹作为原则性、基于模型的信号，并提出一种更广泛的视角：学习模型本身可作为表征其处理数据的工具。更多演示见https://yingjiahao14.github.io/BTE-web/。

summary: Multimodal inputs are inherently heterogeneous, not only across modalities but also in the information pathways required for effective prediction. To address this limitation, we propose InstMoE, an adaptive expert routing framework for multimodal learning. InstMoE dynamically routes each input to specialized unimodal and cross-modal experts, allowing the model to adapt its information pathways to the characteristics of the input. However, routing can be misled when modality-specific variations obscure task-relevant semantics. Such irrelevant variations may distort routing decisions, causing inputs to be assigned to inappropriate experts. We therefore introduce a Contrastive Semantic Alignment module, which encourages semantically similar inputs to share task-relevant representations while suppressing irrelevant modality-specific variations. Experiments on multimodal sentiment analysis benchmarks demonstrate that InstMoE achieves state-of-the-art performance on CMU-MOSEI and CH-SIMS v2 while using substantially fewer parameters than competitive baselines. Further analysis shows that different inputs exhibit distinct expert preferences, demonstrating that InstMoE moves beyond fixed fusion toward adaptive multimodal computation.
title: InstMoE: Adaptive Multimodal Routing with Specialized Experts
title_translated: InstMoE：具有专用专家的自适应多模态路由
summary_translated: 多模态输入本质上具有异质性，不仅在模态之间，而且在实现有效预测所需的信息路径上也存在差异。为解决这一局限，我们提出InstMoE，一种面向多模态学习的自适应专家路由框架。InstMoE动态地将每个输入路由至专门的单模态和跨模态专家，使模型能够根据输入特性自适应调整信息路径。然而，当模态特异性变化掩盖任务相关语义时，路由可能被误导。此类无关变化可能扭曲路由决策，导致输入被分配给不合适的专家。因此，我们引入对比语义对齐模块，鼓励语义相似的输入共享任务相关表示，同时抑制无关的模态特异性变化。在多模态情感分析基准上的实验表明，InstMoE在CMU-MOSEI和CH-SIMS v2上达到最先进性能，且参数量远低于竞争基线。进一步分析显示，不同输入表现出不同的专家偏好，证明InstMoE超越了固定融合，迈向自适应多模态计算。

summary: Locating relevant files from natural-language requests is a core subtask for agents operating over code repositories. We investigate whether this task can be delegated to compact, specialized models to enable on-device search while reducing the token usage, latency, and inference cost of larger agents. We show that semantic search improves file localization, with gains in accuracy, cross-language transfer, and inference efficiency. To study this setting, we introduce a training framework for file-localization agents built around ColGREP, a local semantic search tool based on late-interaction retrieval models. Our recipe combines weighted supervised fine-tuning on teacher trajectories, assigning turn-level credit based on retrieval outcomes, with reinforcement learning on localization quality. We train three model families with fewer than two billion parameters to formulate search queries, inspect retrieved content, and identify relevant files. On localization tasks derived from SWE-bench Lite and Multi-SWE-bench Flash, ColGREP-equipped agents substantially improve over their base models and outperform corresponding GREP-based agents. In addition to improving localization accuracy, ColGREP reduces mean end-to-end trajectory latency by 44.1\% on CPU while using 29.1\% fewer tokens, and enables better generalization to programming languages unseen during fine-tuning. These results suggest that compact, tool-specialized localization agents can provide an efficient interface between natural-language requests and large codebases.
title: Small Agents with Semantic Search: Efficient Multilingual Code Localization
title_translated: 具备语义搜索的小型智能体：高效的多语言代码定位
summary_translated: 从自然语言请求中定位相关文件是代码仓库上运行的智能体的核心子任务。我们探究是否可以将此任务委托给紧凑、专用的模型，以实现设备端搜索，同时降低大型智能体的token使用量、延迟和推理成本。我们发现语义搜索能提升文件定位效果，在准确性、跨语言迁移和推理效率方面均有提升。为研究这一场景，我们引入了一个围绕ColGREP构建的文件定位智能体训练框架，ColGREP是一种基于晚期交互检索模型的本地语义搜索工具。我们的方法结合了教师轨迹上的加权监督微调，根据检索结果分配回合级信用，以及基于定位质量的强化学习。我们训练了三类参数少于二十亿的模型家族，用于生成搜索查询、检查检索内容并识别相关文件。在SWE-bench Lite和Multi-SWE-bench Flash派生的定位任务上，配备ColGREP的智能体显著优于基础模型，并超过相应的GREP基线智能体。除了提升定位准确率，ColGREP在CPU上将平均端到端轨迹延迟降低44.1%，token使用减少29.1%，并提升了对微调期间未见编程语言的泛化能力。这些结果表明，紧凑、工具专用的定位智能体可为自然语言请求与大型代码库之间提供高效接口。

summary: Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) and models derived from it remain widely used topic models. LDA observes each document as a bag-of-words and models each topic by a categorical distribution over the vocabulary, so that it uses neither the internal structure of the document nor the similarity in meaning between words. Earlier work has responded to this limitation in two ways: many models have introduced embeddings, and some have assigned topics to sentences rather than to words. Their combination, a topic model that observes sentence embeddings, remains little explored. We propose vMF Sentence LDA (vSLDA), which keeps the admixture structure of LDA, observes each sentence as its L2-normalized embedding and models each topic by a von Mises-Fisher (vMF) distribution, which matches the cosine geometry of sentence embeddings. Its per-topic parameter count and per-iteration cost are linear in the embedding dimension, versus quadratic for the full-covariance Gaussian distribution in the existing model over sentence embeddings. We evaluate vSLDA where the limitation is expected to matter most, among topics that share much of their vocabulary: the topics that subdivide the one subject of a collection, and the narrow topics that result when a corpus is divided into a large number of topics. On two corpora, vSLDA attains the best mean rank against eight baselines when the fine categories within each coarse category are classified from the document-topic distributions. On the whole corpus, its advantage appears or widens as the number of topics grows. Weighting the word frequencies of each sentence by its topic posterior yields expected topic-word counts of the same form as those of LDA, so that the standard topic coherence and diversity measures apply to models that assign topics to sentences. On their product, topic quality, vSLDA leads in most within-category conditions of both corpora.
title: vMF Sentence LDA: A Spherical Topic Model over Sentence Embeddings
title_translated: vMF句LDA：基于句向量的球面主题模型
summary_translated: 潜在狄利克雷分配（LDA）及其衍生模型仍是广泛使用的话题模型。LDA将每篇文档视为词袋，并用词汇上的分类分布来建模每个主题，因此既未利用文档内部结构，也未考虑词语间的语义相似性。早期工作通过两种方式应对这一局限：许多模型引入了词嵌入，部分模型则为句子而非词语分配主题。然而，将两者结合——即基于句子嵌入的主题模型——仍鲜有研究。我们提出vMF句LDA（vSLDA），保留LDA的混合结构，将每句话视为其L2归一化的嵌入表示，并用冯·米塞斯-费舍尔（vMF）分布建模每个主题，该分布与句子嵌入的余弦几何相匹配。其每个主题的参数量和每次迭代成本随嵌入维度线性增长，而现有基于句子嵌入的模型中全协方差高斯分布的成本为二次方。我们在最可能体现该局限性的场景下评估vSLDA：在共享大量词汇的主题中，如对某一主题进行细分，或在将语料库划分为大量主题时产生的窄主题。在两个语料库上，当从文档-主题分布中对粗粒度类别内的细分类别进行分类时，vSLDA在八种基线中的平均排名最佳。在整个语料库上，随着主题数量增加，其优势逐渐显现或扩大。通过对每句话的词频按其主题后验概率加权，得到的词-主题计数形式与LDA一致，因此标准的主题连贯性和多样性度量可适用于为句子分配主题的模型。在主题质量方面，vSLDA在两个语料库的多数类内条件下均表现领先。

summary: Researchers increasingly use Large Language Models as judges (LLM-as-a-judge) to evaluate model outputs. Yet there are no standards for how to design these judges. Typically, researchers choose the prompt, rating scale, and model intuitively. If these choices change the judge's verdicts, two studies can reach different conclusions about the same facts. To address this risk and to provide an empirical basis for judge designs, we evaluate 10 reasoning models across multiple designs on two tasks: a scalar rating of sentence sentiment and toxicity (over 500 items per category), as well as a binary accuracy classification of question-answer pairs (n=600). For the rating tasks, despite judges showing significant disagreements with the human ground truth, the practical size of differences is small enough to consider most judges reliable (mean absolute deviation of 0.11 points on a 1 - 7 scale); toxicity judges even outperform standard classifiers. Judges are also highly accurate on average (96.5%) for the accuracy classification task. However, design choices can produce shifts: changing the rating scale alone can shift measured bias by up to 0.93 points (rating task), and while accuracy levels are rarely impacted, design choices consistently impact judge leniency (classification task; leniency drop of 28.9 percentage points when using detailed prompts, and up to 56.1 percentage points when switching models). Counterintuitively, lower reasoning effort affects neither accuracy nor leniency. Across both tasks, model identity is the dominant source of variance. These findings suggest that while LLM judges are broadly trustworthy in aggregate, design choices can be meaningful sources of variance. Given the growing reliance on automated evaluation in LLM research, we intend this study as a methodological reference for designing more robust and replicable LLM-as-a-judge pipelines.
title: How Much Do LLM-as-a-Judge Design Choices Matter? A Systematic Comparison of Prompt Designs, Rating Scales, and Models
title_translated: LLM作为裁判的设计选择有多重要？提示设计、评分尺度与模型的系统性比较
summary_translated: 研究人员越来越多地使用大语言模型作为裁判（LLM-as-a-judge）来评估模型输出。然而，目前尚无关于如何设计这些裁判的标准。通常，研究者会凭直觉选择提示、评分尺度和模型。如果这些选择影响裁判的判断结果，那么两项研究可能对同一事实得出不同结论。为降低此风险并提供裁判设计的实证基础，我们对10个推理模型在多个设计下进行了评估，任务包括对句子情感和毒性进行标量评分（每类超过500项）以及对问答对进行二元准确率分类（n=600）。在评分任务中，尽管裁判与人类真实标签存在显著分歧，但实际差异幅度较小，大多数裁判仍可视为可靠（在1-7分量表上平均绝对偏差为0.11分）；毒性裁判甚至优于标准分类器。在准确率分类任务中，裁判平均准确率高达96.5%。然而，设计选择确实会产生影响：仅改变评分尺度即可使测量偏差最多上升0.93分（评分任务）；虽然准确率很少受影响，但设计选择始终影响裁判的宽容度（分类任务中，使用详细提示导致宽容度下降28.9个百分点，切换模型时最高达56.1个百分点）。出人意料的是，降低推理努力程度既不影响准确率也不影响宽容度。在两个任务中，模型身份是方差的主要来源。这些发现表明，尽管LLM裁判在总体上具有可信度，但设计选择可能是重要的变异来源。鉴于大语言模型研究中对自动化评估的依赖日益增加，本研究旨在为设计更稳健、可复现的LLM-as-a-judge流程提供方法论参考。

summary: Music is universally present in human societies. Ethnomusicologists have long been documenting the diverse expressions of human musicality, and comparative musicology has recently brought several studies of folksong to a more global scale. Such cross-cultural research has not been conducted on lyrics: the language barrier has so far prevented work with multi-lingual data. However, Natural Language Processing (NLP) technologies have reached a stage where this language barrier may no longer be prohibitive. Combining folksong lyrics corpora across five languages, we machine-translate them to a pivot language with a pre-trained neural topic model, and we examine the relationship between content and social function within each language, and across languages for wedding songs. As expected, human evaluation of translation results shows that non-Indo-European languages suffer from overall worse translation quality. Experiments with topic models then indicate that the content of lyrics is at best partially related to the social function of folksongs across all languages. These experiments are just first steps into cross-cultural folk musics lyrics analysis; however, they do indicate that a previously unobserved web of cross-cultural relationships beyond ethnomusicological typologies may be uncovered through the study of what people sing across the world's diverse folk musics.
title: Towards cross-cultural study of folksong lyrics with machine translation
title_translated: 基于机器翻译的民歌歌词跨文化研究展望
summary_translated: 音乐在人类社会中普遍存在。民族音乐学家长期记录人类音乐表达的多样性，而比较音乐学近年来已将若干民歌研究推向全球规模。然而，歌词层面的跨文化研究尚未开展：语言障碍长期以来阻碍了多语言数据的研究。不过，自然语言处理（NLP）技术已发展到足以突破这一语言壁垒的阶段。我们整合了五种语言的民歌歌词语料库，通过预训练神经主题模型将其机器翻译至一个中间语言，并考察每种语言内部以及跨语言间婚礼歌曲的内容与社会功能之间的关系。正如预期，人工评估显示非印欧语系语言的翻译质量整体较差。随后的主题模型实验表明，歌词内容与民歌的社会功能在所有语言中最多仅有部分关联。这些实验只是跨文化民歌歌词分析的第一步，但它们表明，通过研究世界各地人们所唱的民歌，有可能揭示出超越民族音乐类型学的先前未被观察到的跨文化联系网络。

summary: Test-time training (TTT) lets a model store information in its weights during inference. When the model learns from its own output, however, each update also changes the model that generates the next training example. Across 128K-token streams, retaining generated-text updates worsens prediction on independent human-written text with three TTT-E2E model configurations (labeled 125M, 760M, and 3B). The same failure occurs when Adam updates Qwen3-4B's existing weights. The same update mechanisms can improve on real text, so writing itself is not the failure. Three matched comparisons trace the causal pathway. Fixed Generation removes over 98% of the damage at 125M and 760M by using a frozen model to generate training chunks. Recorded Replay separates the loss caused by reading degraded text from the additional loss stored by updating on it. A paired one-update comparison then shows the local conflict: an update predicts its source better but new real text worse. This cost grows after Closed Loop adaptation, with a few trajectories accounting for most large failures. Finally, Settlement evaluates the candidate state on independent real text before commitment. It leaves mean endpoint gaps of 0.07 and -0.02 nats at 125M and 760M while retaining real-text adaptation. These results motivate checking prediction on independent evidence before retaining an update.
title: Self-Generated Feedback Destabilizes Test-Time Training: A Causal Decomposition of Long-Horizon Adaptation
title_translated: 自生成反馈破坏测试时训练：长时程适应的因果分解
summary_translated: 测试时训练（TTT）允许模型在推理过程中将其信息存储于权重中。然而，当模型从自身输出中学习时，每次更新也会改变生成下一个训练样本的模型本身。在长达128K token的流数据中，保留生成文本的更新会恶化模型在独立人工撰写文本上的预测性能，涉及三种TTT-E2E模型配置（标记为125M、760M和3B）。同样的失败现象也出现在对Qwen3-4B现有权重进行Adam更新时。相同更新机制在真实文本上也能提升性能，因此问题不在于写作本身。通过三组匹配对比实验追踪因果路径：固定生成（Fixed Generation）通过使用冻结模型生成训练块，在125M和760M模型上消除了超过98%的损害；记录回放（Recorded Replay）将因读取退化文本造成的损失与因更新而存储的额外损失分离；成对单次更新比较进一步揭示局部冲突：一次更新能更好地预测其来源，但对新的真实文本预测更差。这种代价在闭合回路适应后加剧，少数轨迹导致了大部分重大失败。最后，安置评估（Settlement）在承诺前对候选状态在独立真实文本上进行评估。它在125M和760M模型上分别留下0.07和-0.02纳特的平均终点差距，同时保留了真实文本的适应能力。这些结果提示，在保留更新前应检查其在独立证据上的预测表现。

summary: Prior work suggests that sentiment can often be captured by approximately linear directions in LLM activation spaces, but a single direction may not fully capture sentiment representations. In natural communication, sentiment is shaped not only by polarity but also by usage factors, such as tone and audience adaptation. We test whether these factors systematically modulate sentiment representations beyond a shared sentiment direction. We construct a controlled paired dataset that holds event content fixed while varying sentiment polarity and usage factors, and analyze Llama, Mistral, and Gemma. We identify a shared sentiment direction, remove it, and test the residual structure through erasure and generation-time tone steering. Across models, the shared direction is robust (median cosine 0.953-0.975), yet removing it leaves 0.833-0.909 of the original positive-negative representation-difference norm. The residuals contain compact, reproducible usage-conditioned structure. Targeted erasure weakens held-out usage metrics more than random and label-shuffled controls. On Llama, outputs steered along residualized tone components are preferred in 92.8% of blind target-tone comparisons while preserving the requested sentiment polarity in 98.7% of evaluated outputs.
title: Usage-Modulated Sentiment Representations in Large Language Models
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (main conference). 18 pages, 3 figures, including appendices
title_translated: 大语言模型中使用调节的情感表征
summary_translated: 先前研究表明，情感通常可通过大语言模型激活空间中的近似线性方向捕捉，但单一方向可能无法完全描述情感表征。在自然交流中，情感不仅受极性影响，还受使用因素（如语气和受众适应）塑造。我们检验这些因素是否系统性地调制情感表征，超出共享的情感方向。我们构建了一个受控配对数据集，在保持事件内容不变的同时，变化情感极性和使用因素，并分析了Llama、Mistral和Gemma模型。我们识别出一个共享情感方向，移除后通过擦除和生成时语气引导测试残差结构。在各模型中，共享方向具有鲁棒性（中位数余弦值0.953–0.975），但移除后仍保留原始正负情感表征差异范数的0.833–0.909。残差部分包含紧凑且可重复的使用条件结构。针对性擦除削弱了保留使用的度量，效果优于随机和标签打乱对照组。在Llama模型中，沿残差化语气成分引导的输出在盲测目标语气比较中获得92.8%的偏好，同时在98.7%的评估输出中保持了请求的情感极性。

summary: State-of-the-art ASR systems primarily target native adult speech, leading to substantial performance gaps for children, adolescents, and L2 speakers. We introduce AraYoungVoices, a 151.72-hour Arabic read-speech corpus from 286 speakers aged 7--18, comprising AraKids (7--12) and AraTeens (13--18). The corpus includes 146 native Arabic (L1) and 140 second-language (L2) speakers, with native speakers spanning Egyptian, Gulf, Levantine, and North African dialectal backgrounds and L2 speakers representing diverse linguistic backgrounds across the Americas, Asia, Africa, and Europe. We benchmark four pretrained ASR models under zero-shot and fine-tuned settings using unseen-speaker-$\&$-unseen-prompt (USUP) and unseen-speaker-$\&$-seen-prompt (USSP) evaluations. Results show that L2 speech remains substantially more challenging than L1 speech, with the largest errors observed mainly for younger L2 speakers. Age-specific fine-tuning improves the matched age group, while joint fine-tuning provides a stronger balance across populations. ASR hypotheses are also consistently closer to the standard reading prompt than to the verbatim transcription, particularly for L2 speech, suggesting partial normalization of reading deviations.
title: AraYoungVoices: A Diverse L1/L2 Corpus of Arabic Child and Adolescent Speech
title_translated: AraYoungVoices：一个多样化的阿拉伯语儿童与青少年语音L1/L2语料库
summary_translated: 最先进的自动语音识别（ASR）系统主要针对母语成人的语音，导致儿童、青少年及第二语言（L2）使用者性能显著下降。我们提出了AraYoungVoices，这是一个包含286名7至18岁说话者、总计151.72小时的阿拉伯语朗读语音语料库，分为AraKids（7-12岁）和AraTeens（13-18岁）两部分。语料库包含146名母语阿拉伯语（L1）和140名第二语言（L2）使用者，其中L1使用者涵盖埃及、海湾、黎凡特和北非方言，L2使用者则来自美洲、亚洲、非洲和欧洲的多种语言背景。我们在未见过说话者和未见过提示（USUP）以及未见过说话者但见过提示（USSP）的评估设置下，对四种预训练ASR模型进行了零样本和微调测试。结果表明，L2语音仍比L1语音更具挑战性，尤其在年轻L2使用者中错误最为明显。按年龄进行微调可提升对应年龄段的表现，而联合微调则在不同群体间提供更均衡的效果。此外，ASR生成的假设结果始终更接近标准朗读提示而非逐字转录，特别是对于L2语音，表明朗读偏差存在部分归一化现象。

summary: Agentic Harness is the runtime that constructs task context and controls execution flow, thereby shaping overall agent performance. Given a fixed model and external evaluation, automated Harness optimization seeks to improve this runtime through an iterative proposal--evaluation loop to better solve target tasks. Existing meta-harness methods mainly adopt proposer-centric discovery, in which an LLM-based proposer integrates accumulated experimental findings to determine subsequent Harness revisions. This places the burden of maintaining the evolving improvement state on the proposer as history expands and its underlying experimental logic becomes harder to discern. In this paper, we introduce the Causal Improvement Graph (CIG), a graph-governed meta-harness framework that externalizes the evolving improvement state in a persistent graph, allowing prior findings to directly govern subsequent Harness optimization through local proposer operations. CIG grows and links Evidence, Hypothesis, Intervention, and Outcome nodes to represent what was observed, how it may be explained, how to test that explanation, and what the evaluation reveals. Their structural relations preserve how the improvement state changes across iterations, allowing local proposers to build directly on relations among prior findings rather than recover them from raw history. Across various agent tasks, CIG discovers stronger Harnesses than previous meta-harness baselines and remains robust to the choice of task solver and proposer. Structural ablations further support the design of an explicit improvement state with graph-governed evolution.
title: Causal Improvement Graph for Agentic Harness Optimization
title_translated: 用于智能体约束优化的因果改进图
summary_translated: 智能体约束（Agentic Harness）是运行时环境中构建任务上下文并控制执行流程的关键组件，直接影响整体智能体性能。在固定模型和外部评估条件下，自动化约束优化通过迭代的提议-评估循环来改进该运行时，以更好地完成目标任务。现有元约束方法主要采用以提议者为中心的发现策略，即基于大语言模型（LLM）的提议者整合累积的实验结果来决定后续约束修订。这使得提议者需承担维护不断演进的改进状态的负担，随着历史数据增长，其底层实验逻辑也愈发难以理解。本文提出因果改进图（Causal Improvement Graph, CIG），一种由图结构管理的元约束框架，将动态演进的改进状态外化为持久图结构，使先前发现能通过局部提议操作直接指导后续优化。CIG通过连接证据、假设、干预和结果节点，表示观察到的现象、可能的解释、验证方式及评估结果。其结构关系保留了改进状态在迭代过程中的变化轨迹，使局部提议者可直接基于先前发现之间的关联进行构建，而非从原始历史中恢复。在多种智能体任务上，CIG发现的约束优于以往元约束基线，并对任务求解器和提议者的选取保持鲁棒性。结构消融实验进一步支持了显式改进状态与图驱动演化的有效性设计。

summary: Large language models are increasingly used as integration layers above specialized tools, but a stronger component does not necessarily produce a stronger combined system. Across five diagnostic datasets (bearing vibration, process monitoring, semiconductor equipment), we study whether an LLM can reliably use external diagnostic information; paired repeat calls separate advice effects from output instability. In all five, conflicting external information overturned initially correct LLM judgments. Among the four datasets with direct integration comparisons, none showed a consistent advantage for implicit LLM integration over the stronger standalone source. On a Tennessee Eastman confirmation set whose protocol was fixed before evaluation, unaided accuracy was 64.67%, implicit LLM-specialist integration 77.43%, and the specialist alone 83.33%. Specialist information improved the LLM by 12.8 points (95% interval 9.7 to 15.9), yet the integrated output stayed 5.9 points below the specialist (95% interval -12.0 to -0.7). A two-source selector oracle reached 92.76%, indicating complementarity that the integrated output did not fully realize. The integrated output missed 140 of 295 specialist corrections (47.5%) but lost 15 of 99 initially correct LLM judgments (15.2%). The deficit remained under prompt and specialist sensitivity analyses. Among CWRU cases solved under both evidence presentations, task-aligned physical evidence yielded lower estimates of susceptibility to incorrect advice in six of seven models (five intervals excluding zero); higher reasoning effort gave no reliable reduction in five models, and a separate four-model TEP analysis gave no clear evidence that it resolves the integration problem. Source quality and integration quality should be evaluated separately: an integration layer should be compared with its stronger standalone component, not only with the unaided LLM.
title: When LLMs Sit Above Diagnostic Tools: Unrealized Complementarity in Industrial Fault Diagnosis
title_translated: 当大语言模型位于诊断工具之上：工业故障诊断中未实现的互补性
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用作集成层，置于专业诊断工具之上，但更强的组件并不必然带来更强的整体系统表现。我们在五个诊断数据集（轴承振动、过程监控、半导体设备）上研究LLM是否能可靠利用外部诊断信息；通过重复调用配对实验分离出建议效应与输出不稳定性。在所有五个数据集中，冲突的外部信息均推翻了最初正确的LLM判断。在四个具备直接集成对比的数据集中，没有一个显示隐式LLM集成相对于更强独立源具有持续优势。在Tennessee Eastman确认集上，未经辅助的准确率为64.67%，隐式LLM-专家集成达到77.43%，而专家单独使用为83.33%。专家信息使LLM性能提升12.8分（95%置信区间9.7至15.9），但集成输出仍低于专家5.9分（95%置信区间-12.0至-0.7）。一个双源选择器理想模型达到92.76%，表明存在互补性，但当前集成输出未能充分实现。集成输出漏掉了295次专家修正中的140次（47.5%），同时丢失了99次初始正确LLM判断中的15次（15.2%）。该缺陷在提示敏感性和专家敏感性分析下依然存在。在CWRU案例中，两种证据呈现方式下均解决的任务中，任务对齐的物理证据在七种模型中的六种给出了更低的错误建议易感性估计（五种区间不包含零）；更高的推理努力在五种模型中未带来可靠降低，四模型TEP分析也未明确显示其能解决集成问题。应分别评估源质量与集成质量：集成层应与更强的独立组件比较，而不仅与未辅助的LLM比较。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance across various tasks, but they still struggle with questions involving ethical judgment. Previous studies have attempted to train LLMs on ethical standards, but the diversity and relativity of ethical norms make them difficult to fully internalize in model parameters. As an alternative, we introduce normative RAG, a retrieval-augmented approach that supports ethical judgment using external normative knowledge. Normative retrieval involves a distinct asymmetry between context rich narrative queries and generalized normative statements. Existing factual retrieval methods rely on query-only expansion into a document-like form, making them insufficient for resolving this asymmetry. Therefore, we propose Intermediate Representation-based Embedding Alignment (IREA), a bidirectional alignment method that maps both text types into a shared situation-behavior representation. This representation captures ethically salient contextual and behavioral information in a normalized form, reducing surface-level discrepancies and improving alignment in the embedding space. Experimental results show that IREA improves normative retrieval and downstream ethical judgment across multiple settings, demonstrating the effectiveness of bidirectional alignment for normative RAG.
title: IREA: Intermediate Representation-based Embedding Alignment for Normative RAG
title_translated: IREA：基于中间表示的嵌入对齐用于规范型检索增强生成
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLMs）在各类任务中表现出色，但在涉及伦理判断的问题上仍存在困难。以往研究尝试通过在伦理标准上训练LLMs来改善表现，但由于伦理规范的多样性与相对性，难以完全内化于模型参数中。作为替代方案，我们提出规范型检索增强生成（Normative RAG），一种利用外部规范知识支持伦理判断的检索增强方法。规范型检索面临一个独特不对称性：上下文丰富的叙事查询与概括性的规范陈述之间存在差异。现有事实型检索方法依赖仅基于查询的扩展形成类似文档的形式，无法有效解决这一不对称性。因此，我们提出基于中间表示的嵌入对齐（Intermediate Representation-based Embedding Alignment, IREA），一种双向对齐方法，将两类文本映射到共享的情境-行为表示空间中。该表示以标准化形式捕捉伦理相关的情境与行为信息，减少表面差异，提升嵌入空间中的对齐效果。实验结果表明，IREA在多个场景下均提升了规范型检索与下游伦理判断性能，证明了双向对齐在规范型RAG中的有效性。

summary: LLM agents for coding, search, and workplace tasks increasingly rely on long-context capabilities to effectively aggregate and reason over extended interaction histories. Recent work has incorporated agent trajectories into mid-training stage, drawing on their naturally long and interaction-rich structure. Yet how to organize the information within these trajectories into effective mid-training supervision remains underexplored. In this work, we investigate the relationship between long-context and agent atomic capabilities and introduce TrajLong, a novel framework that compiles trajectories into long-context training tasks with dense supervision, targeting three representative atomic capabilities: evidence grounding, cross-evidence aggregation, and temporal state maintenance. We mid-train Qwen3-14B-Base and Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base with data compiled by TrajLong, followed by supervised fine-tuning. Experiments on 6 long-context and 12 agent benchmarks demonstrate broad performance gains, with controlled ablations showing improvements over raw and masked trajectory baselines. Capability-level analyses further reveal task-dependent associations between long-context and agent atomic capabilities. These findings suggest that the shared capability demands of long-context reasoning and agent execution provide a principled basis for designing mid-training data to develop downstream agent capabilities.
title: TrajLong: Co-Designing Agentic and Long-Context Supervision for Mid-Training
title_translated: TrajLong：面向中期训练的智能体与长上下文监督协同设计
summary_translated: 用于编码、搜索和办公任务的大语言模型智能体越来越依赖长上下文能力，以有效聚合和推理长期交互历史。近期工作已将智能体轨迹引入中期训练阶段，利用其天然的长序列和高交互特性。然而，如何将这些轨迹中的信息组织为有效的中期训练监督仍缺乏深入探索。本文研究长上下文与智能体原子能力之间的关系，提出TrajLong框架，将轨迹编译为带有密集监督的长上下文训练任务，聚焦三种代表性原子能力：证据定位、跨证据聚合与时间状态维持。我们使用TrajLong编译的数据对Qwen3-14B-Base和Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base进行中期训练，随后进行监督微调。在6个长上下文和12个智能体基准上的实验表明，性能广泛提升，受控消融实验显示其优于原始轨迹和掩码轨迹基线。能力层面分析进一步揭示了长上下文与智能体原子能力之间的任务依赖性关联。这些发现表明，长上下文推理与智能体执行共享的能力需求，为设计中期训练数据以发展下游智能体能力提供了合理依据。

summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have revolutionized AI research and enabled exciting agent systems. To build a complex LLM agent system, most existing research relies on insights from other domains or heuristics to manually build the agent system. However, this approach often requires heavy hand-engineering and fails to fully optimize for the downstream task of interest. Inspired by the tremendous success of deep learning, we propose to construct LLM agent systems in a modular manner, similar to building a deep neural network. Our key insight is to make analogies between LLM building blocks, such as retrievals, memories, and prompting strategies, and the successful deep learning modules, such as MLPs, attention, and recurrent modules. We further design forward inference and feedback mechanisms for LLMs, where prompts in LLMs are considered as the weights in deep models, and the prompt optimization from feedback is analogous to the back-propagation algorithm. We additionally leverage a search algorithm to search for the best configuration of LLM agent systems, similar to the neural architecture search (NAS) in deep learning research. Comprehensive experimental results demonstrate that the proposed deep learning recipe for LLM agent systems is highly effective, in particular: (1) Organizing LLM modules into deep-learning-style architectures yields noticeable performance gain; (2) Automatic prompt optimization, equivalent to backpropagation, is efficient in incorporating feedback from the task of interest and achieves at least 5% performance improvement; (3) NAS equivalent algorithm works well for further optimizing the LLM agent system architecture with 11% performance gain compared with randomly designed architectures. Overall, our research demonstrates the exciting opportunity of transferring the success of deep learning to building LLM agent systems.
title: Building LLM Agent Systems the Deep Learning Way: From Modular Design to Architecture Search
title_translated: 以深度学习方式构建大语言模型智能体系统：从模块化设计到架构搜索
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLMs）彻底改变了人工智能研究，并推动了令人兴奋的智能体系统的出现。然而，现有研究在构建复杂的LLM智能体系统时，大多依赖于其他领域的经验或启发式方法进行手动设计，这通常需要大量人工工程，且难以充分优化下游任务。受深度学习巨大成功的启发，我们提出以模块化方式构建LLM智能体系统，类似于构建深度神经网络。我们的核心洞察是将LLM的构建模块（如检索、记忆和提示策略）与深度学习中成功的模块（如MLP、注意力机制和循环模块）进行类比。我们进一步设计了LLM的前向推理与反馈机制，将LLM中的提示视为深度模型中的权重，而基于反馈的提示优化则类似于反向传播算法。此外，我们还利用搜索算法来寻找最优的LLM智能体系统配置，类似于深度学习中的神经架构搜索（NAS）。全面的实验结果表明，所提出的深度学习方法在LLM智能体系统构建中非常有效：（1）将LLM模块组织为类似深度学习的架构可带来显著性能提升；（2）自动提示优化（相当于反向传播）能高效融入任务反馈，性能至少提升5%；（3）等效于NAS的算法在进一步优化LLM智能体系统架构方面表现良好，相比随机设计的架构性能提升达11%。总体而言，本研究展示了将深度学习成功经验迁移至构建LLM智能体系统的巨大潜力。

summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) become essential in privacy-sensitive sectors like hospitals and government agencies, the on-premise LLM servers offer a cost-effective and secure alternative to public cloud services. However, these resource-constrained servers struggle to guarantee heterogeneous Service Level Objectives (SLOs) when serving multiple LoRA-adapted services simultaneously. Existing serving frameworks suffer from severe SLO violations due to the computational overhead of LoRA layers and the rigid nature of batch scheduling. To address this, we propose HALO, a scheduling method tailored for LoRA-assisted on-premise LLM deployment. HALO introduces two key innovations: a spatial multiplexing strategy that overlaps Base and LoRA computations by partitioning GPU Streaming Multiprocessors (SMs), and an SLO-aware scheduler that decouples request execution based on "request-level slack." By prioritizing urgent tasks and utilizing idle budget for traffic shaping, HALO significantly mitigates resource contention. Our evaluation demonstrates that HALO minimizes SLO violations while improving throughput compared to state-of-the-art baselines.
title: From Overloaded to Guaranteed: High-Throughput Multi-SLO Enforcement for LoRA-Assisted On-Premise LLM Deployment
title_translated: 从过载到保障：面向LoRA辅助本地部署大语言模型的高吞吐多SLO保障
summary_translated: 随着大语言模型（LLMs）在医疗、政府机构等隐私敏感领域变得日益重要，本地部署的LLM服务器为公共云服务提供了一种成本效益高且安全的替代方案。然而，这些资源受限的服务器在同时服务多个LoRA适配的服务时，难以保证异构的服务等级目标（SLO）。现有的服务框架因LoRA层的计算开销和批处理调度的僵化性，导致严重的SLO违规。为此，我们提出了HALO，一种专为LoRA辅助本地部署LLM设计的调度方法。HALO引入两项关键创新：一种空间多路复用策略，通过划分GPU流式多处理器（SMs）实现基础模型与LoRA计算的重叠；以及一种SLO感知调度器，根据“请求级松弛度”解耦请求执行。通过优先处理紧急任务并利用空闲预算进行流量整形，HALO显著缓解了资源竞争。评估结果表明，HALO在降低SLO违规的同时提升了吞吐量，优于当前最先进的基线方法。

summary: Work agents operate over digital artifacts to execute professional knowledge-intensive work, requiring training environments that support long-horizon interaction and trustworthy verification. However, hand-crafted environments incur prohibitive engineering overhead that prevents environment scaling, whereas synthesis methods sacrifice workspace complexity, realism, or grounded verifiability. To bridge this gap, we introduce WorkForge, a scalable synthesis framework for constructing verifiable work-agent environments from real-world resources. Starting from expert workflows, WorkForge first identifies the resources, decisions, and deliverables required by each workflow. It then retrieves relevant real-world files and organizes them into a workspace. WorkForge inspects the workspace to extract concrete, checkable facts about its content. These factual anchors fix which task types the workspace can support and how their outcomes can be verified. Therefore, WorkForge derives each task's instructions, solution plan, and complementary programmatic and semantic verifiers directly from these factual anchors, keeping verification traceable to observable workspace evidence. Furthermore, we construct 16.7K verifiable environments across 40 professional domains, with workspaces collectively covering 60 file types. Post-training Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base improves GDPVal from 45.5 to 73.6 and APEX Score from 5.0 to 21.3, while enabling Qwen3.5-27B to achieve highly competitive performance and outperform strong competitors. Our analyses confirm the efficacy of the proposed method and reveal consistent scaling behaviors across both data volume and interaction horizons.
title: Scaling Verifiable Environments for Long-horizon Work Agents
title_translated: 面向长周期工作智能体的可验证环境规模化构建
summary_translated: 工作智能体通过操作数字资产来执行专业性强的知识密集型任务，要求训练环境支持长周期交互和可信的验证机制。然而，手工构建的环境存在高昂的工程成本，难以扩展；而合成方法则牺牲了工作区的复杂性、真实感或可验证性。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了WorkForge，一个可扩展的合成框架，用于从真实世界资源构建可验证的工作智能体环境。该框架从专家工作流程出发，首先识别每个流程所需资源、决策和交付成果；随后检索相关的真实文件并组织成工作区。WorkForge对工作区进行检查，提取关于其内容的具体、可验证的事实。这些事实锚点确定了工作区所能支持的任务类型及其结果的验证方式。因此，WorkForge直接从这些事实锚点推导出每项任务的指令、解决方案计划，以及配套的程序化和语义验证器，确保验证过程可追溯至可观测的工作区证据。此外，我们在40个专业领域内构建了16.7K个可验证环境，工作区涵盖总计60种文件类型。后训练的Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base模型使GDPVal从45.5提升至73.6，APEX得分从5.0提升至21.3；同时使Qwen3.5-27B达到极具竞争力的性能，并超越多个强竞争对手。分析证实了该方法的有效性，并揭示了数据量和交互周期上的稳定扩展规律。

summary: In multilingual scenarios, queries with equivalent semantics but in different languages could guide the model into different reasoning trajectories, leading to performance disparities. To mitigate this gap, previous studies typically apply a one-size-fits-all query rewriting strategy, such as translation, which overlooks the fact that different scenarios require diverse types of semantic transformations. In this paper, we propose mRewriter-R1, an agentic multilingual query rewriting framework with reinforcement learning. Unlike single-turn rewriting, mRewriter-R1 formulates multilingual query rewriting as a multi-turn sequential decision-making process, where the model dynamically performs multi-aspect optimization through adaptive operator selection. Experimental results demonstrate that mRewriter-R1 outperforms all strong multilingual rewriting baselines on different large reasoning backbones. Further analyses show that the learned policy can adaptively decide on rewriting operators according to query characteristics, exhibiting strong generalization ability across diverse reasoning tasks, and plug-and-play compatibility with heterogeneous reasoning language models.
title: Rewrite What Matters: Adaptive Multilingual Query Rewriting for Reasoning via Agentic Reinforcement Learning
title_translated: 重写关键之处：基于智能体强化学习的自适应多语言查询重写以实现推理
summary_translated: 在多语言场景中，语义等价但语言不同的查询可能引导模型进入不同的推理路径，从而导致性能差异。为缓解这一差距，以往研究通常采用“一刀切”的查询重写策略（如翻译），却忽略了不同场景需要多样化的语义转换。本文提出mRewriter-R1，一种基于强化学习的智能体多语言查询重写框架。与单轮重写不同，mRewriter-R1将多语言查询重写建模为多轮序列决策过程，模型通过自适应选择操作符动态完成多维度优化。实验结果表明，mRewriter-R1在多种大型推理模型上均优于所有强基准方法。进一步分析显示，所学策略能根据查询特征自适应决定重写操作符，展现出在多样化推理任务中的强大泛化能力，并可无缝集成到异构推理语言模型中。

summary: This study analyzes the predictive power of LM-derived, token-level surprisal on Mandarin Chinese reading times. We first propose the Shortest Matching Sequence (SMS), an alignment scheme that maps between the word segmentation assumed by eye-tracking corpora and the LMs' subword tokenization, as the two tokenizations often disagree in the context of Mandarin Chinese. Then, using a suite of Chinese-Pythia models (14M-1.4B) trained on scratch with 30B tokens, we examine how well surprisal predicts first fixation duration, gaze duration, and total reading time in three paragraph-level eye-tracking corpora of Mandarin Chinese (GECO-CN, HKP, and MECO). Contrary to previous null findings, our results show that surprisal is predictive of Chinese reading times. However, whether predictive power scales with model size and the amount of training is corpus-specific: bigger models predict better in GECO-CN, whereas inverse scaling emerges in HKP and, at the largest sizes, in MECO. Subsequently, we tested one possible explanation for the inverse scaling in HKP and found that checkpoints whose surprisal remains closer to $n$-gram statistics are better predictors of reading. All in all, the predictive power of surprisal on Chinese reading time measurements is corpus-specific, which cautions against drawing scaling conclusions from a single corpus.
title: A Systematic Analysis of the Predictive Power of LM Surprisal in Reading Chinese
comment: 15 pages, 3 figures. Hongao Zhu and Muxiaoqiao Xu contributed equally. Correspondence to: this http URL @polyu. this http URL
title_translated: 大语言模型意外性在阅读中文中的预测能力的系统性分析
summary_translated: 本研究分析了基于语言模型（LM）生成的、逐标记的意外性（surprisal）对普通话中文阅读时间的预测能力。我们首先提出最短匹配序列（SMS）对齐方案，用于映射眼动追踪语料库假设的词切分与语言模型的子词分词之间的差异——在中文语境下，两者常不一致。随后，使用一系列从头训练的中文-Pythia模型（14M-1.4B参数规模，基于300亿token数据），我们考察意外性在三个段落级眼动追踪语料库（GECO-CN、HKP和MECO）中对首次注视时长、注视持续时间和总阅读时间的预测效果。与以往的零发现相反，我们的结果表明意外性确实能预测中文阅读时间。然而，其预测能力是否随模型规模和训练量增长，取决于语料库：在GECO-CN中，更大的模型预测效果更好；而在HKP中则出现逆向缩放现象，且在最大模型规模下，MECO也呈现类似趋势。随后，我们测试了HKP中逆向缩放的一个可能解释，发现那些意外性更接近n元语法统计的检查点，反而能更好地预测阅读行为。综上所述，意外性对中文阅读时间的预测能力具有语料库特异性，警示我们不应仅凭单一语料库得出缩放结论。

summary: As automated fact-checking scales on social media, large language model (LLM) verdict scores can look stronger than warranted. One reason is that evaluations mix in information that was not knowable at claim time. Two channels are easy to conflate: outcomes memorized in pre-training and retrieved evidence published after the claim. Yet standard benchmarks rarely separate the two. In this study we measure both channels on AVeriTeC and QuanTemp++ by reconstructing point-in-time evidence conditions and probing for outcome information encoded in model representations. We find substantial evidence of parametric leakage, that can be hidden by the aggregate accuracy, while a simple representation bottleneck reduces this future leakage more efficiently than a mutual-information-based training penalty. We also find that allowing post-claim evidence inflates zero-shot accuracy by 6.3 points in AVeriTeC while the effect is negligible in QuanTemp++, where retrieval provides little post-claim evidence. These results show that misinformation benchmarks can overstate fact-checking performance when they do not account for what information was actually available at claim time.
title: No Hindsight for LLM Fact-Checkers: Measuring Leakage Channels in Misinformation Detection
title_translated: 大语言模型事实核查器不存在事后洞察：测量虚假信息检测中的信息泄露通道
summary_translated: 随着自动化事实核查在社交媒体上的扩展，大型语言模型（LLM）的判决分数可能看起来比实际更强。原因之一是评估中混入了在声明发布时无法获取的信息。两个容易混淆的通道是：预训练期间记忆的结果和在声明之后发布的检索证据。然而，标准基准很少区分这两者。在本研究中，我们通过重建时间点证据条件并探测模型表示中编码的结果信息，对AVerTeC和QuanTemp++中的这两种通道进行了测量。我们发现了显著的参数泄露证据，这种泄露可能被整体准确率掩盖；而简单的表示瓶颈比基于互信息的训练惩罚更高效地减少了这种未来泄露。此外，允许使用声明后的证据会使AVerTeC中的零样本准确率提升6.3个百分点，而在QuanTemp++中影响微乎其微，因为该数据集的检索提供的声明后证据极少。这些结果表明，当基准测试未考虑声明时实际可用的信息时，虚假信息检测性能可能被夸大。

summary: Self-supervised fine-tuning refines the embedding space of a pretrained language encoder without labels. However, the commonly used approaches are computationally expensive. Specifically, contrastive learning-based methods need multiview data and in-batch negative examples, while negative-free approaches require auxiliary graphs/networks. An interesting question arises: can self-supervised fine-tuning be done without relying on either additional negatives or graph data? To answer this question, we introduce SilK (Silhouette-guided K-means), which trains on a Cluster Validation Index, an internal measure of cluster quality without using labels. SilK clusters the corpus and then regresses a simplified silhouette toward a target value. Each document is compared only against the k cluster centroids, never against other documents, so the method needs no augmentation, no negative pairs and one view per document. On BERT-base, SilK trains 1.46x faster per epoch than the fastest baseline we evaluate and uses 45.4% less peak GPU memory than the leanest one. Under frozen-encoder linear probing, SilK stays competitive with the best baselines on three downstream tasks.
title: Cluster Validation Indices as Self-Supervised Objectives for Text Representation Learning
title_translated: 聚类验证指标作为文本表示学习的自监督目标
summary_translated: 自监督微调在无需标签的情况下优化预训练语言编码器的嵌入空间。然而，常用的策略计算成本较高：基于对比学习的方法需要多视角数据和批次内负样本，而无负样本方法则依赖辅助图或网络。一个有趣的问题浮现：是否可以在不依赖额外负样本或图数据的情况下实现自监督微调？为回答此问题，我们提出了SilK（轮廓引导的K均值），它基于聚类质量的内部度量（无需标签）进行训练。SilK对语料库进行聚类，并将简化的轮廓值回归到目标值。每个文档仅与k个聚类中心比较，从不与其他文档对比，因此无需数据增强、负样本对，且每篇文档只需一个视图。在BERT-base上，SilK每轮训练速度比我们评估的最快基线快1.46倍，峰值GPU内存使用量比最节省的基线减少45.4%。在冻结编码器线性探测下，SilK在三个下游任务中仍保持与最佳基线相当的性能。

summary: When an agentic prover works on an open problem, there is no proof assistant to fall back on: its verifier and lemma library are ultimately language models judging model outputs. We instrumented such a system end to end and analyzed $51{,}754$ traced observations across three full runs ($186$ hours, \$$5{,}694$). We find three connected failure modes. First, the three-model verifier requires unanimity and treats parse or API failure as non-approval; in $10$ of $12$ verification events, one member returned no parseable output or an API error, making acceptance arithmetically impossible without surfacing an error. Second, when the ensemble did function, one verifier approved $3$ attempts that GPT rejected, each claiming to resolve the open problem; a single-verifier design would therefore have announced a solution three times. Third, because nothing could be approved, every review was a refutation, yet the lemma extractor mines reviews as well as proofs: $24$ of $93$ lemmas ($26\%$) were extracted from rejected arguments with their refutational context removed. Taken together, these findings show that without external verification, supervision is itself a critical trust boundary: systems must distinguish abstention from rejection, preserve useful disagreement, and preserve the provenance and polarity of information before it becomes future context.
title: Viva La Vida: Verification and Accumulation Failures in Multi-Agent Proof Search
title_translated: 生命万岁：多智能体证明搜索中的验证与累积失败
summary_translated: 当一个代理证明系统处理开放性问题时，没有证明助手可供依赖：其验证器和引理库最终都是由语言模型来判断模型输出。我们对该系统进行了端到端的仪器化，并分析了三次完整运行（共186小时，花费5694美元）中的51,754次追踪观察。我们发现了三种相互关联的失败模式。第一，三模型验证器要求一致同意，并将解析失败或API错误视为不批准；在12次验证事件中，有10次至少有一个成员返回不可解析输出或API错误，导致接受在数学上不可能，除非暴露错误。第二，当集成验证器正常工作时，一个验证器批准了GPT拒绝的3次尝试，每次都声称解决了开放问题；若采用单验证器设计，系统将三次宣布解决方案。第三，由于没有任何内容被批准，所有评审均为驳回，但引理提取器既从证明也从评审中提取引理：93个引理中有24个（26%）来自被驳回的论证，且其反驳背景已被移除。综合来看，这些发现表明，在缺乏外部验证的情况下，监督本身成为关键的信任边界：系统必须区分回避与拒绝，保留有用的分歧，并在信息成为未来上下文之前保留其来源和极性。

summary: Counter-storytelling is a powerful mechanism people use to challenge dominant narratives. Unlike other forms of counterspeech that have been widely studied in computational social science, counter-storytelling has largely been overlooked. Counter-stories are difficult to detect automatically; they are relational (defined with respect to expressions of racial stereotypes) and structurally diverse (drawing on stories that describe lived experiences, witnessed events, exemplars, and hypotheticals). We introduce a first framework for detecting and characterizing counter-storytelling against racial stereotypes at scale. This includes (1) a three-dimensional taxonomy grounded in narratology and Critical Race Theory and (2) a multi-stage pipeline that identifies relational pairs of stereotypes and counter-stories in noisy Reddit discourse. Using this pipeline, we annotate 25,549 Reddit posts across 615 communities and identify 1,312 counter-stories. Our analysis shows that speaker identity and post context shape how counter-stories are told. For example, in-group writers favor first-person testimony, often adopting the role of self-reflective insiders. Our work shows how computational methods can scale qualitative approaches to identify and characterize counter-storytelling as a contextual narrative practice, with implications for content moderation, narratology, and racial discourse analysis.
title: How Do People Challenge Racial Stereotypes Online? Counter-Story Detection Across Reddit Communities
