title_translated: 边界一致，标签不一：个体标注者动态作为一类训练数据
summary_translated: 如今，数据质量的重要性已与算力相当，成为训练语言模型的关键因素。大量训练数据来自人类对文本的人工标注，而解释性标注并无“真实答案”来判定何为“准确”。现有两种应对策略：一是将多个标注者合并为“真实答案”，衡量他们之间的共识；二是将分歧视为信号。两者均比较不同人在某一时刻的表现。我们测量的是另一维度：同一读者在不同时间对同一文本的解读一致性。一位专家人类读者与三个大语言模型家族对三篇苏美尔神话进行了分段，并用七种状态之一标注每一段的因果功能。跨数月的多次运行显示，人类在分段位置上基本一致，但标签命名却各不相同，每篇神话皆然。而模型则无此类稳定模式：其两层间的差距在某些神话中为正，在另一些中为负，且大小各异。人类标签的变化并非随机：各次运行经历相似的功能序列，但起始点相差一步；而模型运行则始终从相同位置开始。我们认为这一模式可作为数据质量的有效度量和污染检测工具：若某“人类”标注的边界稳定且标签起始同步，则其表现更像模型。

summary: Identical utterance choices can arise from different communicative causes, and identical interpretations can leave different traces in what a listener learns. Rational Speech Act (RSA) models treat interpretation as inference over speaker meaning, but standard one-shot RSA does not intrinsically distinguish these causal update targets. We develop a coupled active-inference model of dialogue in which a listener's likelihood for an utterance is the policy distribution attributed to the speaker, placing the speaker's expected free energy within the listener's variational free energy. Each utterance is therefore both evidence about and an intervention on a partner. The model separates four updates that RSA approaches typically collapse: inference about the partner's current pragmatic state; learning of partner-specific parameters; prospective evaluation of clarification or repair; and a policy prior shaped by habit and a context-sensitive price of time. Under one-step, exact-inference restrictions, the model recovers the RSA speaker and listener, with RSA as the restricted single-turn limit of the coupled process. Outside these restrictions, the updates obey distinct rules and timescales, predicting which adaptations persist, remain partner-specific, or transfer. Worked examples show audience design reversing after clarification, self-confirming misunderstanding in which both interlocutors have low free energy while disagreeing about reference, and rational closing before uncertainty is resolved. Consistent with critiques of equating natural language with communication, the model treats communication as a downstream use of linguistic structure and recasts production and interpretation as coupled inference: speaking is both an intervention on a partner and an epistemic action that samples evidence for the speaker's model of that partner.
title: Evidence and Intervention: A Coupled Active-Inference Extension of Rational Speech Act Models
title_translated: 证据与干预：理性言语行为模型的耦合主动推理扩展
summary_translated: 相同的言语选择可能源于不同的交际动因，相同的理解结果也可能在听者所学内容中留下不同的痕迹。理性言语行为（RSA）模型将理解视为对说话人意图的推断，但标准的一次性RSA无法内在区分这些因果更新目标。我们发展了一种耦合主动推理对话模型，其中听者的言语似然度即为说话人策略分布，将说话人的预期自由能置于听者的变分自由能之中。因此，每次言语既是关于对方的证据，也是对对方的干预。该模型分离了RSA方法通常合并的四种更新：推断对方当前语用状态；学习对方特异性参数；前瞻性评估澄清或修复；以及由习惯和情境敏感的时间代价塑造的策略先验。在单步精确推理限制下，该模型恢复了RSA说话人与听者角色，且RSA是该耦合过程在单轮情况下的受限极限。在超出这些限制时，各更新遵循不同规则与时间尺度，可预测哪些适应会持续、是否具有对方特异性或可迁移。案例分析展示了观众设计在澄清后反转、自我确认误解（双方自由能均较低但参考对象不一致）以及在不确定性未解决前理性结束对话的现象。与将自然语言等同于交流的批评一致，该模型将交流视为语言结构的下游应用，并将生成与理解重构为耦合推断：说话既是对他人的干预，也是一种认知行动，用于采样支持说话人对对方模型的证据。

summary: This paper investigates the task of predicting job experience levels in recruitment texts, aiming to automatically identify the qualifications required for positions. Unlike traditional text classification, recruitment texts typically possess explicit internal structures, with different paragraphs playing disproportionate roles in conveying experience clues. To address this, we propose a structure-aware Section-Aware BERT approach that segments and encodes key paragraphs (titles, responsibilities, requirements) for integrated modeling, building upon rule-based systems and classical baselines TF-IDF. Simultaneously, we evaluate large language models under both few-shot and fine-tuning settings on the same dataset to compare the capability boundaries of different modeling paradigms. Experimental results demonstrate that explicitly leveraging text structure significantly improves experience level prediction performance, particularly in scenarios with ambiguous job titles. Further error analysis reveals systemic challenges in this task, including confusion between Entry and Senior levels and the blurred boundaries of Mid-level positions. This research provides an effective modeling approach and analytical framework for understanding structured recruitment texts.
title: Evaluating Modeling Approaches for Experience-Level Classification in Job Description
title_translated: 招聘文本中经验水平分类建模方法的评估
summary_translated: 本文研究了在招聘文本中预测职位经验水平的任务，旨在自动识别岗位所需的资格要求。与传统的文本分类不同，招聘文本通常具有明确的内部结构，不同段落对传达经验线索的作用差异显著。为此，我们提出了一种结构感知的段落感知BERT方法，通过分割并编码关键段落（标题、职责、要求）进行集成建模，基于规则系统和经典的TF-IDF基线。同时，我们在同一数据集上评估了大语言模型在少样本和微调设置下的表现，以比较不同建模范式的性能边界。实验结果表明，显式利用文本结构能显著提升经验水平预测性能，尤其是在职位名称模糊的情况下。进一步的错误分析揭示了该任务中的系统性挑战，包括初级与高级水平之间的混淆以及中级岗位边界的模糊。本研究为理解结构化招聘文本提供了有效的建模方法和分析框架。

summary: Generating multiple-choice questions is increasingly scalable, but establishing their assessment quality remains difficult. We present a focused narrative review of automated item-writing flaw detection, revision, psychometric screening, and NLP benchmark auditing. Database searches, citation retrieval, and nominated sources yield fourteen research reports reviewed in full text. We distinguish surface checks from content-sensitive judgments and map a 19-criterion rubric to detection methods and reported evidence. High label-level accuracy often coexists with weak positive case detection, while rubric definitions and reference standards vary. Revision evidence is mixed, and the associations reported in prior work do not establish the effects of repair. We propose evaluating quality assurance as a sequence of independently validated decisions, with criterion-specific reporting, calibrated human review, and outcome-based assessment of revisions.
title: AI-Enabled Quality Assurance for Multiple-Choice Assessment Items
comment: 8 pages, 2 tables, Full paper accepted to the AIME Conference 2026
title_translated: 面向多选题评估项目的AI赋能质量保证
summary_translated: 多选题的生成日益可扩展，但确保其评估质量仍具挑战。本文聚焦于自动化题目编写缺陷检测、修订、心理测量筛查及NLP基准审计的叙事综述。通过数据库检索、引文获取和提名来源，共筛选出14篇研究报告并进行全文评审。我们区分了表面检查与内容敏感判断，并将19项标准评分表映射到检测方法和报告证据。高标签级准确率常与弱正例检测能力并存，且评分标准和参考基准存在差异。修订证据不一致，先前研究中报告的关联性未能确立修复效果。我们建议将质量保证视为一系列独立验证决策的序列，采用特定标准报告、校准的人工评审以及基于结果的修订评估。

summary: Reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) is increasingly used in applications where large language models (LLMs) interact with humans and other agents. Here we use social deduction games to study how RFT changes LLMs' social behaviour. We let fine-tuned and base LLM agents play hidden-role games that require hidden-state inference, social reading and vote steering. Our results show that LLM agents do not reliably acquire social-deduction ability by directly optimizing terminal win--loss outcomes, suggesting that final game results provide a sparse and noisy signal for socially interactive learning. However, RFT is particularly effective at improving social reading, including tasks that require agents to infer hidden roles from public discussion, update beliefs over time and predict other agents' future decisions. We further show that RFT can also improve social influence, including tasks that require agents to steer votes, team approvals and collective decisions, although these gains depend more strongly on behaviourally specific rewards and structured interaction settings. Finally, we show that LLMs' ability to play social deduction games can be further improved through multi-agent social-cognitive reinforcement fine-tuning, which combines social-reading and social-influence signals during same-side multi-agent training. These learned behaviours also receive more favourable human evaluations of strategic competence, persuasiveness and social usefulness. Together, these results enrich our understanding of how RFT changes LLMs' social behaviour and provide a step toward a behavioural learning theory for machine social intelligence.
title: Playing social deduction games with reinforcement fine-tuned large language models
title_translated: 使用强化微调大语言模型玩社交推理游戏
summary_translated: 强化微调（RFT）在大语言模型（LLMs）与人类及其他智能体交互的应用中日益普及。本文通过社交推理游戏研究RFT如何改变LLM的社会行为。我们让微调后和原始LLM代理参与需要隐藏状态推断、社会阅读和投票引导的隐角色游戏。结果表明，仅直接优化最终胜负结果无法可靠地使LLM代理获得社交推理能力，说明最终游戏结果对社会互动学习而言是稀疏且噪声较大的信号。然而，RFT在提升社会阅读能力方面尤为有效，包括从公开讨论中推断隐藏角色、随时间更新信念以及预测其他代理的未来决策等任务。此外，我们还发现RFT也能改善社会影响力，如引导投票、团队批准和集体决策等任务，但这些提升更依赖于行为特定奖励和结构化交互设置。最后，我们展示了通过多智能体社会认知强化微调（结合社会阅读与社会影响信号）可进一步提升LLM玩社交推理游戏的能力，且这些习得行为也获得了人类对战略能力、说服力和社会实用性更高的评价。综合来看，这些结果深化了我们对RFT如何改变LLM社会行为的理解，并为机器社会智能的行为学习理论迈出了重要一步。

summary: Uncertainty quantification (UQ) for large language models (LLMs) aims to provide reliable measures of predictive confidence, yet current methods are often unstable under meaning-preserving perturbations. Semantically equivalent paraphrases can induce substantial variability in predictive confidence, even for methods with formal guarantees, such as conformal prediction. To address this issue, we propose a paraphrase-aware UQ framework robust to semantic rewordings. Our approach trains a lightweight proxy model on LLM hidden states and aggregates its predictions across paraphrases to construct label-wise nonconformity scores. Under score exchangeability, conformal calibration retains marginal coverage. This guarantee can also hold under test-only rewording, provided that the paraphrase pipeline satisfies an additional distributional alignment condition. We evaluate three settings (normal, fully reworded, and semi-reworded) which apply rewording to neither dataset, both calibration and test datasets, or only the test dataset, respectively. Across seven multiple-choice QA benchmarks and multiple model families, our method produces compact prediction sets with empirical coverage generally near the nominal target, even in the semi-reworded setting. Ablation studies show that the learned proxy accounts for most of the reduction in set size, while paraphrase-augmented training and inference-time aggregation improve stability under rewording. Code is available at https://github.com/Raina-Xin/PA_Score.
title: Conformal Prediction with Paraphrase-Aware Scoring for LLM Uncertainty Quantification
title_translated: 基于改写感知评分的置信度校准用于大语言模型不确定性量化
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLMs）的不确定性量化（UQ）旨在提供可靠的预测置信度度量，但现有方法在语义保持扰动下往往不稳定。语义等价的改写可能导致预测置信度产生显著波动，即使是对具有形式保证的方法（如置信度校准）。为解决此问题，我们提出一种对改写鲁棒的改写感知UQ框架。该方法在LLM隐藏状态上训练一个轻量级代理模型，并聚合其在改写版本上的预测结果，构建逐标签的非符合性得分。在得分交换性假设下，置信度校准可保持边际覆盖率。该保证在仅测试阶段改写时亦可成立，前提是改写流程满足额外的分布对齐条件。我们评估了三种场景（正常、完全改写、半改写），分别对应不改写数据集、同时改写校准与测试数据集、仅改写测试数据集的情况。在七个多项选择问答基准和多个模型家族上，我们的方法生成紧凑的预测集合，实证覆盖率普遍接近名义目标值，即使在半改写场景下亦然。消融实验表明，所学代理模型贡献了大部分集合尺寸的减少，而改写增强训练和推理时聚合则提升了改写下的稳定性。代码已开源：https://github.com/Raina-Xin/PA_Score。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) receive each user message as plain text, even when it combines text from different sources. For example, a user may paste text into a prompt and keep typing a comment directly below it. We study absorption: a phenomenon where the model treats a trailing user comment as part of the pasted text, returning it inside the edited text. This happens even though the user did not intend the comment to become part of that text. Existing instruction-data separation benchmarks tell the model which text is instruction and which is data, then test whether it obeys that separation. They do not test harmless user speech following an unmarked paste. We introduce SEAM, a controlled benchmark of 300 editing examples. Each example is tested under six matched conditions that vary how the boundary between pasted text and later user speech is expressed. Across 20 models, absorption at a bare newline ranges from 7.7% to 66.7%. Adding a blank line does not significantly reduce absorption in any model, while boundary markers reduce it in 19 of 20 models. Comments that fit the pasted text, such as a code comment typed after code, are absorbed significantly more often in 17 of 20 models. Models often fail to separate pasted material from later user speech, and explicit boundaries reduce but do not remove this failure.
title: Can LLMs Separate Pasted Artifacts from User Speech? Absorption at Unmarked Prompt Seams
title_translated: 大语言模型能否区分粘贴内容与用户语音？未标记提示边界处的吸收现象
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLMs）将每个用户消息作为纯文本接收，即使其包含来自不同来源的文本。例如，用户可能在提示中粘贴一段文本，并在其下方直接输入评论。我们研究“吸收”现象：即模型将后续用户评论视为粘贴文本的一部分，将其返回在编辑后的文本中。这即使用户并未意图让评论成为该文本的一部分也会发生。现有的指令-数据分离基准仅告诉模型哪部分是指令、哪部分是数据，然后测试其是否遵守分离规则，但并未测试在未标记粘贴后跟随的无害用户语音。我们引入SEAM，一个包含300个编辑示例的受控基准。每个示例在六种匹配条件下测试，变化的是粘贴文本与后续用户语音之间边界的表达方式。在20个模型中，仅用换行符分隔时吸收率从7.7%到66.7%不等。添加空行在任何模型中均未显著降低吸收率，而边界标记在19/20个模型中降低了吸收率。与粘贴内容匹配的评论（如代码后输入的注释）在17/20个模型中被吸收得更频繁。模型常常无法区分粘贴内容与后续用户语音，且显式边界虽可减少但无法消除这一失败。

summary: LLM agents for clinical text-to-SQL applications reason autonomously over multiple steps but cannot assess whether their own reasoning or outputs can be trusted. In high leverage applications such as healthcare, this presents a critical risk where system mistakes can be costly. These reliability failures are also resource failures: an incorrect reasoning trajectory spends computation budget on outputs that must be discarded. We introduce Sentinel, a trajectory-derived, classifier-based confidence layer that analyzes an agent's reasoning, code and database outputs to decide at three points whether to stop: refusing unanswerable questions before the agent runs, halting doomed trajectories mid-run, and withholding untrustworthy answers at delivery. Here, utilizing Chow's rule, we optimize decisions under the EHRSQL shared task's Reliability Score, which penalizes incorrect answers given a utility weighting, and find on the benchmark EHRSQL that Sentinel raises this score from +0.08 to +0.24 when mistakes have a low utility weighting, well above the +0.03 earned by refusing every question, with delivered-answer accuracy rising from 54% to 69% as coverage falls from 84% to 55%. At higher stakes the agents we test rarely answer reliably enough to deliver, and Sentinel detects this on its own, abstaining to that same +0.03 where the unmonitored agent scores -3.02. The same stopping decisions cut computation: at low stakes, where the system still answers, Sentinel eliminates 13-28% of agent steps at little or no reliability cost.
title: Trajectory-Derived Confidence for Reliable, Resource-Aware Clinical Text-to-SQL Agents
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Resource-Aware Agentic AI (RAAAI). 19 pages, 7 figures
title_translated: 基于轨迹的置信度：面向临床文本到SQL智能体的可靠且资源感知的评估
summary_translated: 用于临床文本到SQL应用的大型语言模型（LLM）代理在多步推理中自主决策，但无法评估自身推理或输出是否可信。在医疗等高影响场景中，系统错误可能带来严重后果。这些可靠性失败也表现为资源浪费：错误的推理轨迹会消耗计算预算却产生需丢弃的输出。我们提出Sentinel，一种基于轨迹、基于分类器的置信度层，通过分析代理的推理过程、代码和数据库输出，在三个关键点决定是否停止：在代理运行前拒绝无法回答的问题，中途终止注定失败的推理路径，以及在交付时屏蔽不可信的答案。利用Chow准则，我们在EHRSQL共享任务的可靠性评分下优化决策，该评分对具有低效用权重的错误答案施加惩罚。在基准测试EHRSQL上，当错误成本较低时，Sentinel将可靠性评分从+0.08提升至+0.24，远超拒绝所有问题所获得的+0.03；同时，交付答案准确率从54%提升至69%，覆盖范围从84%下降至55%。在高风险情况下，我们测试的代理很少能可靠地给出答案，而Sentinel能自行检测并选择不回答，达到与未监控代理-3.02的负分相比的+0.03得分。相同的停止决策还能减少计算量：在低风险场景下，系统仍会响应，Sentinel可消除13%-28%的代理步骤，几乎不牺牲可靠性。

summary: Building LLMs that behave well socially, not merely correctly, requires Building LLMs that behave well socially, not merely correctly, requires more than producing locally helpful responses. A socially competent agent must infer users' unstated goals, respect their preferences, and adapt as the conversation unfolds. These behaviors are inherently multi-turn and social, making them hard to optimize: real interaction data is scarce, and user preferences are typically latent rather than directly observable. To address these challenges, we build on a persona-driven social simulation environment (consisting of a persona library, LLM-based user simulators, and a user-satisfaction scoring system ranging from [0, 1]), to introduce preference-batched GRPO (PB-GRPO), a post-training algorithm that learns socially adaptive policies from conversation-level feedback. Compared to vanilla GRPO, PB-GRPO computes advantages using a normalization estimated across a bucket of users with similar preferences, stabilizing training across a diverse social population. Empirical evidence shows that PB-GRPO improves models' social behavior over strong reinforcement learning baselines in our simulated environment.
title: PB-GRPO: Learning Socially Adaptive LLM Agents from Persona-Driven Simulation with Preference-Batched GRPO
title_translated: PB-GRPO：基于人格驱动模拟的偏好批处理GRPO学习社交自适应LLM代理
summary_translated: 构建在社交层面表现良好而非仅正确回应的LLM，需要超越局部帮助性回复。一个具备社交能力的代理必须推断用户未明说的目标，尊重其偏好，并随对话推进动态调整。这些行为本质上是多轮且社交性的，难以优化：真实交互数据稀缺，用户偏好通常为隐含而非直接可观测。为此，我们基于一个人格驱动的社会模拟环境（包含人格库、基于LLM的用户模拟器及用户满意度评分系统[0,1]），提出偏好批处理GRPO（PB-GRPO），一种后训练算法，从对话级反馈中学习社交自适应策略。相较于原始GRPO，PB-GRPO使用跨相似偏好用户组估计的归一化优势，稳定了在多样化社交群体中的训练过程。实证结果表明，PB-GRPO在模拟环境中优于强强化学习基线模型的社交行为表现。

summary: Self-report is an appealing low-cost probe of an LLM's dispositions, but recent work finds only selective agreement between what models report and how they behave. Prior accounts establish these patterns by prompting black-box LLMs, leaving open whether the gap is a prompting artefact or a fact about how the underlying constructs are represented internally. We investigate risk-taking, a consequential dimension of agentic decision-making, using activation steering to measure self-report and behavior under the same internal intervention. We survey nine steering-vector extraction methods spanning task-specific directives, the model's own task behavior, and dispositional descriptions at two granularities, evaluated on two behavioral tasks and two psychometric instruments across four open-weight LLMs. We find that (1) a shared internal intervention does not ensure shared responsiveness: directions built from trait descriptions move self-report but leave behavior at chance, directions built from the model's own task choices do the reverse, and only task-specific directives reach both, weakly. (2) Diagnosis dissolves that exception: removing surface confounders leaves the directives only 32% of their behavioral effect. The two channels are otherwise steered by near-orthogonal directions, each channel reachable by several independent constructions. (3) An intervention composing one behavior-moving and one self-report-moving direction moves both together; flipping one sign sets them in opposition, with reported and enacted risk pointing in opposite directions on 69-89% of flipped compositions in all models. These findings move the self-report-behavior relationship from a black-box observation to a representational one that can be inspected and controlled, motivating representational checks alongside behavioral evaluation.
title: Representational Control over Self-Report & Behavior Coherence in LLM Risk-Taking
comment: 10 pages main content, 62 pages total, 21 figures, 19 tables
title_translated: LLM风险行为中自我报告与行为一致性的表征控制
summary_translated: 自我报告是一种低成本探测LLM倾向的吸引人方法，但近期研究发现模型自我报告与实际行为之间仅存在部分一致性。以往研究通过提示黑箱LLM来揭示这些模式，但未明确这种差距是提示造成的伪影，还是源于内部表征的本质。我们以风险承担这一关键的代理决策维度为例，采用激活引导技术，在相同内部干预下测量自我报告与行为的一致性。我们评估了九种不同方向的引导向量提取方法，涵盖任务特定指令、模型自身任务行为以及两种粒度的特质描述，分别在两个行为任务和两个心理测量工具上，针对四款开源权重LLM进行测试。研究发现：(1) 共享内部干预并不保证同步响应：基于特质描述构建的引导方向影响自我报告但对行为无显著作用；基于模型自身任务选择构建的方向则相反；只有任务特定指令能弱化地同时影响两者。(2) 诊断分析揭示例外原因：去除表面混淆因素后，指令对行为的影响仅保留32%。两条通道由近乎正交的方向控制，各自可通过多种独立构造实现。(3) 组合一个行为移动方向与一个自我报告移动方向，可同时操控两者；反转其中一个符号，则使两者对立，导致报告与执行的风险方向相反，出现在所有模型中69%-89%的组合中。这些发现将自我报告与行为的关系从黑箱观察转变为可检查与可控制的表征关系，推动在行为评估之外引入表征验证。

summary: Mechanistic interpretability usually studies fully trained models, yet the computations that drive a behaviour can change while the model is still learning the task. On the Indirect Object Identification task, a model should continue with the name mentioned once rather than the name mentioned twice. Pythia models pass through an early training window in which they prefer the repeated name, so accuracy in a choice between the two names falls below one half while language-model loss on a fixed text sample keeps decreasing across the same window. The window reflects a temporary imbalance between two computations. We identify one cause of the wrong preference by selecting a set of attention heads that write the repeated name, on prompts separate from those used for causal evaluation, keeping that selection fixed, and then replacing each head's final-token output with its average output on a separate set of non-repeated-name prompts. This improves the correct-minus-repeated logit difference in a separately trained 160M model and in the official 160M, 410M, and 1B models. At 160M, the head that lowers the repeated name in the mature model shows little of its mature behaviour at this point. It directs less than one percent of its attention to the repeated mention, and its output makes almost no direct contribution to lowering that name's logit. Both properties grow over the interval in which behaviour recovers. Across the 160M, 410M, and 1B models, transplanting the corresponding head's mature parameters into the early checkpoint recovers 35 to 68 percent of the total improvement in the correct-minus-repeated logit difference seen by the end of training. Related early-to-late reversals appear at further Pythia scales, in two independently trained GPT-2 models, and in OLMo. A mature circuit can therefore conceal a transient causal configuration that shaped behaviour earlier in training.
title: Copying Before Suppression: What Drives a Below-Chance Dip During Language Model Training?
title_translated: 抑制前的复制：语言模型训练期间低于随机水平下降的原因是什么？
summary_translated: 机制可解释性通常研究完全训练后的模型，但驱动行为的计算过程可能在模型仍在学习任务时发生变化。在间接宾语识别任务中，模型应持续关注首次提及的名字而非重复提及的名字。Pythia模型在早期训练阶段经历一个偏好重复名字的窗口期，导致在两个名字之间的选择准确率低于一半，而语言模型损失在固定文本样本上仍持续下降。该窗口反映了两种计算之间的暂时失衡。我们通过选择一组在非因果评估提示中写入重复名字的注意力头，保持该选择不变，并将每个头在最终token上的输出替换为其在另一组非重复名字提示上的平均输出，从而识别出错误偏好的一部分成因。这一操作在单独训练的160M模型以及官方发布的160M、410M和1B模型中均提升了正确名减去重复名的logit差值。在160M模型中，成熟模型中降低重复名字的头在此阶段表现出极小的成熟行为：其注意力不足1%投向重复提及，输出几乎不直接影响降低该名字的logit。这两项特性在行为恢复期间逐渐增强。在160M、410M和1B模型中，将对应头的成熟参数移植到早期检查点，可恢复训练结束时总改善量的35%至68%。类似从早期到晚期的逆转现象也在更大规模的Pythia模型、两个独立训练的GPT-2模型以及OLMo中出现。因此，成熟电路可能掩盖了早期训练中塑造行为的临时因果配置。

summary: Long-context LLMs can now ingest entire online discussion threads, but understanding their social discourse requires more than reading a long document: models must track parent-reply relations, turning points, scoped subtrees, cross-branch contrasts, and participant trajectories. To test this structure-aware social reasoning, we introduce LongSocialBench, a benchmark of 1,462 verified human-authored multiple-choice items drawn from 94 complete Hacker News, Stack Exchange, and Reddit r/ChangeMyView episodes, with a median length of approximately 73K tokens. Each item pairs a complete serialized discussion and reply structure with a four-option question, requiring models to recover structured social evidence. Released items are verified for answerability, option uniqueness, and evidence grounding. Across 18 models and 29 evaluation settings, current long-context workflows remain far below human performance. The best individual result comes from Claude-Opus-4.7, which reaches 63.0% when prompted to eliminate incorrect options before answering, compared with 72.4% for independent human readers. Averaged across all 18 models, the full-context Baseline scores 43.9%. Supplying the gold evidence scope raises this to 55.0%, showing that substantial errors remain even after the relevant thread region is identified. LongSocialBench shows that the missing capability is not context access or prompting alone, but social understanding over structured reply trees.
title: LongSocialBench: Do Long-Context LLMs Understand Online Discussion Threads?
title_translated: LongSocialBench：长上下文LLM能否理解在线讨论帖？
summary_translated: 长上下文LLM现在可以摄入完整的在线讨论帖，但理解其社会话语不仅需要阅读长文档，还需追踪父回复关系、转折点、作用域子树、跨分支对比以及参与者轨迹。为测试这种结构感知的社会推理能力，我们引入LongSocialBench，一个包含1,462个经人工验证的多人选择题的基准数据集，源自94个完整的Hacker News、Stack Exchange和Reddit r/ChangeMyView讨论事件，中位长度约为73K token。每个题目将完整序列化的讨论与回复结构与四个选项的问题配对，要求模型恢复结构化社会证据。已发布题目经过验证，确保可答性、选项唯一性和证据基础性。在18个模型和29种评估设置下，当前长上下文工作流仍远低于人类表现。最佳单个结果来自Claude-Opus-4.7，通过提示其先排除错误选项再作答，达到63.0%，而独立人类读者为72.4%。所有18个模型的平均全上下文基线得分为43.9%。提供黄金证据范围后提升至55.0%，表明即使确定了相关线程区域，仍存在大量错误。LongSocialBench表明，缺失的能力并非上下文访问或提示本身，而是对结构化回复树的社会理解能力。

summary: Language models exhibit strong reasoning capabilities, yet adapting them to structured domains remains challenging and can yield inconsistent outcomes. We identify representation compatibility, the extent to which a model effectively processes a representation for a structured task, as a key factor in adaptation. We study this in chess, which provides a controlled testbed with precise semantics, computable optimal actions, and multiple state representations, including a symbolic encoding (FEN) and a spatial format (ASCII). We find that models often process semantically equivalent inputs substantially differently, affecting both learning and generalization. Building on this observation, we propose representation-aligned auxiliary supervision, which uses environment-derived tasks expressed in compatible representations to improve adaptation to structured domains. Across models and representations, auxiliary supervision consistently improves optimal-move prediction relative to target-only training under identical target data. Tasks that expose environment dynamics provide larger and most consistent gains than surface-level or static supervision, while remaining competitive with substantially increasing the amount of target-task data. Moreover, ASCII-trained models transfer more effectively to FEN than FEN-trained models do to ASCII, even surpassing the FEN target-only baseline on FEN evaluation. The gains also extend beyond optimal-move prediction to open-ended, factually grounded commentary generation. Overall, our results show that auxiliary supervision in model-compatible representations can enable effective adaptation in structured domains.
title: Representation-Aligned Auxiliary Supervision for Language Model Adaptation
title_translated: 表示对齐的辅助监督用于语言模型适应
summary_translated: 语言模型展现出强大的推理能力，但将其适配到结构化领域仍具挑战性，且结果往往不一致。我们识别出表示兼容性——即模型有效处理结构化任务表示的程度——是适配的关键因素。我们在国际象棋中研究这一问题，其提供了具有精确语义、可计算最优动作和多种状态表示（包括符号编码FEN和空间格式ASCII）的受控测试环境。我们发现，模型经常以显著不同的方式处理语义等价的输入，影响学习和泛化能力。基于此观察，我们提出表示对齐的辅助监督，利用环境中导出的、在兼容表示下表达的任务来提升对结构化领域的适配效果。在不同模型和表示下，与仅使用目标数据训练相比，辅助监督在最优着法预测上始终表现更优。揭示环境动态的任务带来的增益最大且最稳定，而无需大幅增加目标任务数据量。此外，经过ASCII训练的模型向FEN迁移的效果优于FEN训练模型向ASCII迁移，甚至在FEN评估中超越了FEN仅目标基线。该收益还扩展至开放式、事实依据的评论生成任务。总体而言，我们的结果表明，在模型兼容表示下的辅助监督能够实现结构化领域中的有效适配。

summary: Despite rapid progress in automating scientific research, generating promising and well grounded research solutions remains a central challenge. We isolate research ideation as a standalone task and build our solution on the intuition that a challenge in one field can often be addressed by a mechanism that solved an analogous challenge in another. Accordingly, we introduce IdeaScientist, which decomposes ideation into gap finding, innovation, and report writing, and trains each role with reinforcement learning. These roles identify limitations in related work, draw solution intuitions from analogous problem settings, and develop those intuitions into complete research proposals. To facilitate discovery of insights across domains, we construct the Svalbard Idea Vault, a corpus of 2.77M decomposed research ideas for retrieval, training, and temporally controlled evaluation. Our evaluation restricts access to literature available before a cutoff date and assesses how closely proposed directions align with those later explored in 15K papers authored by human researchers. On Qwen3.6-27B, IdeaScientist outperforms the strongest open-source autoresearch baseline by 14.0%, driven mainly by gains in novelty. On this 27B open backbone, IdeaScientist even outperforms Claude Code SDK with Claude-4.8-Opus and Codex SDK with GPT-5.4, by up to 5.9%.
title: IdeaScientist: Orchestrating Agents for Grounded Scientific Ideation
title_translated: IdeaScientist：协调智能体实现有根基的科学创意生成
summary_translated: 尽管科学自动化研究进展迅速，但生成有前景且扎实的研究方案仍是核心挑战。我们将研究创意生成视为独立任务，并基于一个直觉：某一领域的挑战常可通过另一领域解决类似问题的机制来应对。因此，我们提出IdeaScientist，将创意生成分解为缺口发现、创新构思和报告撰写三个角色，并使用强化学习分别训练每个角色。这些角色能识别相关工作的局限性，从类比问题情境中汲取解决方案灵感，并将这些灵感发展为完整的研究提案。为促进跨领域洞察发现，我们构建了Svalbard创意档案库，包含277万条分解后的研究创意，用于检索、训练和时间控制下的评估。我们的评估限制访问截止日期前的文献，评估所提方向与15,000篇由人类研究人员撰写的论文后续探索方向的契合度。在Qwen3.6-27B模型上，IdeaScientist相较于最强的开源自研究基线提升了14.0%，主要得益于新颖性方面的提升。在该27B开源基础模型上，IdeaScientist甚至超越了Claude Code SDK（Claude-4.8-Opus）和Codex SDK（GPT-5.4），最高提升达5.9%。

summary: A language model reads long text in one quadratic forward pass, stops at the context window, and loses accuracy with length before reaching it. We ask whether the read can be factorized when deciding over a finite set: which document is relevant, which option is supported, which passage is the evidence. Periscope, a training-free inference method, arranges the $N$ chunks of a text on a $K{\times}K$ grid with $K{=}\lceil\sqrt{N}\rceil$ and asks a frozen model the same question about $K$ local spans of consecutive chunks and $K$ strided spans that sample the whole text, reading the log-odds of every answer at one token. Each answer takes its best local and strided score, and scoring every chunk by its two spans gives an evidence map at no further cost, whose peak is the chunk behind the answer. Every probe is about $\sqrt{sc}$ tokens for a text of $s$ tokens and chunk size $c$, so a window of $W$ tokens reaches $W^{2}/c$ tokens at $s^{1.5}$ cost. The map replaces the long read. On LongBench v2, reading only the $K$ chunks the map ranks highest, 9k tokens, matches the same model's best window read across windows from 32k to 1M tokens, and on InfiniteBench, where the median context is 150k tokens, it leads the best window read by 5 points. The same map ranks BRIGHT's long-document corpora with the best NDCG@10 of six methods. Each call caches only one probe, so a 27B model reads 4.5M-token contexts on one 80GB GPU, where a single pass would need 296GB of cache. A long read then needs a GPU that holds the model, not one that holds the text.
title: Periscope: Extending Frozen Language Models Beyond Their Context Window
title_translated: Periscope：突破冻结语言模型的上下文窗口限制
summary_translated: 语言模型以二次方复杂度的一次前向传播读取长文本，但在达到上下文窗口时停止，且随着长度增加准确率下降。我们探讨是否可在有限集合决策时对读取过程进行分解：哪份文档相关，哪个选项被支持，哪段文字是证据。Periscope是一种无需训练的推理方法，将文本的N个片段排列成K×K网格（K=⌈√N⌉），并让冻结模型针对K个连续片段局部跨度和K个步进跨度（覆盖全文）提出相同问题，一次读取每个答案的对数似然。每个答案取其最佳局部和步进得分，通过两个跨度评分对每个片段打分，从而生成无额外成本的证据图，峰值位置即为答案背后的片段。每次探测仅需约√(sc)个token（s为文本总token数，c为片段大小），因此W token的窗口可实现W²/c token的阅读范围，代价仅为s¹·⁵。该证据图取代了长文本读取。在LongBench v2上，仅读取证据图排名最高的K个片段（9k token）即可匹配同一模型在32k至1M token窗口中的最佳性能；在InfiniteBench（中位上下文15万token）上，领先最佳窗口读取5个百分点。同一证据图在BRIGHT长文档语料库上取得六种方法中最佳的NDCG@10。每次调用仅缓存一个探测，因此27B模型可在单块80GB GPU上读取450万token上下文，而单次前向传播需296GB缓存。长文本读取不再需要能容纳文本的GPU，只需能容纳模型的GPU。

summary: A trainable input embedding table assigns each vocabulary item an independently adjustable vector. We investigate whether this token-specific parameterization is required for substantial language-modeling capability, or whether a shared Transformer can learn from fixed token identities. We compare three decoder-only language models trained from scratch with the same tokenizer, contextual backbone, untied output-head architecture, and training recipe, with a target budget of 100 billion prediction tokens per model. Their input interfaces are a learned table, canonical 16-bit token-ID codes, and one fixed invertible recoding over GF(2). The fixed codes are repeated to model width without an additional trainable input projection. Both fixed-code models acquire substantial capabilities: canonical codes achieve 52.40\% HellaSwag normalized accuracy, 70.51\% PIQA accuracy, and 42.75\% LAMBADA accuracy. The learned-input control performs better on several evaluations, including HellaSwag and LAMBADA, so these results establish viability rather than performance parity. The fixed interfaces remove 100.7 million trainable parameters, yielding 1.711B-parameter models, but parameter reduction is not the central result. These single-run experiments distinguish architectural necessity from empirical utility: independently trainable token-specific input vectors are not required for the observed capabilities. A fixed identity interface also provides a controlled setting for studying representation learning downstream of an immutable input, without establishing where particular capabilities are localized.
title: Do Language Models Need a Trainable Input Embedding Table? Fixed Minimal Token Codes at 1.7B-Class Scale
title_translated: 语言模型是否需要可训练的输入嵌入表？固定最小标记编码在17亿级规模下的应用
summary_translated: 可训练的输入嵌入表为词汇表中每个项目分配一个可独立调整的向量。我们探究这种依赖于标记的参数化是否对语言模型的核心能力必不可少，或共享Transformer能否仅从固定标记身份中学习。我们比较三种从头训练的解码器-only语言模型，使用相同分词器、上下文骨干、未绑定输出头架构和训练流程，每模型目标预算为1000亿次预测。它们的输入接口分别为：可学习表、标准16位标记ID编码和一个在GF(2)上的固定可逆重编码。固定编码重复填充至模型宽度，无需额外可训练输入投影。两种固定编码模型均获得了显著能力：标准编码在HellaSwag上达到52.40%归一化准确率，PIQA为70.51%，LAMBADA为42.75%。可学习输入控制在多个评估中表现更优（如HellaSwag和LAMBADA），因此这些结果证明可行性而非性能对等。固定接口减少了1.007亿个可训练参数，得到17.11亿参数模型，但参数减少并非核心成果。这些单次实验区分了架构必要性与经验实用性：独立可训练的标记特定输入向量并非实现所观察能力的必需条件。固定身份接口也为研究不可变输入后的表示学习提供了受控环境，而不必确定特定能力的具体定位。

summary: The BAIBAICHUCHU team participated in the Social Media Subtask of NTCIR-19 FinArg-3, ranking Chinese investor posts by Maximum Possible Profit (MPP). A three-track ensemble of lexical features, a FinArg-2-pre-finetuned MacBERT ranker, and an LLM judge reaches 0.734 in post-grouped development evaluation, but our best official run scores 0.517. All twelve submitted runs lie between 0.4598 and 0.5402, and our 26 unanimous three-track pairs score 0.500.   A post-hoc audit finds that the submitted judge applied a long-only rule to bearish posts although MPP is stance-aware. Correcting it changes 28 of 87 official predictions without changing accuracy, yet lowers development accuracy from 0.680 to 0.622: a regime-specific semantic shortcut improved validation fit.   We decompose ranking into directional text, volatility and horizon, and pairwise margin. A running-extremum model predicts $σ\sqrt{T}$ scaling, observed ex post in 502 price-aligned posts from a separate July 2026 collection. Pre-posting volatility scaled by the post-specific observation horizon, $σ_{\mathrm{pre},20}\sqrt{N_i}$, is associated with a later truncated-horizon MPP proxy (Spearman $ρ=0.320$; ticker-cluster 95% CI [0.133,0.466]) and correctly orders 61.4% of unequal-outcome pairs. Transferred text is nearly uncorrelated with the July outcome ($ρ=0.055$) and adds little conditional on this score and stance. Development reliability rises from about 0.60 to 0.93 as the labeled MPP gap widens. An earlier ERAI result of 0.6207 rules out universal unpredictability as a simple explanation. Evaluation should jointly consider text, market regime, historical volatility, horizon, and pair composition.
title: BAIBAICHUCHU at the NTCIR-19 FinArg-3 Task: When Is Maximum Possible Profit Predictable from Investor Text?
comment: 15 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables. Both authors contributed equally. Selected for oral presentation at NTCIR-19 (FinArg-3 Social Media Subtask)
title_translated: BAIBAICHUCHU在NTCIR-19 FinArg-3任务中的表现：投资者文本中最大可能利润何时可预测？
summary_translated: BAIBAICHUCHU团队参与了NTCIR-19 FinArg-3的社会媒体子任务，对中文投资者帖子按最大可能利润（MPP）进行排序。一个包含词汇特征、FinArg-2预微调MacBERT排序器和LLM裁判的三轨集成模型在帖子分组开发评估中达到0.734，但我们的最佳官方运行得分为0.517。所有十二次提交结果介于0.4598至0.5402之间，我们26个一致的三轨组合得分为0.500。事后审计发现，提交的裁判对看跌帖子应用了仅做多规则，而MPP是立场感知的。纠正后改变了87个官方预测中的28个，未改变准确率，但使开发准确率从0.680降至0.622：一种特定于制度的语义捷径改善了验证拟合。我们将排序分解为方向性文本、波动性和时间跨度，以及成对边际。一个运行极值模型预测σ√T缩放关系，在另一次2026年7月收集的502个价格对齐帖子中被事后观测到。发布前波动性乘以帖子特定的观察时间跨度σ_pre,20√N_i，与后期截断时间跨度的MPP代理相关（Spearman ρ=0.320；股票聚类95%置信区间[0.133,0.466]），并正确排序了61.4%的非均等结果对。转移文本与7月结果几乎无关（ρ=0.055），在该分数和立场条件下贡献甚微。随着标注MPP差距扩大，开发可靠性从约0.60升至0.93。早期ERAI结果0.6207排除了普遍不可预测作为简单解释的可能性。评估应综合考虑文本、市场制度、历史波动性、时间跨度和成对构成。

summary: During fine-tuning, a language model can assign less probability to previously learned answers even when the current gradient acts to preserve that probability. With momentum, each update also carries gradients computed at earlier model states, and these stored contributions can push the model in the opposite direction. We investigate how this optimiser memory contributes to forgetting by separating old-task loss into confusion among its answers and leakage of probability outside the answer set. Across three language-model families, answer mass consistently declines while discrimination among old answers usually improves: the model becomes less likely to produce answers that it can still distinguish correctly. Decomposing Adam updates reveals opposing contributions to this loss of answer mass. Over training, accumulated history favours leakage, while the current gradient opposes it. Resolving history by age shows that the harmful contributions come mainly from older gradients of the new task, whereas recent gradients tend to protect the old answers. Changes in history's effect are dominated by its orientation relative to the old-task gradient. Interventions that reset momentum while matching the initial update norm establish that stored history affects retention, with state-dependent immediate effects and lower final old-task loss over longer Adam continuations, mainly through recovered answer mass. Finally, integration along finite updates shows that most sampled large loss increases are captured by local projections, while curvature along history amplifies some events. Together, these findings reveal how an optimiser's memory can erode learned behaviour even as its current gradient acts to preserve it.
title: A Step Towards Forgetting: Optimiser History and the Loss of Answer Mass
title_translated: 迈向遗忘：优化器历史与答案质量的丧失
summary_translated: 在微调过程中，语言模型即使在当前梯度试图保留先前学习答案概率的情况下，仍可能降低这些答案的概率。由于动量的存在，每次更新都携带了早期模型状态下的梯度，这些存储的贡献可能使模型朝相反方向移动。我们通过将旧任务损失分解为答案间的混淆和概率向答案集外泄露两部分，研究了优化器记忆如何导致遗忘。在三种语言模型家族中，答案质量持续下降，而对旧答案的区分能力通常提升：模型更少产生仍能正确区分的答案。对Adam更新的分解揭示了对答案质量丧失的相反作用力。训练过程中，累积的历史倾向于促进泄露，而当前梯度则抑制这一趋势。按历史年龄分析显示，有害贡献主要来自新任务较早的梯度，而近期梯度则倾向于保护旧答案。历史影响的变化主要由其相对于旧任务梯度的方向决定。通过在保持初始更新范数的前提下重置动量的干预实验表明，存储的历史确实影响保留效果，具有依赖状态的即时效应，并在更长的Adam连续训练中实现更低的最终旧任务损失，主要得益于恢复的答案质量。最后，沿有限更新进行积分分析表明，大多数采样的大损失增加可通过局部投影捕捉，而历史路径上的曲率会放大某些事件。这些发现共同揭示了优化器记忆如何在当前梯度试图维持学习行为的同时，侵蚀已学行为。

summary: General decision models, such as Jev, have recently emerged as efficient alternatives to LLMs for structured judgment and selection. But what kinds of decisions can these models reliably make, and how does their behavior change when individual decisions are composed into larger systems? To study this, we introduce JEVal, a bilingual benchmark comprising 11,257 instances from 36 datasets across 10 application domains, and evaluate 25 model configurations spanning general decision models and generative LLMs. Our results show that (1) general decision models are most competitive when decisions can be resolved from available evidence, but weaken when they require specialist knowledge or faithful uncertainty estimation: they can often identify the most likely outcome while substantially overstating its probability. (2) In more dynamic and realistic systems involving long-horizon, multi-step interactions, the advantages of fast local decision making are offset by reliability failures at the system level. on $τ$-bench, faster local decisions reduce median episode time but lower task success as decision errors accumulate over long trajectories. (3) In large-scale social simulation, decision models approach strong generative LLMs on individual response prediction at substantially lower inference cost, yet remain weaker in user profiling and exhibit larger aggregate estimation errors and systematic bias. Finally, we propose InnerJev-4B and InnerJev-27B, which internalize an open-weight LLM's own reasoning into a single-pass first-token decision through Reasoning-to-Readout Self-Distillation, with InnerJev-27B performing on par with Jev on JEVal while answering a typical query in about 0.1 s.
title: General Decision Models: Benchmarking and Insights Beyond Jev
title_translated: 通用决策模型：超越Jev的基准测试与洞察
summary_translated: 通用决策模型（如Jev）最近作为结构化判断与选择的高效替代方案出现，但它们在哪些决策上表现可靠？当个体决策被组合成更大系统时，其行为又如何变化？为此，我们引入JEVal，一个包含11,257个样本、覆盖10个应用领域的双语基准，评估了25种模型配置，涵盖通用决策模型和生成式大语言模型。结果表明：(1) 当决策可从现有证据中得出时，通用决策模型最具竞争力；但在需要专业知识或准确不确定性估计时，其性能下降：模型常能识别最可能的结果，却严重夸大其概率。(2) 在涉及长周期、多步骤交互的动态真实系统中，快速本地决策的优势被系统级可靠性失败所抵消。在τ-bench上，更快的本地决策虽减少中位episode时间，但因决策错误在长轨迹中累积而导致任务成功率下降。(3) 在大规模社会模拟中，决策模型在个体响应预测上接近强生成式大语言模型，且推理成本显著更低，但在用户画像方面仍较弱，表现出更大的总体估计误差和系统性偏差。最后，我们提出InnerJev-4B和InnerJev-27B，通过推理到读出的自蒸馏方法，将开放权重大语言模型自身的推理内化为单次前token决策，其中InnerJev-27B在JEVal上的表现与Jev相当，且典型查询响应时间约为0.1秒。

summary: When documents supporting an agent's derived facts are revoked or replaced, should it repair memory or re-read current evidence? We introduce an evidence-revision evaluation on medication- and problem-list tasks from public ICU records. Under revocation, replacement and control events, we compare full and source-filtered re-reading with caching, rebuilding and graph-local repair across two 7B models. Memory is supplied in full without retrieval, and costs include ingest, revision and every use. On short records, local repair uses 5-10$\times$ fewer revision tokens than rebuilding, yet every memory pipeline costs at least twice full re-reading in held-out conditions. In a small pre-specified development sweep, adding task-ineligible documents extended records to about 10,000 tokens; at that length, memory's mean cumulative cost fell below full re-reading's after 2-14 uses, partly through truncated extraction, while source-filtered re-reading remained cheapest. In the replacement study, none of the four primary confirmatory tests reached statistical significance. These results show why the cost of agent memory after evidence revision must be assessed against source-filtered re-reading over the full pipeline.
title: When Evidence Changes: Evaluating Memory Repair and Re-reading in Language-Model Agents
title_translated: 当证据发生变化时：评估语言模型智能体中的记忆修复与重读机制
summary_translated: 当支持智能体推导事实的文档被撤销或替换时，智能体应选择修复记忆还是重新读取当前证据？我们针对公开ICU记录中的药物清单和问题列表任务，引入了一项证据修订评估。在撤销、替换和控制条件下，我们比较了完整与源过滤重读、缓存、重建及图局部修复四种方法，使用两个7B规模的模型进行测试。记忆以完整形式提供，不依赖检索，成本包括摄入、修订及每次使用。在短文档情况下，局部修复的修订token消耗仅为重建的5-10倍，但所有记忆流水线在保留条件下成本至少是完整重读的两倍。在一次预设的小规模开发扫描中，加入任务无关文档使记录长度扩展至约10,000 tokens；在此长度下，记忆的平均累计成本在使用2-14次后低于完整重读，部分得益于截断提取，而源过滤重读始终最便宜。在替换研究中，四个主要确认性测试均未达到统计显著性。这些结果表明，在证据修订后，必须将智能体记忆的成本与全流水线的源过滤重读进行对比评估。

summary: Long chain-of-thought (CoT) traces impose substantial output-token costs. Under constrained budgets, compression must preserve answer-critical information, making boundary placement central. Token-level and fixed-length boundaries can fragment coherent spans such as phrases, formulas, and local derivations, whereas step-level boundaries can bind content requiring different compression actions. We introduce SynLat, a text-latent CoT framework that aligns compression boundaries with syntactic structure through non-overlapping Syntax-Aligned Units (SAUs). An answer-conditioned Teacher constructs progressive KEEP/LATENT targets for a single compression-conditioned Student, which generates mixed reasoning from only the question and requested compression level at inference. Across two Qwen3 Student scales, Standard-CoT and Long-CoT groups, and three compression levels, SynLat matches or exceeds the strongest evaluated baseline in all 12 task-group aggregates and strictly leads in 11 under the reported achieved-CR selection protocol. Overall gains reach 3.6/2.6 points at MEDIUM and 7.0/5.5 points at HIGH for Qwen3-8B/14B, with larger advantages under stronger compression, particularly on Long-CoT groups.
title: SYNLAT: Syntax-Aligned Text-Latent Compression for Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
title_translated: SYNLAT：用于思维链推理的语法对齐文本-隐变量压缩
summary_translated: 长思维链（CoT）痕迹带来巨大的输出token开销。在预算受限的情况下，压缩必须保留与答案相关的关键信息，因此边界定位至关重要。基于token或固定长度的边界可能破坏连贯片段（如短语、公式、局部推导），而基于步骤的边界可绑定需不同压缩策略的内容。我们提出SynLat，一种文本-隐变量思维链框架，通过非重叠的语法对齐单元（SAUs）将压缩边界与语法结构对齐。一个答案条件化的教师模型为单一压缩条件化的学生构建逐步的KEEP/LATENT目标，学生仅在推理时使用问题和请求的压缩级别生成混合推理。在两个Qwen3学生规模、Standard-CoT与Long-CoT组别以及三种压缩等级下，SynLat在全部12个任务组聚合中匹配或超过最强基线，在报告的达成CR选择协议下有11个组严格领先。整体增益在MEDIUM和HIGH级别分别达到3.6/2.6点（Qwen3-8B/14B），在更强压缩下优势更大，尤其在Long-CoT组别中更为明显。

summary: Real-world outpatient oncology notes contain specialised terminology, tumour staging expressions, treatment names, toxicity descriptions, and institution-specific de-identification markers that may not be represented efficiently by general biomedical or adjacent clinical language models. We developed and evaluated oncology-specific BERT-style encoders using a governed UK outpatient oncology corpus comprising 290,026 notes from 21,564 patients treated for lung and head-and-neck cancer. We compared RadBERT and PathologyBERT with two local strategies: OncoNote-RadBERT, produced by continued masked language model pretraining, and OncoNoteBERT, trained from scratch with an oncology WordPiece tokenizer. Models were evaluated using masked language modelling loss and perplexity on the validation set, tokenizer fragmentation metrics, clinical term tokenisation, masked-token probes, and exploratory representation analysis. Both external encoders fit the oncology corpus poorly in zero-shot evaluation (perplexity 113.04 for RadBERT; 2035.03 for PathologyBERT), while continued pretraining produced the strongest fit (2.10 for OncoNote-RadBERT). OncoNoteBERT achieved perplexity 2.83 but produced the most efficient tokenisation, with lower subword fertility and shorter normalised sequence length. It also returned a clinically acceptable prediction for 12 of 13 masked-token probes, compared with 7 of 13 for OncoNote-RadBERT. This divergence between corpus-level fit and masked-token performance was partly attributable to tokenizer fragmentation rather than learned semantics alone. Both locally developed models represented the institutional placeholder as a single learnable token. These findings show that continued adaptation and bespoke tokenisation provide complementary benefits, and that representation-layer design matters before adjacent-domain encoders are applied to oncology NLP.
title: OncoNoteBERT: A Foundation Representation Model for Natural Language Processing of Real-World Outpatient Oncology Notes
comment: Accepted at the AI at Scale for Clinical Impact (ASCI): Cancer Pathology Foundation Models Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
title_translated: OncoNoteBERT：面向真实世界门诊肿瘤学笔记自然语言处理的基础表示模型
summary_translated: 真实世界的门诊肿瘤学笔记包含专业术语、肿瘤分期表达、治疗名称、毒性描述以及机构特有的去标识标记，这些内容可能无法被通用生物医学或邻近临床语言模型有效表示。我们基于一个包含290,026条笔记（来自21,564名接受肺癌和头颈部癌治疗的患者）的受控英国门诊肿瘤学语料库，开发并评估了专用于肿瘤学的BERT风格编码器。我们将RadBERT和PathologyBERT与两种本地策略进行比较：OncoNote-RadBERT（通过持续掩码语言模型预训练生成）和OncoNoteBERT（使用肿瘤学WordPiece分词器从头训练）。模型在验证集上通过掩码语言建模损失、困惑度、分词器碎片化指标、临床术语分词、掩码token探测和探索性表示分析进行评估。外部编码器在零样本评估中对肿瘤学语料拟合较差（RadBERT困惑度113.04；PathologyBERT 2035.03），而持续预训练产生的OncoNote-RadBERT拟合最佳（困惑度2.10）。OncoNoteBERT达到困惑度2.83，同时实现了最高效的分词，具有更低的子词肥力和更短的归一化序列长度。它在13个掩码token探测中成功预测12个，而OncoNote-RadBERT仅成功7个。这种语料层面拟合与掩码token性能之间的差异部分归因于分词器碎片化，而非仅学习语义。两个本地开发模型都将机构占位符表示为单个可学习token。这些发现表明，持续适应与专用分词器设计具有互补优势，且在将邻域编码器应用于肿瘤学NLP之前，表示层设计至关重要。

summary: Researchers often support the claim that a model shares structure with the brain, or across languages, by reporting a similarity score. We ask what such a score reads when the shared structure is absent, or when the tool that measures it does not work. We check two settings, and in both the score is not what it appears. First, a probe trained to tell grammatical from ungrammatical sentences in one language transfers worse to more distant languages, the usual evidence for shared structure. But the probe itself gets worse along the same axis: in four of seventeen languages it performs at chance, so 64 of 272 language pairs are scored with a tool that does not work. Dropping those languages halves the strength of the relationship, but they are also the most distant, and this design cannot separate the two effects. Counting matters too: the same data give p = 0.0006 when the 272 pairs are treated as independent and p = 0.155 when the seventeen languages are, which is the correct unit. Second, training a language model to match human brain responses raises its similarity score from 0.10 to 0.34, against a ceiling of 0.54. A model trained on a target whose correspondence to the brain was destroyed still scores 0.31, so only 0.028 to 0.068 of the rise is specific to the brain. With no model at all, a destroyed target already sits at 0.204 from the real one, a floor that tracks the target's rank divided by the number of sentences. Finally, steering a language along its own direction works (+6.2 over a random direction in sixteen of seventeen languages) yet shows no effect that varies with language distance. Before asking whether a correspondence helps, ask how much of the score would survive without it.
title: The Score Is Not the Structure: Brain Alignment and Cross-Lingual Transfer

title_translated: 得分并非结构：大脑对齐与跨语言迁移
summary_translated: 研究人员常通过报告相似性得分来支持模型与大脑或不同语言之间存在结构共享的论断。我们探讨当共享结构不存在，或测量工具失效时，该得分实际反映什么。在两种情境下，得分均非表面所示。首先，一个在一种语言中区分语法正确与错误句子的探测器，在向更远距离语言迁移时表现更差，这通常被视为共享结构的证据。但探测器自身在同一维度上也表现变差：在十七种语言中的四种语言中其表现仅达随机水平，因此272个语言对中有64个使用了失效的工具进行评分。剔除这些语言后关系强度减半，但它们恰恰是最远的语言，该设计无法区分这两种效应。计数方式同样重要：相同数据在将272对视为独立单元时p值为0.0006，而以十七种语言为单位时p值为0.155，后者才是正确的单位。其次，训练语言模型以匹配人类大脑反应，使其相似性得分从0.10提升至0.34（上限为0.54）。即使目标与大脑对应关系被破坏，仍能获得0.31的得分，因此仅有0.028至0.068的提升是特定于大脑的。若无任何模型，被破坏的目标本身已达到0.204（相对于真实目标），这一基线与目标排名除以句子数量相关。最后，沿自身方向引导语言可带来+6.2的提升（在十七种语言中十六种如此），但其效果不随语言距离变化。在询问对应关系是否有益之前，应先问：若无此对应，得分中有多少仍能保留。

summary: A benchmark score compares a system output against a reference, and methodological attention falls almost entirely on the first term. We measure the second. The retained annotation record of a six-language benchmark for personally identifiable information contains two independent annotator labellings, the aggregate shipped as gold, and a reviewer gold from independent expert re-annotation of a sample. Using it, we hold the scored output fixed and exchange the reference. The score moves by 4.95 F1 points for one output and 2.00 for the other (95% CIs [3.23, 6.27] and [0.26, 3.37]), and by 7.55 in the worst language. The comparison between two outputs moves as well: the paired interaction between reference and system is +2.95 points (CI [+1.97, +3.87]), survives correction for multiple testing, and changes one language's margin outright. The cause is an undocumented aggregation default that usually kept one annotator when adjudication did not fire, making the shipped reference a partial copy of an output being scored. We report the resulting reference-sensitivity band, show how to compute one from any retained annotation record, and argue that the quantity belongs beside the score.
title: Same Output, Different Gold: Measuring How Reference Choice Moves a Multilingual Benchmark Score

title_translated: 相同输出，不同真值：参考选择如何影响多语言基准分数
summary_translated: 基准分数比较系统输出与参考答案，方法论关注几乎全部集中在第一项。我们关注第二项。一个六语言个人身份信息检测基准的注释记录包含两组独立标注者标签，聚合后的结果作为标准参考，另有一组由独立专家重新标注样本生成的评审参考。利用此数据，我们固定被测输出并更换参考。分数变化分别为4.95 F1点和2.00 F1点（95%置信区间[3.23, 6.27]和[0.26, 3.37]），最差语言中变化达7.55。两个输出之间的比较也发生变化：参考与系统间的配对交互效应为+2.95点（置信区间[+1.97, +3.87]），经多重检验校正后依然显著，并彻底改变了某一语言的得分差距。原因是未记录的聚合默认规则：当仲裁未触发时，通常保留一位标注者的标签，导致交付的参考部分复制了待评分的输出。我们报告由此产生的参考敏感性范围，展示如何从任意保留的注释记录中计算该范围，并主张该量应与分数并列呈现。

summary: Context: Fine-grained emotion classification of mobile app reviews enables requirements engineering activities that go beyond polarity-based opinion mining, including emotionally informed issue prioritisation and feature-oriented feedback analysis. However, automatic fine-grained emotion extraction from app reviews remains understudied. Objectives: Building on a previously published annotation framework and human-labelled ground truth adapted from Plutchik's taxonomy, this paper investigates how large language models can be leveraged for automatic multi-label emotion classification under severe class imbalance. Methods: We compare encoder-only fine-tuning under multi-label and binary-ensemble formulations, decoder-only zero- and few-shot prompting across open-source and proprietary models, and a catalogue of imbalance mitigation strategies (loss reweighting, resampling, generative data augmentation), with the synthetic-review generator and prompting strategy selected via an intrinsic augmentation-utility ranking. Results: Fine-tuned encoders trail the best decoder-only few-shot prompting (macro-F1 0.642) by a wide margin at baseline (multi-label: 0.387; binary ensemble: 0.450); pairing the best multi-label encoder with generative data augmentation and positive-weighted loss closes most of this gap (+0.204) at up to three orders of magnitude lower inference latency than the decoders, with the largest gains on the rarest emotions, from undetected to gains of up to +0.501 F1. Conclusion: Large language models make fine-grained, multi-label emotion classification of app reviews feasible for requirements engineering pipelines, with modest macro-F1, and the best formulation and mitigation strategy are backbone- and formulation-dependent. We release the experimental pipeline, synthetic corpora, and fine-tuned checkpoints for replication and reuse.
title: Fine-Grained Emotion Classification from Mobile App Reviews: An Empirical Study with Large Language Models
title_translated: 基于移动应用评论的细粒度情绪分类：大语言模型的实证研究
summary_translated: 背景：对移动应用评论进行细粒度情绪分类，可支持超越极性分析的意见挖掘，包括情感驱动的问题优先级排序和面向功能的反馈分析。然而，自动从应用评论中提取细粒度情绪的研究仍显不足。目标：基于先前发布的标注框架及源自普拉奇克情绪理论的人工标注真实数据，本文研究如何利用大语言模型实现严重类别不平衡下的自动多标签情绪分类。方法：比较仅编码器微调在多标签与二元集成形式下的表现、开放源码与专有模型在解码器仅零样本与少样本提示下的表现，以及一系列不平衡缓解策略（损失重加权、重采样、生成式数据增强），其中合成评论生成器与提示策略通过内在增强效用排名选定。结果：微调的编码器在基线表现上远落后于最佳解码器少样本提示（宏F1 0.642）（多标签：0.387；二元集成：0.450）；将最佳多标签编码器与生成式数据增强及正类加权损失结合，可弥补大部分差距（+0.204），且推理延迟低三个数量级，尤其在罕见情绪类别上提升显著，从无法检测到最高+0.501 F1。结论：大语言模型使应用评论的细粒度多标签情绪分类在需求工程流程中成为可能，尽管宏观F1不高，但最优方案与模型架构和形式密切相关。我们公开实验流程、合成语料库及微调检查点以供复现与再利用。

summary: In this paper, we study how training data creates associations between the tokens at the start of a base model's response and the reasoning behavior that follows. First, we demonstrate that fixing particular starting token cues makes a base model's performance competitive with that of its reinforcement learning (RL)-trained counterparts on math and coding. For instance, the cue ".\n\nOkay" raises Olmo-3-7B's MATH-500 pass@1 accuracy from 42% to 78%, while "Alright," raises Qwen3-14B's from 72% to 87%. Second, RL makes these cues more likely, while fixing them recovers much of its performance gain over the base model. Third, we trace the reasoning effects of token cues to the training data. We perform causal data interventions to turn an arbitrary word, such as "chicken", into an effective reasoning cue, or remove an existing cue's effect. A similar edit makes the prompt instruction "Think duck duck goose" as effective as "Think step by step" at eliciting reasoning. We also find that the hidden state representations induced by different cues correlate with different document types from the training set. Finally, we extend our study of token cues with a case study in language model safety, finding that different cues elicit distinct refusal and compliance behaviors that correspond to different types of training data.
title: Base Models Can Reason By Taking a Cue From Training Data

title_translated: 基础模型可通过借鉴训练数据实现推理
summary_translated:
本文研究训练数据如何在基础模型响应起始标记与后续推理行为之间建立关联。首先，我们证明固定特定起始标记可使基础模型在数学和编程任务上的表现媲美强化学习（RL）训练的模型。例如，提示符".

Okay"使Olmo-3-7B在MATH-500测试集上的pass@1准确率从42%提升至78%，而"Alright,"使Qwen3-14B从72%升至87%。其次，RL使这些提示更易出现，而固定提示则可恢复其相对于基础模型的大部分性能增益。第三，我们追溯标记提示的推理效应源于训练数据。通过因果数据干预，可将任意词汇（如"chicken"）转变为有效的推理提示，或消除现有提示的影响。类似操作使提示指令"Think duck duck goose"在激发推理方面与"Think step by step"同样有效。我们还发现，不同提示诱导的隐藏状态表示与训练集中不同类型文档相关联。最后，我们在语言模型安全性案例研究中扩展了标记提示分析，发现不同提示会引发不同的拒绝与服从行为，对应于训练数据的不同类型。

summary: LLM agents that orchestrate frozen vision-language-action (VLA) policies improve across episodes through text memory, which records what the agent did but not how the task is done. A demonstration video shows it, but fits poorly into an agent's context. The full video slows every turn, fixed keyframes lose the contact detail that decides whether a grasp holds, and what the agent needs shifts from the task's structure while planning to the frames around each contact. We introduce Recursive Video In-Context Learning (RV-ICL), a training-free method that turns a demonstration into a hierarchy the agent navigates rather than a prompt it receives. The hierarchy is built from the sub-events of the demonstration, such as grasps and releases. Its levels grow finer, from keyframes of the whole task to phases, moments and short clips, and are exposed through read-only tools. The agent reads the coarse levels before planning. During execution it re-enters the hierarchy whenever a step needs more detail and loads only the clip of its current sub-goal. One demonstration per task is enough. Built on RPent, RV-ICL raises success from 92.6% to 96.5% on LIBERO-PRO and from 86.7% to 95.8% on LIBERO-Plus.
title: Recursive Video In-Context Learning for Agentic Robot
title_translated: 用于智能体机器人的递归视频上下文学习
summary_translated: 能够协调冻结视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的LLM智能体通过文本记忆在多轮中持续改进，但该记忆仅记录智能体做了什么，而非任务如何完成。演示视频展示了过程，但难以融入智能体的上下文。完整视频拖慢每轮执行，固定关键帧丢失决定抓取是否成功的接触细节，而智能体所需信息在规划阶段从任务结构转向每个接触点周围的帧。我们提出递归视频上下文学习（RV-ICL），一种无需训练的方法，将演示转化为智能体导航的层次结构，而非接收的提示。该层次结构由演示中的子事件（如抓取与释放）构建，层级逐渐细化，从整个任务的关键帧到阶段、时刻和短片段，并通过只读工具暴露。智能体在规划前读取粗粒度层级，执行过程中每当需要更多细节便重新进入层次结构，仅加载当前子目标对应的片段。每项任务仅需一次演示即可。基于RPent，RV-ICL在LIBERO-PRO上成功率从92.6%提升至96.5%，在LIBERO-Plus上从86.7%提升至95.8%。

summary: We distill Kokoro-82M, a widely used open text-to-speech model with 54 voices, into Paradee, an 8.07M-parameter model that speaks one of them. Paradee keeps Kokoro's architecture with much narrower layers, and each of its two halves is trained separately against the frozen teacher. It has 10x fewer parameters and needs 15x less compute. We first synthesize a corpus with the teacher and keep its durations, pitch, energy and phoneme features. We then train a small text side to predict these values, and a small decoder to turn the teacher's saved values into the teacher's audio, first with spectral losses and then adversarially. Finally, we connect the two halves and quantize the weights to int8. It needs no alignment learning and no joint training, and it runs on one laptop. Stored in int8, Paradee is 8.5 MB, runs 25x faster than real time on one CPU thread, and scores 4.41 on UTMOS against the teacher's 4.52. The student initially kept a slight buzz, which we trace to the phase of voiced speech between 2 and 8 kHz. A phase-locking filter applied after synthesis removes most of it, with no training and no extra parameters. Code, model files and audio samples are at https://github.com/sahilmahendrakar/paradee
title: Paradee: Distilling Kokoro-82M into an 8M-Parameter Single-Voice Text-to-Speech Model

title_translated: Paradee：将Kokoro-82M蒸馏为一个800万参数的单语音文本转语音模型
summary_translated: 我们将广泛使用的开源文本转语音模型Kokoro-82M（包含54种语音）蒸馏为一个8.07万参数的模型Paradee，该模型仅能生成其中一种语音。Paradee保留了Kokoro的架构但使用更窄的层，其两个部分分别在冻结的教师模型上独立训练。该模型参数量减少10倍，计算需求降低15倍。我们首先用教师模型合成语料库并保留其时长、音高、能量和音素特征；然后训练一个小的文本侧预测这些值，再训练一个小解码器将教师模型保存的值转换为音频，先使用频谱损失，再采用对抗方式。最后，我们将两部分连接起来，并将权重量化为int8。该方法无需对齐学习和联合训练，可在一台笔记本电脑上运行。以int8存储时，Paradee大小为8.5 MB，在单个CPU线程上运行速度比实时快25倍，与教师模型相比的UTMOS得分为4.41（教师为4.52）。学生模型初始存在轻微嗡鸣声，我们将其归因于2至8 kHz之间的有声语音相位。在合成后应用相位锁定滤波器可有效消除该噪声，且无需额外训练或参数。代码、模型文件和音频样本见https://github.com/sahilmahendrakar/paradee。

summary: Background music that matches the mood of a text has been shown to make readers feel more immersed and improve their reading experience, motivating recommender systems that pair books with mood-matched music. In this direction, we present Sentiment Aware Generative Adversarial Network for Cross Domain Recommendation (SAGA-CDR), a two-phase cross-domain recommendation framework that personalizes music suggestions and emotionally aligns them with the book being read. In the first phase, transformer-based sentiment embeddings are constructed from user reviews and mapped across domains via a Conditional Generative Adversarial Network, whose mask-conditioned generator handles missing sentiment components and injects stochasticity for richer preference transfer. A compact rating neural network then fuses sentiment-specific interaction scores with a collaborative filtering prior to predict music ratings. In the second phase, large language models classify each book into a valence-arousal emotional quadrant, and candidate tracks are filtered to match that quadrant. Experiments on both the English Amazon and Chinese Douban datasets show that SAGA-CDR achieves the best rating prediction accuracy on Amazon (RMSE 0.98) and the lowest RMSE on Douban (0.91), with ranking performance competitive with the strongest sentiment-aware baseline, even in cross-lingual settings.
title: Reading the Mood: Emotion-Guided Book-to-Music Recommendation via CGANs and LLMs

title_translated: 感知情绪：通过CGANs和LLMs实现书与音乐的情绪引导推荐
summary_translated: 与文本情绪匹配的背景音乐已被证明能增强读者沉浸感并改善阅读体验，从而推动了将书籍与情绪匹配音乐配对的推荐系统研究。为此，我们提出Sentiment Aware Generative Adversarial Network for Cross Domain Recommendation（SAGA-CDR），一种两阶段跨域推荐框架，用于个性化音乐推荐并使其情感与正在阅读的书籍相一致。第一阶段，基于Transformer的情感嵌入从用户评论中构建，并通过条件生成对抗网络（CGAN）跨域映射，其掩码条件生成器处理缺失的情感成分并注入随机性以实现更丰富的偏好迁移。随后，一个紧凑的评分神经网络融合特定情感的交互得分与协同过滤先验，预测音乐评分。第二阶段，大语言模型将每本书分类到一个效价-唤醒情绪象限，候选曲目则根据该象限进行筛选。在英文Amazon和中文豆瓣数据集上的实验表明，SAGA-CDR在Amazon上实现了最佳评分预测准确率（RMSE 0.98），在豆瓣上达到最低RMSE（0.91），排名性能与最强的情感感知基线相当，即使在跨语言场景下也表现良好。

summary: Clinical questions often depend on linking a patient's multimodal evidence to external biomedical knowledge, yet existing predictive systems rarely represent such links explicitly, so they can neither be traced to their evidence sources nor removed to measure their contributions. We present MM-KG (Multimodal Knowledge Graph), which represents heterogeneous, multimodal patient observations and biomedical concepts as separate layers in one typed graph, joined by explicit alignment edges. First, modality-specific harmonizers convert EHR text, imaging, genomic, and biospecimen data into typed observations mapped to UMLS concepts, which a route-prioritized aligner links to a biomedical knowledge graph. Query-conditioned retrieval then selects a compact subgraph for downstream use by a large language model or a graph neural network. We build MM-KGs for MIMIC-IV and ADNI, and evaluate them with a 2x2 design that separates patient evidence, biomedical knowledge, and their interaction. On questions that require both sources, neither source alone performs far above chance, whereas their combination yields a drug-controlled AUROC interaction of +0.194 on MIMIC and +0.299 on ADNI. On held-out five-candidate ranking, MM-KG outperforms MindMap by +0.131 Hits@1 and leads an adapted GraphCare on the items that require consulting the patient, and deleting the single answer-bearing relation from the retrieved packet returns Hits@1 to the no-knowledge baseline. Finally, query-conditioned retrieval reaches 0.731 AUROC with 6.8x less context than the strongest generic policy, whereas static knowledge graph context gives no consistent gain on ordinary outcome prediction. Knowledge graphs thus benefit clinical LLMs not as background context but as explicit links between multimodal patient evidence and the relation a question requires, and MM-KG makes these links retrievable, traceable, and testable.
title: Aligning Multimodal Patient Evidence with Biomedical Knowledge Graphs for Clinical LLMs
title_translated: 对齐多模态患者证据与生物医学知识图谱以支持临床大语言模型
summary_translated: 临床问题通常依赖于将患者的多模态证据与外部生物医学知识相链接，但现有预测系统很少显式表示此类链接，因此无法追溯其证据来源，也无法通过移除来衡量其贡献。我们提出MM-KG（多模态知识图谱），将异构的多模态患者观察与生物医学概念作为单一类型图中的独立层表示，并通过显式的对齐边连接。首先，特定模态的调和器将电子健康记录文本、影像、基因组和生物样本数据转化为映射到UMLS概念的类型化观察；随后，路径优先对齐器将这些观察与生物医学知识图谱连接。查询条件检索随后选择一个紧凑子图，供大语言模型或图神经网络下游使用。我们在MIMIC-IV和ADNI数据集上构建了MM-KGs，并采用2×2实验设计，分离患者证据、生物医学知识及其交互作用。对于需要同时使用两种来源的问题，单独使用任一来源的表现远高于随机水平，而两者结合在MIMIC上产生+0.194的药物控制AUROC交互增益，在ADNI上达+0.299。在五候选项排序任务中，MM-KG在Hits@1上优于MindMap +0.131，且在需参考患者信息的任务中领先经适配的GraphCare；若删除检索包中唯一承载答案的关系，Hits@1将回落至无知识基线水平。查询条件检索在仅需6.8倍较少上下文的情况下达到0.731 AUROC，而静态知识图谱上下文在普通结果预测上未带来一致提升。因此，知识图谱并非作为背景上下文，而是作为多模态患者证据与问题所需关系之间的显式链接，而MM-KG使这些链接可检索、可追溯、可测试。

summary: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) routers typically apply softmax to the router scores and keep the top-K experts, making every token use exactly K experts. Sparsity-inducing probability maps such as sparsemax, alpha-entmax and normmax can adaptively assign exact zeros to selected experts, and therefore appear to offer token-dependent expert participation, even when using the same top-K machinery. In this work, we study whether and how this sparsity survives training. We train matched 300M and 1B top-2 MoE language models with softmax, 1.5-entmax, sparsemax and 2-normmax, and find that the maps behave very differently once trained: at 1B, entmax discards 30% less probability mass than softmax while almost never dropping a selected expert, sparsemax retains the most mass, and normmax routes 21% of tokens to a single expert. These outcomes are not properties of the maps alone. Each map drops a selected expert only when the gap between the two largest scores reaches a fixed threshold, and the trained routers differ in the score distribution they learn: the entmax router learns scores with roughly half the spread of softmax's, which keeps its top-2 gaps below its threshold, while sparsemax and normmax, which share the same threshold, learn different gap distributions and hence different participation. Routers thus co-adapt their scores to the map, and a map's capacity to produce zeros does not by itself determine expert participation. While none of the sparse maps improves validation loss over softmax, they make the trained models far less sensitive to selecting more experts at inference: sparsemax trained with K=2 loses 0.02 nats when run with K=8, where softmax loses 0.58. Our results indicate that adaptive MoE routing has to be designed around the joint behavior of the probability map and the learned scores, rather than around the map alone.
title: How Sparse Probability Maps Shape Mixture-of-Experts Routing
