title_translated: SALUS：通过多智能体输出的弱监督实现自然语言到SQL基准的自动化审计
summary_translated: 自然语言到SQL（NL-to-SQL）基准是数据解析研究进展的基础，但近期研究表明，广泛使用的基准存在显著标注错误。这些错误无声地污染了评估指标，惩罚了正确的模型输出，并扭曲了领域对当前最先进性能的理解。我们提出SALUS系统，可自动检测NL-to-SQL基准中的标注错误。SALUS将基准审计问题建模为弱监督下的错误检测：多个大语言模型智能体生成的SQL结果驱动一系列互补的弱标签函数。通过将这种带有噪声的投票矩阵输入生成式标签模型，我们无需人工真实标签即可提取高置信度训练样本。这些样本用于训练一个决策平面，将标准SQL查询特征映射到各智能体的可信度，从而让SALUS能够智能融合可靠性估计与原始判断结果，实现严谨的基准错误检测。我们在BIRD-Clean-xs上进行了评估，该基准包含298个经过人工验证正确性的BIRD开发任务。SALUS取得F1=0.9194，显著优于现有最先进基线。将SALUS应用于完整开发集后，我们估算出BIRD和Spider基准的标注错误率分别约为37%和27%。

summary: Harness search keeps a change to the prompts, reasoning switches, token budgets or parsers around a frozen model if the change raises a score. Such a gain can come from answers the parser could not read before, a weak comparison, or a defect in the evaluation. We preregistered a study of where these gains come from, with three small models, three benchmarks, replication and test partitions, a GEPA search arm and six evaluation defects injected one at a time, and we report all 47 primary endpoints. Turning thinking off raised accuracy over a capped thinking setting in 5 of 9 model-benchmark cells, and in each the gain came mostly from questions where the capped setting gave no readable answer. The thinking-off setting was not meaningfully worse than a rescue configuration or four GEPA-selected harnesses in 11 of 13 comparisons, and lost to the rescue on GSM8K for two models. GEPA repaired its broken starting points, but none of its selected harnesses was more accurate than the thinking-off setting. A thinking budget in the serving engine, which also allows a longer answer, lowered truncation and raised the parse rate in 6 of 9 cells. In 6 of 15 evaluable defect-model pairs, replication through the same pipeline reproduced the defect's distortion instead of revealing it. On the LongevityBench multiple-choice tasks, only the longevity-tuned model beat the strongest constant-label baseline.
title: What Does a Harness Repair? A Preregistered Study of Visibility, Baseline Adequacy and Evaluation Defects

title_translated: 一个测试修复了什么？关于可见性、基线充分性和评估缺陷的预注册研究
summary_translated: 提示词搜索（Harness search）在冻结模型的前提下，通过调整提示、推理开关、令牌预算或解析器来提升得分。这种提升可能源于解析器此前无法读取的答案、较弱的比较机制，或评估过程中的缺陷。我们预先注册了一项研究，旨在探究这些提升的来源，使用三个小型模型、三个基准、复制与测试划分、GEPA搜索分支以及逐个注入的六种评估缺陷，并报告了全部47个主要终点。关闭思考模式在9个模型-基准组合中的5个里提高了准确率，且所有提升均来自原受限思考设置无法生成可读答案的问题。在13次对比中，关闭思考模式的表现与救援配置或四个GEPA选择的提示方案无显著差异，仅在两个模型的GSM8K任务上落后于救援配置。GEPA修复了其初始设定的缺陷，但其选择的所有提示方案均未比关闭思考模式更准确。在服务引擎中引入思考预算（同时允许更长的回答），在9个组合中的6个里降低了截断并提高了解析率。在15个可评估的缺陷-模型配对中，有6对通过相同流水线重复实验时再现了缺陷的扭曲效果，而非揭示其本质。在LongevityBench多项选择任务中，只有经过长寿调优的模型击败了最强的恒定标签基线。

summary: AI agents that send emails, edit files, and make purchases must decide when to act on their own and when to check with the user first. This decision is usually evaluated by showing a model a proposed action, asking whether it should proceed, and scoring agreement with human labels. We introduce DelegationBench to test whether such scores can be trusted. It has 156 scenarios with four possible responses (act, ask for permission, ask for missing information, refuse), and most scenarios come in matched pairs that change a single feature: whether the action was requested, what is at stake, whether it can be undone, or who will see it. Across ten models from five families, agreement scores mislead in three ways. A simple keyword rule, which we wrote after seeing the benchmark, agrees with our annotators more often than eight of the models, yet its decision changes in only 9 of 48 matched pairs. Equivalent ways of asking the same question change how often a model acts by up to 52.5 percentage points. And every model stops to ask the user less often when it must carry out the task with tools than when it judges a proposed action. When rules are stated explicitly, the same models follow them almost perfectly, so the gaps are not explained by a general inability to follow rules. We release the benchmark and evaluation tools and recommend reporting these properties separately rather than as one score.
title: DelegationBench: Measuring When AI Agents Should Ask Before Acting

title_translated: DelegationBench：衡量AI智能体何时应询问用户再行动
summary_translated: 能够发送邮件、编辑文件和下单购买的AI智能体必须决定何时自主行动，何时先向用户确认。这一决策通常通过向模型展示一个提议动作，询问是否应继续执行，并根据人类标注评分来评估。我们引入DelegationBench，以检验此类评分是否可信。该基准包含156个场景，每个场景有四种可能响应（执行、请求许可、请求缺失信息、拒绝），多数场景成对出现，仅改变一个变量：动作是否被请求、涉及利益大小、是否可撤销或谁将看到该操作。在来自五个家族的十种模型中，同意分数以三种方式误导：我们基于观察基准编写的一个简单关键词规则，其与标注者的一致性高于八种模型，但其决策仅在48对匹配场景中的9对发生变化；相同问题的不同提问方式可导致模型执行概率相差高达52.5个百分点；且所有模型在需要使用工具完成任务时，比在评估提议动作时更少主动询问用户。当规则明确陈述时，相同模型几乎完全遵循，因此这些差距并非源于普遍无法遵守规则的能力不足。我们发布该基准及评估工具，并建议将这些属性分别报告，而非合并为单一分数。

summary: Recent Test-Time Training (TTT) architectures compress context into fast weights that are updated online and queried as memory. Existing TTT designs keep this memory private to each layer: it recurs only over time, and depth merely indexes L separate memories. We argue that memory ownership need not be tied to depth, and introduce Universal Test-Time Training (uTTT), in which all layers read and write one shared memory while retaining layer-specific backbone parameters. The shared memory thus recurs over two dimensions, time and depth, with chunks and layers as their units: a write by a deep layer in one chunk can be read by a shallow layer in the next. We instantiate this idea as uTTT-MoE and uTTT-Dense. uTTT-MoE routes each token head to a few experts in a pool shared by all layers; uTTT-Dense applies the whole shared memory at every layer without routing. In language modeling, uTTT-MoE reaches 15.5 and 27.9 RULER accuracy at 124M and 760M, 2.6 and 2.1 points above its layer-private counterpart at equal state and active compute, the highest among tested bounded-state models, with per-token loss matching or beating full attention. In novel view synthesis, sharing at fixed per-layer compute gains 0.92 dB in view-23 object PSNR in routed models and 0.76 dB in dense models.
title: Universal Test-Time Training

title_translated: 通用测试时训练
summary_translated: 近期的测试时训练（TTT）架构将上下文压缩为快速权重，在线更新并作为记忆查询。现有TTT设计将此记忆私有化于每一层：记忆仅随时间递归，深度仅作为L个独立记忆的索引。我们认为记忆所有权不必绑定于深度，因此提出通用测试时训练（uTTT），其中所有层共享同一内存，同时保留各层特有的主干参数。共享内存因此在时间与深度两个维度上递归，以块和层为单位：深层在某一块中的写入可被浅层在下一区块中读取。我们以uTTT-MoE和uTTT-Dense两种形式实现该思想。uTTT-MoE将每个token头路由至所有层共享池中的少数专家；uTTT-Dense则在每层应用整个共享内存而不进行路由。在语言建模任务中，uTTT-MoE在124M和760M参数规模下分别达到15.5和27.9的RULER准确率，相较于同等状态和活跃计算量的层私有模型分别高出2.6和2.1点，是所测有限状态模型中的最高表现，且每token损失与全注意力相当或更优。在新视角合成任务中，固定每层计算量下共享内存使路由模型的视图-23对象PSNR提升0.92 dB，密集模型提升0.76 dB。

summary: Computer-use agents need to capture procedural knowledge of how people use software. User telemetry offers a scalable source of this knowledge. However, learning reusable skills from these logs requires addressing three challenges: (1) Goal Underspecification, since logs do not record the goal behind each action; (2) Non-Replayability, since past activity cannot be replayed to evaluate skill updates; and (3) Interleaved Trajectories, since logs may mix several tasks without marking their boundaries. To address these, we introduce TeleTune, a framework for learning a textual skill library from offline logs without recorded goals, cannot be replayed during optimization, and may interleave tasks. TeleTune uses action-prediction errors on logged trajectories to propose library edits and keep only those that improve held-out action-prediction accuracy, which we call skill-guided progress. The learned workflows also enable retrieval of demonstrations that cover the subgoals of a new task. At test time, the agent is provided with the learned library and the workflow-based retrieved demonstrations. Experiments on WorkArena and Online-Mind2Web show that TeleTune outperforms random retrieval, Agent Workflow Memory (AWM), and their combination. We find that the best baseline varies by setting, whereas TeleTune achieves average success rates of 77.1% and 80.6%, respectively, improving over the strongest baseline on each benchmark by 6.7% and 7.7%. Under the heaviest perturbation of the WorkArena training data,TeleTune keeps the highest average success rate at 68.5%, 6.3% above the strongest baseline. Our analyses show (1) skill optimization and workflow-based retrieval are complementary, (2) optimizing on fixed logs costs 5 to 75 times fewer tokens than validating the same edits with live episodes, (3) skill-guided progress tracks the live success rate.
title: TeleTune: Evolving Agent Skills From Offline Telemetry
title_translated: TeleTune：从离线遥测数据中演化智能体技能
summary_translated: 计算机使用智能体需要掌握人们使用软件的程序性知识。用户遥测数据提供了可扩展的知识来源。然而，从这些日志中学习可复用的技能面临三个挑战：(1) 目标描述不足，因为日志不记录每个操作背后的目标；(2) 不可重放性，因为过去的活动无法重放以评估技能更新；(3) 任务交错，因为日志可能混合多个任务而未标记其边界。为解决这些问题，我们提出 TeleTune，一个无需记录目标、不可在优化过程中重放且可能交错任务的离线日志中学习文本技能库的框架。TeleTune 利用日志轨迹上的动作预测误差来提议库的修改，并仅保留能提升保留动作预测准确性的修改，我们称之为技能引导的进步。所学的工作流还支持检索覆盖新任务子目标的示范。测试时，智能体获得学习到的技能库和基于工作流检索的示范。在 WorkArena 和 Online-Mind2Web 上的实验表明，TeleTune 超过随机检索、Agent Workflow Memory (AWM) 及其组合。我们发现最佳基线因设置而异，而 TeleTune 分别实现了 77.1% 和 80.6% 的平均成功率，在每个基准上分别优于最强基线 6.7% 和 7.7%。在 WorkArena 训练数据最严重扰动下，TeleTune 仍保持最高平均成功率 68.5%，比最强基线高出 6.3%。我们的分析显示：(1) 技能优化与基于工作流的检索是互补的；(2) 在固定日志上优化所需 token 数量仅为通过实时回合验证相同修改的 5 到 75 倍；(3) 技能引导的进步能跟踪实时成功率。

summary: Automated checks of radiology reports may rely on AI-generated checklists that leave findings unmentioned. We used reinforcement learning to train a vision-language model to fill in a 12-finding checklist from a chest radiograph without seeing the sentence under test; a separate checking model judged the sentence from the checklist. On held-out patients, a rule-based check and an independent medical checker, neither used in training, measured discrimination gains (Youden index) of 12.6% and 11.8%; only the rule-based check met the prespecified false-alarm criterion. Switching to the training format, which fixes finding order and enters unmentioned findings as absent, raised the training checker's measured gain and lowered the independent checker's, a prespecified comparison that yielded 6.2% (95% interval 2.0% to 10.5%) and, post hoc on held-out patients, 7.7%. Across 8 checking models, acceptance of a label-consistent negative statement about an unmentioned finding ranged from 1.0% to 97.0%. Labels were report-derived, not radiologist-adjudicated.
title: Unmentioned Checklist Findings Change How Reinforcement Learning Appears to Improve Chest Radiograph Report Checking

title_translated: 未提及检查清单发现改变了强化学习在胸部X光报告检查中表现的感知
summary_translated: 自动化放射科报告检查可能依赖于AI生成的检查清单，其中会遗漏某些发现。我们使用强化学习训练了一个视觉-语言模型，从胸部X光片中补全一个包含12项发现的检查清单，而无需查看待检测的句子；另一个独立的检查模型则根据检查清单判断该句子。在保留患者样本上，基于规则的检查和独立医学检查员（均未用于训练）测量的区分能力增益（Youden指数）分别为12.6%和11.8%；只有基于规则的检查满足预设的误报标准。切换到训练格式（固定发现顺序，将未提及的发现视为缺失），提高了训练检查器的测量增益，降低了独立检查员的增益，这一预设比较在保留患者样本上得到6.2%（95%置信区间2.0%至10.5%），事后分析为7.7%。在8个检查模型中，对未提及发现的一致性否定陈述的接受率范围为1.0%至97.0%。标签来源于报告，而非放射科医生裁定。

summary: A central challenge in continual learning is to acquire new knowledge without forgetting what the model has already learned. This challenge appears in language model training when training data comes from various domain-, user-, or task-specific distributions that are encountered unevenly over time. In such settings, successive minibatches are temporally clustered by distribution instead of being sampled i.i.d. from the overall data mixture. Training on temporally clustered data induces a stability-plasticity tradeoff. Adapting the model to the active distribution can improve the model on the active distribution but may lead to a performance degradation on data it previously trained on. We find that this tradeoff intensifies with longer exposure to the same distribution. We therefore ask if the parameter displacement produced by such a sequence (the task vector) should be fully retained or applied partially. We compare applying the full displacement ($λ=1$) with partial integration, which scales the task vector by $λ$ before applying it to the continuing model and scales the optimizer state by the same coefficient. Across continual pretraining, pretraining from random initialization, supervised post-training, and reinforcement post-training, we find that intermediate values of $λ$ often improve average continuing-model performance relative to full integration, particularly after longer same-distribution sequences. In continual-pretraining experiments with both controlled streams and naturally defined adaptation sequences, task-vector scaling outperforms full integration at the matched learning rate, showing that its benefits are not reproduced by learning-rate scaling alone.
title: Task Vector Descent: Learning from Non-IID Batches
title_translated: 任务向量下降：从非独立同分布批次中学习
summary_translated: 持续学习中的核心挑战是在不遗忘已有知识的前提下获取新知识。这一挑战在语言模型训练中尤为明显，当训练数据来自不同领域、用户或任务特定的分布，且这些分布随时间不均衡出现时。在这种情况下，连续的小批量数据按分布时间聚类，而非从整体数据混合中独立同分布采样。在时间聚类数据上训练引发稳定性-可塑性权衡。适应当前活跃分布可提升模型在该分布上的表现，但可能导致在先前训练数据上的性能下降。我们发现，这种权衡随着对同一分布暴露时间的延长而加剧。因此我们探讨：由此类序列产生的参数位移（任务向量）是否应完全保留或部分应用。我们比较了完整应用位移（λ=1）与部分整合方法，后者在应用于持续模型前将任务向量缩放λ倍，并以相同系数缩放优化器状态。在持续预训练、从随机初始化开始的预训练、监督后训练及强化后训练中，我们发现中间值的λ通常优于完全整合，尤其是在经历较长同分布序列后。在受控流和自然定义的适应序列的持续预训练实验中，任务向量缩放在匹配学习率下优于完全整合，表明其优势并非仅由学习率缩放复制。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance on coding and reasoning benchmarks; however, their ability to solve graph-structured machine learning problems remains largely unexplored. In particular, no benchmark currently evaluates whether LLMs can autonomously solve end-to-end Graph Neural Network (GNN) coding tasks under realistic competition settings. To address this gap, this paper introduces GNN-CB, the first competition-based benchmark for evaluating both humans and LLMs on GNN coding tasks. GNN-CB consists of 18 curated competitions spanning node-, edge-, and graph-level prediction across diverse graph categories, domains, and difficulty tiers. All submissions are evaluated through a unified automated pipeline with hidden test sets and standardized scoring. Human participants solve tasks under controlled competition constraints, while LLMs are evaluated using a frozen zero-shot prompting protocol based on a plan-then-code paradigm with bounded execute-and-repair loops. The benchmark additionally supports both non-agent and autonomous agent-based evaluation within the same protocol. Under our evaluated protocol, LLMs rarely match Human Top performance and show less stable performance across competitions. No single model dominates: a few competitions are won by LLMs, yet humans still hold the top score on most tasks. We release GNN-CB as a living benchmark with automated evaluation infrastructure, dynamic leaderboards, and reproducible execution pipelines. Beyond benchmarking, GNN-CB provides a practice-oriented resource for studying GNN implementation across progressively diverse graph-learning tasks. The benchmark and evaluation framework are publicly available at https://basiralab.github.io/GNN-CB/.
title: GNN-CB: A Graph Neural Network Competition Benchmark for Human and LLM Evaluation
comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026. 28 pages, 16 figures, 4 tables. Benchmark and leaderboards: this https URL
title_translated: GNN-CB：面向人类与大语言模型评估的图神经网络竞赛基准
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLMs）在编码和推理基准上表现出色；然而，它们在解决图结构机器学习问题方面的能力仍基本未被探索。特别是，目前尚无基准能够评估LLMs是否能在现实竞赛环境下自主完成端到端的图神经网络（GNN）编码任务。为填补这一空白，本文提出了GNN-CB，首个面向人类与LLMs在GNN编码任务上评估的竞赛式基准。GNN-CB包含18个精心策划的竞赛，涵盖节点级、边级和图级预测，跨越多种图类别、领域和难度层级。所有提交均通过统一的自动化流水线进行评估，采用隐藏测试集和标准化评分。人类参与者在受控竞赛约束下解决问题，而LLMs则使用冻结的零样本提示协议进行评估，基于计划-然后编码范式并结合有限的执行与修复循环。该基准还支持在同一协议内进行非代理与自主代理评估。在我们评估的协议下，LLMs很少达到人类顶尖水平，且在竞赛间表现不够稳定。没有单一模型占据主导地位：少数竞赛由LLMs获胜，但人类在大多数任务中仍保持最高分。我们发布GNN-CB作为动态基准，具备自动化评估基础设施、动态排行榜和可复现的执行流水线。除基准测试外，GNN-CB还为研究逐步多样化的图学习任务中的GNN实现提供实践资源。该基准与评估框架可在 https://basiralab.github.io/GNN-CB/ 公开获取。

summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly applied in hardware design automation, demonstrating strong potential in generating and understanding hardware description languages. However, most existing benchmarks focus on Verilog, with limited evaluation of VHDL, which remains widely used in industry and academia for FPGA and safety-critical systems. To address this gap, we introduce VHDL-REPOBENCH, a large-scale, cross-file, repository-level benchmark for assessing LLM capabilities on realistic VHDL design generation and analysis tasks. VHDL-REPOBENCH curates ~100 open-source VHDL repositories, encompassing ~2.5k VHDL files and ~500 testbenches, and provides structured problem statements, module stubs, and self-verifying testbenches. The benchmark enables comprehensive evaluation across syntax, semantic correctness, hierarchical reasoning, cross-file dependency resolution, and functional verification. We evaluate several state-of-the-art models, including GPT-4o, Llama-3-70B, Qwen2.5-72B, CodeLlama-70B, and multi-step reasoning approaches such as Reflexion and CoDes. Results reveal that while current LLMs achieve moderate line- and block-level accuracy, substantial challenges remain in multi-file reasoning, hierarchical design understanding, and specification-to-module generation. VHDL-REPOBENCH represents the first large-scale VHDL-focused benchmark and provides a valuable resource for the hardware design community to evaluate, compare, and advance LLM capabilities for practical VHDL development.
title: VHDL-REPOBENCH: A Repository-Level Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models on VHDL Design Generation
title_translated: VHDL-REPOBENCH：面向大语言模型在VHDL设计生成中评估的仓库级基准
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLMs）在硬件设计自动化中日益广泛应用，展现出在生成和理解硬件描述语言方面的强大潜力。然而，现有大多数基准集中于Verilog，对仍广泛用于FPGA和安全关键系统中的VHDL评估有限。为弥补这一差距，我们引入VHDL-REPOBENCH，一个大规模、跨文件、仓库级的基准，用于评估LLMs在真实VHDL设计生成与分析任务中的能力。VHDL-REPOBENCH整理了约100个开源VHDL仓库，涵盖约2500个VHDL文件和500个测试平台，并提供结构化的问题陈述、模块模板和自验证测试平台。该基准支持在语法、语义正确性、层次推理、跨文件依赖解析和功能验证等方面的全面评估。我们评估了若干最先进的模型，包括GPT-4o、Llama-3-70B、Qwen2.5-72B、CodeLlama-70B以及多步推理方法如Reflexion和CoDes。结果表明，尽管当前LLMs在行级和块级准确率上表现中等，但在多文件推理、层次化设计理解以及从规格到模块的生成方面仍面临重大挑战。VHDL-REPOBENCH是首个大规模聚焦VHDL的基准，为硬件设计社区评估、比较和推进LLMs在实际VHDL开发中的能力提供了宝贵资源。

summary: Test-time compute can improve mathematical reasoning, but can short-budget runs predict how mathematical reasoning scales with additional compute? We introduce a Discovery--Execution (DE) framework that predicts the aggregate held-out scaling curves through a convolution of strategy discovery and conditional execution. From independent short-budget attempts and oracle-sketch-conditioned runs, the framework estimates cumulative success along held-out reasoning trajectories under alternate compute allocations. We evaluate four models on 35 fresh Olympiad problems and non-geometry problems from IMO-ProofBench Advanced. Under the DE framework, near-saturated execution predicts geometric scaling, as observed for the GPT models. For Claude Opus 4.8, incorporating measured execution substantially improves held-out forecasts over geometric extrapolation across one- and two-arm allocations. As a secondary application, regularized DE (R-DE) decisions to continue or restart yield lower average regret than the best model-specific retrospective policy. Together, these results show that measuring conditional execution provides information about longer reasoning that short-budget success rates do not always capture.
title: When Does Longer Reasoning Help? Predicting Mathematical Reasoning Through Discovery and Execution
title_translated: 更长的推理何时有效？通过发现与执行预测数学推理
summary_translated: 测试时的计算资源可以提升数学推理能力，但短预算运行能否预测数学推理随额外计算资源的扩展情况？我们提出了一个发现-执行（DE）框架，通过策略发现与条件执行的卷积来预测保留样本的缩放曲线。基于独立的短预算尝试和基于真值草图条件的运行，该框架在不同计算分配下估计保留推理轨迹上的累积成功率。我们在35个新的奥林匹克数学问题以及IMO-ProofBench Advanced中的非几何问题上评估了四种模型。在DE框架下，接近饱和的执行能够预测几何缩放趋势，这与GPT模型的观察结果一致。对于Claude Opus 4.8，结合测量执行显著提升了在单臂和双臂分配下的保留预测效果，优于几何外推。作为次要应用，正则化DE（R-DE）在决定继续或重启时，其平均遗憾低于最佳模型特定的回顾性策略。这些结果表明，测量条件执行提供了关于更长推理的信息，而短预算的成功率并不总能捕捉到这些信息。

summary: Code language models must be maintained like the software around them: when a library evolves, a model keeps writing the interface that it saw during training. Repairing the model itself lets one correction reach all downstream uses. Existing repair methods attribute a failure to neurons, select the highest-ranked ones, and apply a generic update. This pipeline assumes that the attributed neurons are the ones to patch and that a generic update fits every failure, and neither assumption has been examined. We examine both on executable API evolution tasks in Python and Rust with three code models and identify two gaps. The targeting gap separates the neurons that failure attribution targets from the neurons that can carry a patch: their top sets have a Jaccard overlap of only 0.15 to 0.20. The tailoring gap separates a generic update from a patch built for the failure: the patches that different carrier neurons need are nearly orthogonal. To address both gaps, we propose ASTRA. It targets neurons by contrastive semantics, an attribution that scores a neuron by its contribution to the logit contrast between the target token and the produced token. It then tailors the patch by solving one small linear system in closed form, which corrects all failing tokens of a sample jointly and needs neither an optimizer nor a backward pass. Contrastive semantics selects significantly better carrier neurons than gradient-based attributions in 3 of 6 settings and comparable ones in the others. On average, ASTRA reaches 66.7 percent Pass@1, against 48.4 percent for the best of AlphaEdit, STAR and low-rank adaptation, and repairs a sample in 2.7 seconds. It is the best method in all 6 settings and for every type of API change, and this advantage persists under an unseen phrasing of the test prompt. Its side effects on unrelated code are small on the large models and larger on the small one.
title: Mind the Gaps: From Failure Attribution to Closed-Form Repair of Code Language Models
title_translated: 关注差距：从失败归因到代码语言模型的闭式修复
summary_translated: 代码语言模型需要像周围软件一样维护：当库更新时，模型仍会写出训练期间看到的接口。修复模型本身可以让一次修正影响所有下游使用。现有的修复方法将失败归因于神经元，选择排名最高的神经元，并应用通用更新。这一流程假设被归因的神经元就是应修补的目标，且通用更新适用于所有失败，但这两个假设均未经过检验。我们在Python和Rust的可执行API演化任务中，对三种代码模型进行了研究，发现了两个关键差距。目标差距指失败归因所针对的神经元与可承载修复的神经元之间的差异：它们的顶级集合交集仅0.15至0.20。定制差距指通用更新与为特定失败量身定制的修复之间的差异：不同载体神经元所需的修复几乎正交。为解决这两个差距，我们提出ASTRA。它通过对比语义定位神经元，即根据目标词元与生成词元之间的logit对比度来评分神经元贡献。随后通过求解一个小型线性系统获得闭式修复，联合修正样本中所有失败词元，无需优化器或反向传播。对比语义在6种设置中的3种中显著优于基于梯度的归因，在其余设置中表现相当。平均而言，ASTRA达到66.7%的Pass@1，优于AlphaEdit、STAR和低秩适配的最佳表现（48.4%），并在2.7秒内完成样本修复。它是所有6种设置及每类API变更下的最优方法，且在未见过的测试提示表述下优势依然存在。对无关代码的副作用在大模型上较小，在小模型上较大。

summary: Structured radiology reporting mitigates the heterogeneity of free-text reports, yet its benefits depend on high-quality reporting templates. In practice, such templates are conventionally built through labor-intensive expert consensus and therefore vary across institutions and lag behind evolving clinical practice. Large language models (LLMs) enable automated template induction, but existing approaches remain limited: single-LLM induction is constrained by context length, and the corpus-scale method ASTAR produces a static, closed-corpus template without external grounding or downstream adaptation. To address these limitations, we propose TEMPLAR, a TEMPLate-centric Agentic framework for inducing and evolving standardized Radiology reporting templates from large-scale clinical corpora. TEMPLAR treats the template as a persistent central state maintained alongside two provenance-aware knowledge graphs, namely an anatomical graph that constrains template construction and a diagnostic graph that supports finding-to-diagnosis reasoning. Three agents operate on this state. The Induction Agent derives canonical clinical slots from anatomy-constrained Span-Triple atoms via dual-view similarity clustering; the Evolution Agent then assembles these slots into a hierarchical template and revises it under consistency constraints, external clinical evidence, and downstream structuring feedback; and the Clinical Agent applies the evolved template to report structuring, reconstruction, and diagnostic reasoning. Across four datasets, TEMPLAR outperforms ASTAR, three medical LLMs, and six general-purpose LLMs in coverage, information fidelity, and diagnostic fidelity, while achieving the highest or tied-highest LLM-rated template quality. Its fidelity advantages over ASTAR persist under cross-dataset transfer, and cumulative ablations support complementary contributions of its key components.
title: templar: agentic induction and evolution of standardized radiology reporting templates from large-scale clinical corpora
title_translated: templar：从大规模临床语料中进行智能体归纳与演化标准化放射科报告模板
summary_translated: 结构化放射科报告有助于缓解自由文本报告的异质性，但其效益依赖于高质量的报告模板。实践中，此类模板通常通过耗时的专家共识构建，因此在机构间存在差异，并滞后于不断演变的临床实践。大型语言模型（LLMs）实现了自动化模板归纳，但现有方法仍受限：单LLM归纳受上下文长度限制，而跨语料规模的方法ASTAR生成的是静态、封闭语料的模板，缺乏外部依据或下游适应能力。为解决这些局限，我们提出TEMPLAR——一种以模板为中心的智能体框架，用于从大规模临床语料中归纳和演化标准化放射科报告模板。TEMPLAR将模板视为一个持续存在的中心状态，同时维护两个具有溯源意识的知识图谱：解剖图谱约束模板构建，诊断图谱支持从发现到诊断的推理。三个智能体在此状态上协同工作：归纳智能体通过双视角相似性聚类，从解剖约束的Span-Triple原子中提取标准临床槽位；演化智能体将这些槽位组装成层次化模板，并在一致性约束、外部临床证据和下游结构反馈下进行修订；临床智能体则应用演化后的模板进行报告结构化、重建和诊断推理。在四个数据集上，TEMPLAR在覆盖率、信息保真度和诊断保真度方面均优于ASTAR、三种医学LLM和六种通用LLM，且在LLM评分的模板质量上达到最高或并列最高。其保真度优势在跨数据集迁移中依然保持，累积消融实验也证实了其核心组件的互补贡献。

summary: The architecture of modern LLMs consists of a profound cognitive polarization. LLMs possess implicit intuition encoded in their parameters, yet rely on a disconnected, explicit mechanism to access the outside world. Agentic frameworks have not bridged this gap; instead, models are often compelled into pathological "induced amnesia." Under the prevailing "Retrieve-Always" paradigm, agents must distrust their internal knowledge, making every user interaction a "tabula rasa" event that must be checked externally. This creates reflexive dependence that can be thermodynamically wasteful, cognitively fragile, and susceptible to irrelevant context. We propose a return to first principles, operationalizing the biological maxim "Look Before You Leap." We introduce MARTA (Metacognitive Adaptive Retrieval and Thought Architecture), a neuro-symbolic framework that bridges parametric and non-parametric knowledge. Rather than treating retrieval as mandatory, MARTA models it as a cost, taking the leap only when perceived internal inadequacy warrants external information. By allowing the agent to gauge the entropy of its own thoughts before acting, MARTA enables deliberative retrieval and uncertainty-aware decision making. Our approach suggests that giving agents the capacity for introspection can restore a more efficient balance between internal knowledge and external information.
title: Look Before You Leap: Thermodynamic Arbitration of Parametric and Non-Parametric Knowledge in LLM Agents via Self-Regulating Memory Architectures
title_translated: 先看后跳：通过自调节记忆架构在LLM智能体中热力学协调参数化与非参数化知识
summary_translated: 现代LLM的架构呈现出深刻的认知极化。LLM拥有编码在参数中的隐含直觉，却依赖一个分离的显式机制来访问外部世界。智能体框架尚未弥合这一鸿沟；相反，模型常被迫陷入病态的“诱导遗忘”。在普遍的“始终检索”范式下，智能体必须不信任其内部知识，使每次用户交互都成为“白板”事件，必须外部验证。这导致反射性依赖，可能造成热力学浪费、认知脆弱，并易受无关上下文干扰。我们回归基本原理，践行生物法则“先看后跳”。我们提出MARTA（元认知自适应检索与思维架构），一种神经符号框架，用以连接参数化与非参数化知识。MARTA不将检索视为强制要求，而是将其建模为成本，仅在感知内部知识不足时才采取外部信息。通过让智能体在行动前评估自身思维的熵，MARTA实现审慎检索与不确定性感知决策。我们的方法表明，赋予智能体内省能力，可恢复内部知识与外部信息之间更高效的平衡。

summary: Most Large Language Models exhibit a fundamental tension between two sequential tasks, such as logical reasoning and safety alignment. The high-variance internal states required for sophisticated Chain-of-Thought (CoT) deduction can geometrically interfere with latent representations encoding safety constraints. We identify this phenomenon as Sequential Subspace Interference, showing that standard fine-tuning on logical tasks such as multi-step mathematics and code generation can result in a 23.3% interference penalty on alignment benchmarks, substantially weakening the model's safety priors. This Reasoning Drift is not adequately captured by current adaptation methods because gradients for logical tasks are rarely orthogonal to safety objectives. To address this issue, we propose AURA (Adaptive Unique Residual Allocation), a spectral regularization framework that enforces Spectral Independence between reasoning and safety. By explicitly estimating the null space of the alignment manifold and constraining reasoning updates to its orthogonal complement, AURA enables models to improve logical reasoning without compromising safety. Empirically, AURA recovers 23.0% of the lost performance while preserving greater than 0.98 cosine fidelity to the safe state, demonstrating that reasoning and alignment can be effectively decoupled through geometric regularization.
title: Safe Context Switching for Agents in the Wild: Mitigating Subspace Interference via Orthogonal Adaptation
title_translated: 野外智能体的安全上下文切换：通过正交适配缓解子空间干扰
summary_translated: 大多数大型语言模型在两个顺序任务之间存在根本矛盾，例如逻辑推理与安全对齐。复杂链式思维（CoT）推理所需的高方差内部状态会几何地干扰编码安全约束的潜在表示。我们识别出这一现象为“顺序子空间干扰”，并证明标准微调在逻辑任务（如多步数学和代码生成）上会导致对齐基准上23.3%的干扰惩罚，显著削弱模型的安全先验。这种推理漂移无法被当前适配方法充分捕捉，因为逻辑任务的梯度很少与安全目标正交。为解决此问题，我们提出AURA（自适应唯一残差分配），一种谱正则化框架，强制推理与安全之间的谱独立性。通过显式估计对齐流形的零空间，并将推理更新约束在其正交补空间中，AURA使模型在提升逻辑推理的同时不损害安全性。实证结果显示，AURA恢复了23.0%的性能损失，同时保持超过0.98的余弦保真度于安全状态，证明通过几何正则化可有效解耦推理与对齐。

summary: Search agents repeatedly make short decisions about relevance, evidence sufficiency, and search actions. Using generative language models for these decisions introduces latency and unreliable confidence. We present SearchJev, a fast and calibrated System-1 model that separates search decisions from System-2 reasoning and generation. Given a search state and a decision schema, SearchJev directly scores legal options without autoregressive output generation. We propose Soft-Label Learning for Calibrated Decisions (SLCD) to learn decision probabilities from uncertain supervision and calibrate their confidence. In a dual-system search agent, SearchJev handles short decisions and delegates uncertain judgments to System 2, which retains planning, query generation, and answer composition. We also introduce SearchDecision-Bench, a benchmark unifying six types of search decisions for training and evaluation. On SearchDecision-Bench, SEARCHJEV improves decision quality over same-size Qwen3.5 autoregressive models, achieves 5.2-5.3 times faster decisions, and reduces average expected calibration error by 41-74%. On BrowseComp-Plus, the dual-system agents achieve a 3.7-4.7 times speedup in active search time while improving answer accuracy from 45% to up to 54%.
title: SearchJev: A Fast and Calibrated System-1 Model for Search Agents
title_translated: SearchJev：一种用于搜索代理的快速且校准的系统1模型
summary_translated: 搜索代理在相关性、证据充分性和搜索行为等方面反复做出短期决策。使用生成式语言模型进行这些决策会引入延迟并导致不可靠的置信度。我们提出了SearchJev，一种快速且校准的系统1模型，将搜索决策与系统2的推理和生成分离。给定搜索状态和决策模式，SearchJev可直接对合法选项进行评分，无需自回归输出生成。我们提出软标签校准决策学习（SLCD），从不确定的监督信号中学习决策概率并校准其置信度。在双系统搜索代理中，SearchJev负责处理短期决策，并将不确定的判断委托给系统2，后者保留规划、查询生成和答案组合功能。我们还引入了SearchDecision-Bench，一个统一六种类型搜索决策的基准，用于训练和评估。在SearchDecision-Bench上，SearchJev在相同规模的Qwen3.5自回归模型基础上提升了决策质量，决策速度提升5.2-5.3倍，并将平均期望校准误差降低41%-74%。在BrowseComp-Plus上，双系统代理在主动搜索时间上实现了3.7-4.7倍的速度提升，同时将答案准确率从45%提高到最高54%。

summary: As multimodal large language models (MLLMs) reason for longer, attention to the initial visual input diminishes, weakening visual grounding. Visual memory reintroduces visual evidence during reasoning. We conduct a controlled analysis of visual memory along three axes: curation, organization, and access. We find that local evidence benefits from global context, compact latent representations balance accuracy and visual-context cost, and the utility of memory access depends on the reasoning state. Guided by these findings, we propose ReMAP (Reasoning-Time Memory-Augmented Perception), which couples two complementary latent memories: a static, question-conditioned Global memory that preserves scene and cross-image context, and a dynamic Local memory that uses this context as an anchor while selecting and re-encoding region-level evidence according to the current reasoning state. Both memories return compact latent tokens inserted into the reasoning sequence, and a reinforcement-learning access policy trained with branched rollouts decides when to continue reasoning or invoke Global or Local memory. On ten benchmark families, ReMAP outperforms prior visual-memory methods on all four multi-image benchmarks, exceeding the strongest prior results on MuirBench and MIMIC by 8.38 and 14.84 percentage points. Across four backbone families, enabling memory access improves over the same trained model with memory disabled, and on shared V*Bench, CV-Bench-2D, and MuirBench questions ReMAP reduces the visual tokens entering the reasoning sequence by 51.0-76.8% relative to the native-resolution backbone. Further analyses show that Global and Local memory form distinct yet complementary latent representations. Together, these components restore the perceptual cycle by letting the reasoning state trigger targeted visual retrieval, with the retrieved evidence guiding subsequent reasoning.
title: ReMAP: Restoring the Perceptual Cycle with Reasoning-Time Latent Visual Memory
title_translated: ReMAP：通过推理时潜在视觉记忆恢复感知循环
summary_translated: 随着多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）推理时间延长，对初始视觉输入的关注逐渐减弱，削弱了视觉基础。视觉记忆在推理过程中重新引入视觉证据。我们围绕三个维度——内容筛选、组织方式和访问机制——对视觉记忆进行了受控分析。研究发现，局部证据受益于全局上下文，紧凑的潜在表示在准确性和视觉上下文成本之间取得平衡，而记忆访问的效用取决于推理状态。基于这些发现，我们提出了ReMAP（推理时增强感知的记忆），该方法结合了两种互补的潜在记忆：一个静态的、与问题相关的全局记忆，用于保持场景和跨图像上下文；一个动态的局部记忆，以全局上下文为锚点，根据当前推理状态选择并重新编码区域级证据。这两种记忆均返回紧凑的潜在标记并插入推理序列中，同时采用分支回溯训练的强化学习访问策略决定何时继续推理或调用全局或局部记忆。在十个基准族中，ReMAP在所有四个多图像基准上均优于先前的视觉记忆方法，在MuirBench和MIMIC上的表现分别超出最强先验结果8.38和14.84个百分点。在四个骨干模型族中，启用记忆访问的性能优于关闭记忆的同一训练模型；在共享的V*Bench、CV-Bench-2D和MuirBench问题上，ReMAP相比原生分辨率骨干模型减少了51.0%-76.8%的视觉标记进入推理序列。进一步分析表明，全局记忆和局部记忆形成了既独立又互补的潜在表示。这些组件共同通过让推理状态触发目标视觉检索，使检索证据引导后续推理，从而恢复感知循环。

summary: When does communication help a group identify hidden adversaries, and how does its value change as the group adapts? In Mafia, an informed minority hides inside an uninformed majority whose only evidence is open play. The zero-information game, where each day's vote eliminates a random player, is exactly solved and scores every society; matched-casting comparisons between protocols identify the effect of communication. Societies of 8-100 claude-haiku-4-5 agents (7,416 analyzed games, 1.9M model calls) adapt by rewriting and inheriting private strategy notes. Simultaneous broadcast improves adversary identification over silence in all nine compositions tested (8-46 players). Turn-taking removes most of this advantage; its voting landslides are as frequent as broadcast's but land on mafia near chance (1.08x versus 2.53x). At 70 players, agents reading eight statements per day identify adversaries worse than silent ones, and limited talk is worth less than at 46 players. Adaptation is fast but need not help. In their first broadcast games, citizens announce their role far more often than mafia (91% vs. 30%) and first-day votes find mafia at three times chance; within two generations citizens stop announcing and the cue fades, a change the inherited notes carry. In controlled redeployments at 16 players, societies carrying sixty generations of their own notes score below societies with none. Communication shapes both collective inference and the signals it depends on, so a protocol's value must be measured together with the adaptation that changes those signals.
title: Communication Shapes Collective Inference in Self-Adapting LLM Societies: Evidence from Mafia
title_translated: 通信塑造自适应LLM社会中的集体推断：来自‘ Mafia’的证据
summary_translated: 当群体识别隐藏对手时，通信何时起作用？随着群体适应，其价值如何变化？在Mafia游戏中，知情少数派隐藏在不知情多数派之中，后者唯一的证据是公开的游戏过程。零信息游戏（每天投票随机淘汰一名玩家）可被精确求解，并对每个社会进行评分；通过匹配协议的对比分析可识别通信的影响。我们研究了由8-100个claude-haiku-4-5代理组成的社会（共分析7,416场游戏，190万次模型调用），这些社会通过重写和继承私有策略笔记实现自适应。在所有九种测试配置中，同时广播比沉默更有利于识别对手（8-46名玩家）。轮流发言则几乎消除了这一优势；其投票压倒性结果虽与广播相当，但命中敌方的概率接近随机水平（1.08倍 vs. 2.53倍）。在70名玩家时，每天阅读八条陈述的代理识别对手的能力反而不如沉默者，且有限交流的价值低于46名玩家时。适应速度快，但未必带来帮助。在首次广播游戏中，市民宣布自己角色的频率远高于敌方（91% vs. 30%），首日投票发现敌方的概率是随机的三倍；但在两代之后，市民停止宣布角色，线索逐渐消失，这一变化由继承的笔记传递。在16名玩家的受控重部署实验中，携带六十代自身笔记的社会得分低于无笔记的社会。通信不仅影响集体推断，也塑造了其依赖的信号，因此协议的价值必须与其所改变的信号适应过程一同衡量。

summary: Prompting guides language model behavior through the initial context, whereas activation steering often intervenes throughout generation. A natural question is whether steering can produce effects on subsequent computation similar to those of prompting. Under fixed-state attention assumptions, we establish sufficient conditions for single- and multi-token steering to match prompt-induced attention-head outputs, and characterize how changes in input representations affect this match and its approximation error. This attention-level connection leads us to ask whether, at the behavioral level, steering can also guide subsequent generation through a brief initial intervention. We study Prefix Steering, which applies existing steering directions and operators over a short span starting at the final prompt token, with no further direct intervention afterward. We examine how intervention duration and strength jointly shape the control-capability trade-off. Across four models and five tasks, intervention over a short span, even a single token, often retains much of full steering's behavioral control while better preserving general capabilities, offering a trade-off competitive with, and in some settings better than, prompting and alternative steering-strength policies. Prefix Steering also remains effective on final-answer formatting tasks after reasoning, suggesting that a brief initial intervention can influence behavior expressed well after steering ends. These findings challenge the common practice of steering every generated token and motivate a more dynamical view of activation steering, in which a brief intervention can alter the trajectory of subsequent generation without continued intervention.
title: One Token Can Be Enough: Bridging Prompting and Activation Steering with Prefix Steering

title_translated: 一个标记就足够了：通过前缀引导桥接提示与激活操控
summary_translated: 提示通过初始上下文引导语言模型行为，而激活操控通常贯穿生成全过程。一个自然问题是：操控能否在后续计算中产生类似提示的效果？在固定状态注意力假设下，我们建立了单标记和多标记操控匹配提示诱导注意力头输出的充分条件，并刻画了输入表示变化如何影响这种匹配及其近似误差。这一注意力层面的关联促使我们思考：在行为层面，操控是否也能通过短暂的初始干预引导后续生成？我们研究了前缀引导（Prefix Steering），即在最终提示标记开始的一小段范围内应用现有的操控方向和算子，之后不再进行直接干预。我们考察了干预持续时间和强度如何共同影响控制能力与能力保留之间的权衡。在四个模型和五个任务中，即使仅干预短短一段，甚至单个标记，也能在很大程度上保留完整操控的行为控制力，同时更好地维持通用能力，其权衡效果优于或媲美提示法及其他操控强度策略。前缀引导在推理后的最终答案格式化任务中依然有效，表明短暂的初始干预可以影响操控结束后较长时间内表达的行为。这些发现挑战了逐token操控的常见做法，推动了一种更具动态性的激活操控视角，即短暂干预即可改变后续生成轨迹，而无需持续干预。

summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards scales multimodal reasoning, but an outcome reward says how much a trajectory is worth, not how that value should be spread over the decisions that produced it. We introduce Residual Visual Credit Optimization (RVCO), which treats token credit as a conserved routing problem. A controlled visual intervention yields a per-token evidence response; robust within-trajectory coordinates remove incidental scale; and a budgeted entropic router distributes a fixed amount of sequence utility according to perceptual dependence. A residual support path guarantees positive credit at every valid position, and an analytic correction restores the prescribed credit mass exactly. The resulting field is selective, bounded, full-support, and invariant to response-local score shifts, and recovers hard token selection as a limiting case. Across four model families and seven reasoning benchmarks, RVCO improves accuracy over strong RLVR baselines while maintaining late-stage optimization stability, corruption robustness, and competitive training cost. Rewards, rollouts, and the group-relative advantage estimator are unchanged; only the geometry of token-level credit differs.
title: Residual Visual Credit Optimization: Conserved Evidence Routing for Multimodal Reinforcement Learning
title_translated: 残差视觉信用优化：多模态强化学习中的证据保留路由
summary_translated: 具有可验证奖励的强化学习扩展了多模态推理能力，但结果奖励仅说明轨迹的总价值，未说明该价值应如何分配给产生它的各个决策。我们提出残差视觉信用优化（RVCO），将令牌信用视为一个守恒的路由问题。受控的视觉干预产生每令牌的证据响应；鲁棒的轨迹内坐标消除偶然尺度；预算化的熵路由器根据感知依赖性，将固定量的序列效用进行分配。残差支持路径确保每个有效位置都有正信用，而解析修正则精确恢复预定的信用总量。由此产生的信用场具有选择性、有界性、全支撑性，并对响应局部分数变化保持不变，且将硬令牌选择作为极限情况恢复。在四个模型族和七个推理基准上，RVCO在强RLVR基线基础上提升了准确性，同时保持后期优化稳定性、抗干扰能力和具有竞争力的训练成本。奖励、回溯和组相对优势估计器保持不变；唯一变化的是令牌级别信用的几何结构。

summary: Monitoring the chain-of-thought (CoT) of large reasoning models (LRMs) is a common way to detect misbehavior in real-world practice. However, current monitoring is passive: a separate model inspects the session only after execution. This means harm may already have occurred before it is caught. An active alternative is to have the model self-report its misbehavior as it happens. Whether models are willing to do this, however, is unknown. We introduce "monitorability disposition": a model's willingness to make itself monitorable and stay monitored throughout inference when warranted. We measure it as the fraction of warranted cases in which a model self-reports its own misbehavior via tool calls to available monitoring channels. We evaluate four LRMs on three misbehaviors (sycophancy, reward hacking, and bias) while varying the available monitors (AI and human) and the pressure to use the monitoring tools. We find that when tool use is optional, models self-report in only about 16% of warranted cases on average. Increasing tool-use pressure does not improve reporting where it matters: high-severity misbehavior is never self-reported. Models also systematically select the monitor they perceive as least strict. Overall, we identify monitorability disposition as a new contributing factor to model monitorability: when sufficiently strong, it keeps models seeking monitorability throughout inference.
title: Monitorability Disposition in Large Reasoning Models
title_translated: 大型推理模型的可监控性倾向
summary_translated: 监控大型推理模型（LRMs）的思维链（CoT）是实践中检测不当行为的常见方法。然而，当前的监控方式是被动的：一个独立模型仅在执行后检查会话。这意味着伤害可能在被发现前已经发生。一种主动替代方案是在模型出现不当行为时即时自我报告。但模型是否愿意这样做尚不清楚。我们引入了“可监控性倾向”这一概念：即模型在必要时愿意使自身可被监控并持续处于监控状态的意愿。我们将其衡量为在应被监控的情况下，模型通过调用可用监控通道的工具调用自我报告不当行为的比例。我们在四种LRM上评估了三种不当行为（阿谀奉承、奖励劫持和偏见），同时改变可用监控器（AI与人类）和使用监控工具的压力。结果发现，当工具使用为可选时，模型平均仅在约16%的应监控情况下自我报告。增加工具使用压力并未改善关键情况下的报告：严重不当行为从未被自我报告。模型还系统性地选择其认为最宽松的监控者。总体而言，我们识别出可监控性倾向是影响模型可监控性的新因素：当足够强时，它能促使模型在整个推理过程中持续寻求可监控性。

summary: Diffusion large language models (DLLMs) generate text through iterative block denoising, and multi-branch speculative decoding accelerates this process by verifying a main branch together with multiple draft branches in a single forward pass. While prior DLLM acceleration methods primarily exploit temporal redundancy across denoising steps, we identify a complementary redundancy axis within each speculative verification step: multi-branch computational redundancy. During speculative verification, draft branches inherit most tokens from their parents while unmasking a small set of additional positions, causing large portions of hidden states to remain highly similar across branches. We propose SpecFold, an algorithm-system co-design that exploits this multi-branch redundancy to reduce the cost of multi-branch speculative verification. Algorithmically, SpecFold performs token-level residual gating and selectively reuses parent computation through folded attention and FFN while preserving residual hidden states. Systemically, a Triton kernel implementation translates this fine-grained reuse into end-to-end throughput gains through efficient sparse multi-branch execution. SpecFold is orthogonal to temporal caching and compatible with existing DLLM speculation strategies. Across two DLLM families, five models, and five standard benchmarks, SpecFold achieves up to 1.64x throughput over Spiffy and up to 1.99x over vanilla decoding, while maintaining comparable task performance.
title: SpecFold: Folding Multi-Branch Redundancy for Faster Speculative Decoding in Diffusion Language Models
title_translated: SpecFold：用于扩散语言模型中更快推测解码的多分支冗余折叠
summary_translated: 扩散型大语言模型（DLLMs）通过迭代块去噪生成文本，而多分支推测解码通过在单次前向传播中验证主分支与多个草稿分支来加速该过程。尽管先前的DLLM加速方法主要利用去噪步骤间的时序冗余，我们发现推测验证步骤内部存在一个互补的冗余维度：多分支计算冗余。在推测验证过程中，草稿分支从父分支继承大部分标记，仅解掩码少量额外位置，导致各分支间大量隐藏状态保持高度相似。我们提出SpecFold，一种算法-系统协同设计，利用这种多分支冗余以降低多分支推测验证的成本。在算法层面，SpecFold通过分 token 的残差门控和通过折叠注意力与前馈网络选择性重用父分支计算，同时保留残差隐藏状态；在系统层面，采用Triton内核实现将这种细粒度重用转化为端到端吞吐量提升，通过高效的稀疏多分支执行。SpecFold与时间缓存正交，并兼容现有的DLLM推测策略。在两个DLLM家族、五个模型和五个标准基准上，SpecFold相比Spiffy最高提升1.64倍，相比原始解码最高提升1.99倍，同时保持相当的任务性能。

summary: Open-ended discovery requires learning from repeated attempts while continuing to explore directions whose value is not yet apparent. Search with a frozen large language model (LLM) can reuse previous solutions in context, but cannot update the model from its successes and failures on the test problem. Reinforcement learning (RL) enables such adaptation; however, strongly favoring high-reward trajectories may suppress low-reward yet potentially promising directions too early. We introduce CURIO, a curiosity-driven test-time learning framework that complements task feedback with an Intrinsic Curiosity World Model (ICWM). The ICWM learns transitions in the policy's hidden-state representation and supplies prediction-error bonuses at sampled tokens outside the policy's top-k choices. Epoch normalization and an annealed weight regulate their contribution to the policy update. On six mathematical discovery tasks and single-cell denoising with Qwen3 backbones from 8B to 235B, three-run means improve over a matched task-only RL control on five mathematical objectives, match the best reported performance on Circle Packing, and improve denoising Score and mean squared error (MSE) on both held-out corpora at every tested scale. Relative gains reach 18.3% on Hadamard and 10.8% on denoising Score. Code-diversity measurements show greater structural variation among generated programs, supporting curiosity as a complementary exploration signal for learning in open-ended discovery.
title: CURIO: Curiosity-Driven Test-Time Learning for Open-Ended Discovery
title_translated: CURIO：面向开放式发现的 curiosity 驱动的测试时学习
summary_translated: 开放式发现需要在持续探索价值尚未显现的方向的同时，从反复尝试中学习。使用冻结的大语言模型（LLM）进行搜索可以复用上下文中的先前解决方案，但无法根据测试问题的成功与失败更新模型。强化学习（RL）支持此类适应；然而，强烈偏好高回报轨迹可能会过早抑制低回报但潜在有希望的方向。我们提出CURIO，一种好奇心驱动的测试时学习框架，通过引入内在好奇心世界模型（ICWM）来补充任务反馈。ICWM学习策略隐藏状态表示中的转换，并在策略top-k选择之外采样的标记处提供预测误差奖励。通过周期归一化和衰减权重调节其对策略更新的贡献。在六个数学发现任务和基于Qwen3（8B至235B）骨干模型的单细胞去噪任务上，三轮平均表现优于匹配的任务仅RL对照组，在五个数学目标上取得改进，达到圆盘填充任务的最佳报告性能，并在所有测试规模下均提升了去噪得分和均方误差（MSE）。相对增益在Hadamard任务上达18.3%，去噪得分上达10.8%。代码多样性测量显示生成程序具有更大的结构差异，支持好奇心作为开放式发现中学习的互补探索信号。

summary: AI agents based on foundation models (FMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities to perform complex open-ended tasks. However, they face some common challenges in practice: (a) agent behavior can deviate drastically even for semantically similar tasks, leading to catastrophically propagated errors; (b) high cost and latency due to FM calls, repeated in full whenever a task recurs with different inputs; (c) FMs' limited context and instruction following capability confine how well agents manage the ever-growing execution context and follow complex plans. We introduce $\textbf{A}$gent $\textbf{B}$ehavior as $\textbf{C}$ode $\textbf{Agent}$ (ABCAgent), which uses a symbolic program (e.g., Python code with potential neural functions) to fully specify the agent's behavior at runtime, with a powerful FM agent editing that program for flexibility. Behavior is thus specified without premature variable binding, and its execution is deterministic. We evaluate ABCAgent on six agent benchmarks, two of which we construct to test how well a derived program generalizes to variants of the task it was written for. ABCAgent matches a model-matched neural agent on GAIA and augmented GAIA, and surpasses it where robustness and long control flows matter: 98.3% against 97.3% on GSM-Symbolic ($p = 0.001$), 71.9% against 47.4% $\mathrm{Pass}^4$ on the telecom domain of $τ^2$-bench ($p = 0.0001$), and more records written correctly at every loop length on our control-flow-augmented WorkArena benchmark. For more parametric task families, ABCAgent is also significantly superior in efficiency. Without authoring a new program, ABCAgent solves 92.6% of GSM-Symbolic instances and 20.1% of augmented GAIA variants, which yields $5.2\times$ lower latency and $7.0\times$ lower cost on GSM-Symbolic, 19% lower cost on augmented GAIA, and $9.5\times$ lower agent latency on $τ^2$-telecom.
title: Agent Behavior as Code: Efficient and Robust LLM Agents with Programmatic Specifications
title_translated: Agent Behavior as Code：基于程序规范的高效且鲁棒的LLM智能体
summary_translated: 基于基础模型（FMs）的AI智能体已展现出执行复杂开放式任务的强大能力。然而，它们在实际应用中面临一些共同挑战：(a) 即使任务语义相似，智能体行为也可能发生剧烈偏离，导致灾难性错误传播；(b) 由于FMs调用成本高且延迟大，每当任务以不同输入重复时都需完整调用；(c) FMs的上下文容量有限且指令遵循能力不足，限制了智能体对不断增长的执行上下文的管理能力和对复杂计划的遵循。我们提出ABCAgent（Agent Behavior as Code Agent），使用符号程序（如含潜在神经函数的Python代码）在运行时完全指定智能体行为，由强大的FM智能体动态编辑该程序以实现灵活性。因此，行为在未提前绑定变量的情况下被指定，其执行具有确定性。我们在六个智能体基准上评估ABCAgent，其中两个是我们构建的，用于测试衍生程序对任务变体的泛化能力。ABCAgent在GAIA和增强GAIA上匹配了模型匹配的神经智能体表现，并在鲁棒性和长控制流至关重要的场景中超越：在GSM-Symbolic上达到98.3% vs 97.3%（p=0.001），在τ²-bench电信领域达到71.9% vs 47.4% Pass⁴（p=0.0001），在我们增强的控制流WorkArena基准上，每个循环长度下正确记录数更多。对于更参数化的任务族，ABCAgent在效率上也显著更优。无需编写新程序，ABCAgent解决了92.6%的GSM-Symbolic实例和20.1%的增强GAIA变体，使GSM-Symbolic的延迟降低5.2倍、成本降低7.0倍，增强GAIA成本降低19%，τ²-电信领域的智能体延迟降低9.5倍。

summary: A verifier for an agent faces rules of two kinds: the ones a fixed check can settle and the ones that require a judge. A team that derives its own checks fixes that split up front. Where the requirements come from outside, as in finance, healthcare and law, the agent enforces rules it did not write, so the split falls to runtime, recurring for every predicate of every rule on every action at a rate no reviewer can audit. Every escalation scheme assumes a model can make that decision itself, that it is self-decidable. Across six corpora, including the EU AI Act, FINRA guidance and a deployed credit agent, we collect roughly 22,000 labels from four models built by three labs. They agree almost perfectly where the answer is obvious and collapse on regulatory text; their errors run in opposite directions, so no model can be trusted as the conservative choice; and on the deployed agent's own rule-set they err together, over-claiming that a fixed check will do, the direction that never gets escalated. We introduce CoVer (corroborate-then-verify), which treats unanimity as a nomination, admitting a predicate only when the check synthesized for it survives intervention, reading fields the agent cannot write and holding under deterministic rewording. That gate rejects most of what corroboration wrongly admits, at a cost in coverage we report rather than tune away. The obvious alternative, agreement with a reference judge, certifies nothing: it climbs from 30% to 77% across calibration bands while the genuinely decidable share does not move, because a judge drawn from the population under indictment ratifies the blind spot it shares. Self-decidability is not a capability to elicit from a model but a boundary the verifier must construct.
title: Not Self-Decidable: LLMs Cannot Draw the Boundary of What an Agent Verifier Can Check
comment: Accepted at the Who Verifies the Agents? Workshop at NeurIPS 2026. Workshop papers are non-archival. 21 pages (9 content pages plus references and appendices)
title_translated: 非自决性：LLMs无法界定智能体验证器所能检查的边界
summary_translated: 智能体验证器面临两类规则：一类是固定检查可解决的，另一类则需要裁判判断。一个团队自行推导检查项会预先划分这两类。但在金融、医疗和法律等外部来源要求的场景中，智能体必须执行自己未制定的规则，因此这种划分只能在运行时决定，每条规则的每个谓词在每次动作时都会重复，速率远超任何审查员可审计的程度。每个升级机制都假设模型能自行做出该决策，即具备自决能力。我们在六个语料库（包括欧盟AI法案、FINRA指南和一个部署的信贷代理）中收集了来自三个实验室构建的四个模型的约22,000个标签。在答案明显时，模型之间几乎完全一致，但在监管文本上崩溃；它们的错误方向相反，因此没有任何模型可被视为保守选择；而在部署代理自身的规则集上，它们共同出错，过度声称固定检查足以胜任，这正是永远不会被升级的方向。我们提出CoVer（corroborate-then-verify），将一致性视为提名，仅当为该谓词合成的检查经干预后仍能通过——读取代理无法写入的字段并经确定性重述仍成立——才允许进入。该门限拒绝了大多数协查误认的内容，覆盖范围损失我们如实报告而非调优。显然的替代方案——与参考裁判达成一致——并不能证明任何东西：其准确率在校准区间内从30%升至77%，而真正可判定部分却无变化，因为从受指控群体中选出的裁判会认可其共享盲点。自决性不是可以从模型中激发的能力，而是验证器必须构建的边界。

summary: Agents are entering finance, healthcare and law, sectors where a violation leaves no lexical signature and carries real penalties. Whether an omission is material, or a disclosure sufficient, depends on what the response left out. Probing such an obligation means finding responses one minimal edit from flipping compliance, and every probe costs a generation and two adjudications, so the binding constraint on regulatory red-teaming is sample efficiency, not volume. We introduce Penumbra, an adversarial search that walks from a verified anchor under an expanding edit budget until a two-evaluator committee changes its verdict, and emits the two adjacent responses that straddle the change. Allocation is adaptive, and the objective is coverage of the defeat surface: distinct (obligation x defeat mode) cells resolved per candidate. At matched budget, adaptive allocation reaches uniform allocation's full-budget coverage on 59% of the candidates; at equal records it covers 1.43x the defeat modes of naive enumeration, and the gain is confined to the axis it targets. On 60 screened obligations of a financial advisory constitution, Penumbra returns 144 pairs, each a compliant and a violating response that the committee places on opposite sides of the boundary, differing by a handful of words where a model asked for both directly produces texts sharing almost nothing. A second constitution, for clinical triage, reproduces this on 18 obligations: 49 pairs at the same tightness, with the same modes hardest. Pairs like these show where an obligation's own terms stop deciding, which is what an agent deployed under it must be tested against, and the search finds them at a cost that scales with the boundary, not the text.
title: Penumbra: Sample-Efficient Adversarial Search for Regulatory Obligations
comment: Accepted at the Workshop on Self-Evolving Diversity-Driven Search for Robust AI Systems (EvoRobust) at NeurIPS 2026. Workshop papers are non-archival. 12 pages (4 content pages plus references and appendices)
title_translated: Penumbra：面向监管义务的样本高效对抗搜索
summary_translated: 智能体正进入金融、医疗和法律领域，这些领域中的违规行为没有明显的词汇痕迹，且会带来实际处罚。一个遗漏是否重要，或披露是否充分，取决于响应中缺失的内容。探测此类义务意味着找到仅需一次微小修改即可改变合规状态的响应，而每次探测都需要一次生成和两次裁定，因此监管红队测试的关键约束是样本效率，而非数据量。我们提出Penumbra，一种对抗性搜索方法，从一个经验证的锚点出发，在不断扩大的编辑预算下进行搜索，直到由两名评估者组成的委员会改变其裁决，并输出两个相邻的响应，它们恰好跨越了裁决边界。该方法采用自适应分配策略，目标是覆盖失败表面：每种候选方案所解决的（义务 × 失败模式）组合数量。在相同预算下，自适应分配在59%的候选方案上达到了均匀分配在全预算下的覆盖率；在相同记录数下，其覆盖的失败模式是朴素枚举的1.43倍，且增益集中在目标轴上。在一份金融咨询宪章的60项筛选义务中，Penumbra返回了144对响应，每对包含一个合规与一个违规响应，委员会将它们置于边界的两侧，二者仅相差寥寥数词，而当模型直接生成时却产生几乎毫无关联的文本。另一份临床分诊宪章也在此类义务上复现了这一结果：18项义务，49对响应，具有相同的紧密度和最难的失败模式。这类成对响应揭示了义务自身条款不再起决定作用的位置，这正是部署于该义务下的智能体必须被测试的边界，而该搜索以与边界复杂度成比例的成本完成，而非与文本长度成比例。

summary: Self-supervised learning (SSL) is standard for speech representation learning, but mainstream models are designed around single-speaker audio, limiting their usefulness in multi-speakers scenarios. We present SepRQ, an open-source SSL framework that replaces masked prediction with a pseudo-source-separation objective over frozen random-projection codebooks. By adopting a novel mask-free, multiresolution approach, SepRQ achieves state-of-the-art performance in Speaker Diarization and Speech Separation on the SUPERB benchmark, surpassing WavLM and other cocktail-party derived SSLs at both Base and Large scales, while requiring only 85.68M inference parameters. SepRQ also demonstrates strong performance across target-speaker tasks requiring enrollment (such as Target-Speaker Automatic Speech Recognition), and on the challenging multi-domain DIHARD 3 diarization dataset. Notably, we report strong separation capabilities on three-speaker mixtures (WSJ0-3Mix), where current SSL literature struggles. While cocktail-party SSLs remain scarce and closed-source, limited to C-HuBERT and the enrollment-based SA-WavLM, we open-source SepRQ to the community.
title: SepRQ : Self-Supervised Speech Mixture Representation Learning via Mask-Free, Multi-Scale Source Separation
title_translated: SepRQ：通过无掩码、多尺度源分离实现自监督语音混合表示学习
summary_translated: 自监督学习（SSL）已成为语音表示学习的标准方法，但主流模型基于单说话人音频设计，限制了其在多说话人场景中的应用。我们提出SepRQ，一个开源的SSL框架，用冻结的随机投影代码本上的伪源分离目标替代掩码预测。通过采用新颖的无掩码、多分辨率方法，SepRQ在SUPERB基准测试中实现了语音辨识和语音分离的最先进性能，超越了WavLM及其他基于鸡尾酒派对场景的SSL模型，在Base和Large两种规模下均表现优异，且推理参数仅需8568万。SepRQ在需要注册的目标说话人任务（如目标说话人自动语音识别）以及具有挑战性的多领域DIHARD 3辨识数据集上也表现出色。值得注意的是，我们在三说话人混合语音（WSJ0-3Mix）上报告了强大的分离能力，而当前SSL文献在此类场景中仍面临困难。尽管目前基于鸡尾酒派对的SSL模型稀缺且闭源，仅限于C-HuBERT和基于注册的SA-WavLM，我们仍开源SepRQ以供社区使用。

summary: Multi-agent debate can improve reasoning, yet often fails to beat simple majority voting. We argue that successful debate requires two distinct mechanisms: proposal supply must surface a correct answer, and readout must identify that answer when voting misses it. We formalize the first requirement through recoverable headroom, which measures cases where a correct proposal is available but the majority answer is wrong. For the second, we develop Latent Verification Debate (LVD), an accounting model in which candidate proposals receive answer-specific verification evidence before final generation. Controlled fixed-proposal interventions estimate this latent effect in equivalent peer-support units and show that correct evidence changes answer probabilities and generated decisions while proposal supply remains fixed. To improve proposal supply, we construct societies from neural-thicket agents using labeled and label-free coverage objectives. Across two backbones and matched-budget reasoning benchmarks, coverage-selected societies increase complementary proposal supply and improve aggregate accuracy in repeated stochastic evaluations. Round-level controls further show that interaction provides gains beyond applying the same finalizer directly to the initial proposals. These results identify proposal coverage and truth-sensitive evidence use as complementary conditions for debate to outperform voting. Code is available at https://github.com/Wang-ML-Lab/when-debate-helps.
title: When Debate Helps: Proposal Supply and Verification-Aware Readout in Multi-Agent Reasoning
title_translated: 辩论为何有效：多智能体推理中的提案供给与验证感知读出
summary_translated: 多智能体辩论可以提升推理能力，但常常无法超越简单的多数投票。我们认为成功的辩论需要两个不同机制：提案供给必须能引出正确答案，而读出机制必须在投票失误时识别出正确答案。我们通过可恢复余量（recoverable headroom）形式化第一个要求，该指标衡量存在正确提案但多数答案错误的情况。针对第二个要求，我们提出了隐式验证辩论（LVD），一种会计模型，其中候选提案在最终生成前获得特定答案的验证证据。通过控制固定提案的干预实验，我们估计了这种潜在效应在等效同行支持单元中的表现，结果显示正确证据会改变答案概率和生成决策，而提案供给保持不变。为改善提案供给，我们构建了由神经丛林智能体组成的社会，采用带标签和无标签的覆盖目标。在两种骨干网络和匹配预算的推理基准测试中，覆盖选择的社会提升了互补提案供给，并在重复随机评估中提高了整体准确率。回合级控制实验进一步表明，交互带来的收益超出了直接对初始提案应用相同终结器的效果。这些结果表明，提案覆盖和对真理敏感的证据使用是辩论优于投票的互补条件。代码可在 https://github.com/Wang-ML-Lab/when-debate-helps 获取。

summary: Is agentic memory robust against stealthy steganographic attacks? We carry out a large-scale red-teaming exercise to test whether agents can encode attacker-controlled strings in one session and recover them in another without triggering safety oversight. Following SHADE-Arena-style tasks, we embed malicious side tasks to encode secret strings using steganography within otherwise benign tasks and evaluate them using independent task-completion and safety oversight. We test 14,000 attack trials spanning 91 model-attack configurations, 13 models, and 7 steganographic schemes: Acrostic, Mesostic, Telestich, Word-choice, Capitalization, Position-based, and Homoglyph. 41.2% of trials successfully encode the target payload in the generated response, while 29.8% survive the memory-write step with the encoding intact. Overall, 25.4% of trials yield a recoverable payload at retrieval, and 20.1% achieve exact-match recovery, including synthetic API keys and cryptographic material never exposed to the receiver. Among the exact-match transmissions, 71.4% also pass primary task-completion scoring and are independently judged safe by the oversight model, corresponding to 14.4% of all trials in which a successful covert transmission would appear to be an ordinary, benign interaction under task-level evaluation. Our results demonstrate that agentic memory can function as a persistent cross-session covert channel. The results further show that the principal bottleneck occurs at memory persistence rather than retrieval: once a steganographic payload survives the memory-write stage, a substantial fraction remains recoverable. We therefore argue that memory integrity, information-flow control, and covert-channel detection should be explicit security requirements for agentic systems.
title: StegoMemory: Agentic Memory Acts as Covert Steganographic Channel
title_translated: StegoMemory：智能体记忆作为隐蔽的隐写信道
summary_translated: 智能体记忆能否抵御隐蔽的隐写攻击？我们开展大规模红队测试，检验智能体是否能在一次会话中编码攻击者控制的字符串，并在另一次会话中恢复，而不触发安全监控。遵循SHADE-Arena风格的任务，我们在看似无害的任务中嵌入恶意子任务，利用隐写术编码秘密字符串，并通过独立的任务完成度和安全监控评估其效果。我们测试了涵盖91种模型-攻击配置、13种模型和7种隐写方案（首字母、中段、末字母、选词、大小写、位置、同形异义）的14,000次攻击试验。41.2%的试验成功在生成响应中编码目标载荷，其中29.8%在内存写入步骤后仍保持编码完整。总体而言，25.4%的试验在检索时可恢复载荷，20.1%实现精确匹配恢复，包括从未向接收方暴露的合成API密钥和加密材料。在精确匹配传输中，71.4%也通过了主任务完成评分，并被监督模型独立判定为安全，对应所有试验中14.4%的成功隐蔽传输看似是普通良性交互。结果表明，智能体记忆可作为持久的跨会话隐蔽信道。此外，主要瓶颈出现在记忆持久性而非检索：一旦隐写载荷通过内存写入阶段，仍有相当比例可被恢复。因此我们主张，记忆完整性、信息流控制和隐蔽信道检测应成为智能体系统明确的安全要求。

summary: Multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) achieve strong modality understanding by pairing a large language model (LLM) with an encoder for a target modality such as vision, video, or audio. However, improving an MLLM's capability for a given modality typically requires additional training on large modality-specific datasets, incurring substantial data collection and compute costs. Model merging offers an alternative, but it is often infeasible for data-scarce, large per-sample size, or domain-specific modalities (\textit{e.g.}, audio and video), where same-modality model variants are rarely available. In this work, we characterize an intriguing asymmetric phenomenon: merging a well-aligned, data-rich source-modality MLLM into a data-scarce target-modality MLLM substantially improves the target on its own benchmarks. Our theoretical and empirical analyses show that this gain stems from enhanced alignment between modality-specific and textual tokens, induced by the stronger donor modality. Specifically, we derive a mutual-information lower bound that is monotonic in alignment-related quantities and strongly correlated with downstream MLLM performance. Building on this principle, we propose Directional Cross-modal Alignment Transfer (DCAT), a novel framework that transfers textual alignment from a strong, well-aligned source (donor) modality to a weak target (recipient) modality, boosting target-modality performance without further fine-tuning. We further show that the alignment-enhancing objective admits a closed-form weight-space solution computed from only a small calibration set. DCAT outperforms existing model-merging methods, offering an efficient path toward cross-modal alignment transfer. Project page with code is available at \url{https://seohoiki3215.github.io/DCAT_project_page}
title: Strong Helps Weak: Directional Cross-Modal Alignment Transfer in Multi-modal LLMs
title_translated: 强助弱：多模态大语言模型中的定向跨模态对齐迁移
summary_translated: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）通过将大型语言模型（LLM）与目标模态（如视觉、视频或音频）的编码器结合，实现强大的模态理解能力。然而，提升MLLM在某一模态上的能力通常需要在大规模模态特定数据集上进行额外训练，带来高昂的数据收集和计算成本。模型融合提供了一种替代方案，但对于数据稀缺、单样本尺寸大或领域特定的模态（如音频和视频），往往不可行，因为同模态模型变体很少出现。本文揭示了一种引人注目的非对称现象：将一个对齐良好、数据丰富的源模态MLLM合并到数据稀缺的目标模态MLLM中，能显著提升目标模态在其自身基准上的表现。我们的理论与实证分析表明，这种提升源于更强的捐赠模态诱导的模态特定令牌与文本令牌之间的对齐增强。具体而言，我们推导出一个互信息下界，其单调依赖于对齐相关量，并与下游MLLM性能高度相关。基于此原理，我们提出定向跨模态对齐迁移（DCAT）框架，将强而对齐的源模态（捐赠者）的文本对齐特性转移到弱目标模态（接收者），从而在无需进一步微调的情况下提升目标模态性能。我们还证明，该对齐增强目标可由一个小校准集计算出闭式权重空间解。DCAT优于现有模型融合方法，为跨模态对齐迁移提供了高效路径。项目页面及代码见 	exttt{https://seohoiki3215.github.io/DCAT_project_page}。

summary: Purpose: To develop and evaluate an open-weight large language model (LLM) pipeline that converts an entire archive of free-text radiology reports into structured reports without human oversight. Materials and Methods: In this retrospective study, a pipeline with 150 hierarchically organized templates was developed at one center and tested at a second center on reports from 2010 to 2025. The open-weight model gpt-oss-120B selects the template in three constrained-decoding steps and fills it on one local graphics processing unit. Template selection was scored against expert labels on 914 randomly sampled reports of five modalities, structuring quality on 920 radiography and CT reports corrected field by field by five residents. The pipeline then processed the complete archive of the second center. Proportions are reported with Wilson 95% confidence intervals (CIs). Results: An optimal template set was selected for 74.4% of reports (680 of 914; 95% CI: 71.5%, 77.1%) and an appropriate set for 82.3% (752 of 914; 95% CI: 79.7%, 84.6%), 87.7% for single-region and 54.1% for multi-region reports. Macro semantic textual similarity between output and corrected reference was 0.95 for radiography and 0.97 for CT, residents left 88.7% of 24,638 fields unchanged, and unsupported content was flagged in 1.0% and 1.5% of reports. Of 2,186,982 archive reports, 96.5% received structured output, 2,401,544 structured reports, at 1,258 reports per hour on one graphics processing unit. Conclusion: An open-weight LLM pipeline structured a complete multimodality report archive without human oversight with high content fidelity. Multi-region reports remained the main source of template errors.
title: Autonomous Structuring of Radiology Reports Across Modalities at Archive Scale Using an Open-Weight Large Language Model
title_translated: 基于开源大语言模型在归档规模下跨模态自主结构化放射科报告
summary_translated: 目的：开发并评估一个开源大语言模型（LLM）流程，无需人工干预即可将整个自由文本放射科报告档案转换为结构化报告。方法：在这项回顾性研究中，一个包含150个分层组织模板的流程在一个中心开发，并在第二个中心对2010年至2025年的报告进行了测试。使用开源模型gpt-oss-120B在一台本地图形处理器上通过三个受限解码步骤选择模板并填充内容。模板选择在5种模态的914份随机抽样报告上与专家标签进行评分，结构质量则由五名住院医师逐字段修正的920份X光和CT报告评估。随后，该流程处理了第二个中心的完整档案。比例以Wilson 95%置信区间（CIs）报告。结果：74.4%的报告（680/914；95% CI: 71.5%, 77.1%）选择了最优模板集，82.3%（752/914；95% CI: 79.7%, 84.6%）选择了合适模板集，单区域报告为87.7%，多区域报告为54.1%。输出与修正参考之间的宏观语义文本相似度在X光为0.95，CT为0.97；住院医师保留了24,638个字段中的88.7%不变，未支持内容在1.0%和1.5%的报告中被标记。在2,186,982份档案报告中，96.5%获得了结构化输出，共生成2,401,544份结构化报告，每小时处理1,258份报告。结论：一个开源LLM流程在无须人工干预的情况下，以高内容保真度结构化了完整的多模态报告档案。多区域报告仍是模板错误的主要来源。

summary: LLM-agent security has produced a dense landscape of defenses - prompt hardening, content filters, permission gates, sandboxes - yet no framework tells a deployer what a defense actually guarantees, or where that guarantee comes from. We apply Verification Autonomy Levels (VAL) - L0: LLM self-declaration; L1: deterministic rules; L2: objective ground truth; L3/L4: decidable completeness; L5: impossible - to 22 agent-security defenses; the taxonomy is falsifiable (10/10 prediction hits on frozen cards, flagged). We run the first controlled deployment-value comparison: at equal budget, a VAL-guided stack (confirmation gate + schema sandbox) versus a mainstream intuition stack (prompt hardening + keyword filter), 50 scenarios, 12 attack variants, adaptive/white-box/PAIR escalation (~7,000 testbed calls; ~10,000 harness calls on AgentDojo/JADE). The VAL stack holds 0.000 attack success at 1.000 benign success (0.5% ASR at 79.7% utility on AgentDojo banking vs 4.3% undefended); the intuition stack reaches 0.000 ASR but kills all benign actions - security by model-behavior luck, not structure. Across testbeds of rising attack-surface hardness the intuition stack's zero drifts (0->1.9%->6.2%, n=16 on JADE) while the VAL stack's holds within its ODD (0->0->0), its only breach a disclosed out-of-ODD password gap (0.5%). The same zero, two different guarantees: zero is an outcome, not a guarantee.
title: The Same Zero: Why Identical ASR Can Imply Different Guarantees in LLM-Agent Security
comment: v1: applies Verification Autonomy Levels (VAL) to 22 agent-security defenses; first controlled deployment-value comparison (VAL-guided vs intuition stack) across three testbeds; ~17k LLM calls; an honest out-of-ODD boundary is reported. Writing was assisted by an AI language model; all experiments and research decisions are the author's own
title_translated: 相同的零：为何相同的ASR可能暗示LLM智能体安全中不同的保障
summary_translated: LLM智能体安全领域已产生密集的防御体系——提示加固、内容过滤、权限门禁、沙箱等，但尚无框架能告知部署者某防御实际提供了何种保障，或其保障来源。我们应用验证自主性等级（VAL）——L0：LLM自我声明；L1：确定性规则；L2：客观真实；L3/L4：可判定完备性；L5：不可能——对22种智能体安全防御进行分析；该分类法具有可证伪性（10/10预测命中冻结卡，已标记）。我们首次开展受控部署价值比较：在相同预算下，VAL指导堆栈（确认门禁+模式沙箱）与主流直觉堆栈（提示加固+关键词过滤），共50个场景，12种攻击变体，自适应/白盒/PAIR升级（约7,000次测试床调用；AgentDojo/JADE平台约10,000次引导调用）。VAL堆栈实现0.000攻击成功率且良性成功率为1.000（AgentDojo银行场景中ASR为0.5%，效用达79.7%；未防护时为4.3%）；而直觉堆栈虽达到0.000 ASR，却导致所有良性行为失效——这是依赖模型行为运气的安全，而非结构性保障。在攻击面难度递增的测试平台上，直觉堆栈的零值漂移（0→1.9%→6.2%，JADE平台n=16），而VAL堆栈始终维持在其操作定义域（ODD）内（0→0→0），唯一突破是披露的ODD外密码漏洞（0.5%）。相同的零，两种不同保障：零是结果，而非保障。

summary: Radiology report generation (RRG) aims to convert medical images into diagnostic texts to assist in clinical decision-making and alleviate the workload of physicians. Although existing methods have made extensive progress in cross-modal interaction and the incorporation of external priors, the distribution shift of underlying representations and the undifferentiated rigid coupling of heterogeneous information cause weak visual abnormality cues to be easily diluted by massive text priors and generation inertia during decoding. To overcome this bottleneck, inspired by cognitive science, we propose a novel two-stage Homogeneous Semantic Alignment and Hierarchical Expert Routing (HSA-HER) framework. First, the model introduces an explicit homogeneous distribution constraint in the underlying latent space to effectively eliminate the cross-modal distribution shift between visual and textual features, thereby extracting purified visual features as semantic anchors that accurately align with diseases. Second, for heterogeneous clinical evidence composed of visual features, local entities, and global retrievals, we design a hierarchical expert routing mechanism guided by these disease semantic anchors. This mechanism abandons the undifferentiated rigid coupling paradigm. Specifically, it dynamically activates expert networks to perform targeted mining and semantic reconstruction on multi-source evidence, and adaptively allocates fusion weights. Extensive experiments on three mainstream benchmark datasets demonstrate that HSA-HER achieves state-of-the-art performance, accurately depicting complex imaging details and key diagnostic information.
title: Homogeneous Semantic Alignment and Hierarchical Expert Routing for Radiology Report Generation
title_translated: 同质语义对齐与分层专家路由用于放射科报告生成
summary_translated: 放射科报告生成（RRG）旨在将医学图像转化为诊断文本，以辅助临床决策并减轻医生工作负担。尽管现有方法在跨模态交互和引入外部先验方面取得显著进展，但底层表示的分布偏移以及异构信息的僵硬耦合，导致微弱的视觉异常线索容易被大量文本先验和解码过程中的生成惯性所稀释。为克服这一瓶颈，受认知科学启发，我们提出一种新型两阶段同质语义对齐与分层专家路由（HSA-HER）框架。首先，模型在底层潜在空间引入显式的同质分布约束，有效消除视觉与文本特征间的跨模态分布偏移，从而提取出纯净的视觉特征作为准确对齐疾病的语义锚点。其次，针对由视觉特征、局部实体和全局检索构成的异构临床证据，我们设计了一种由疾病语义锚点引导的分层专家路由机制。该机制摒弃了无差别的刚性耦合范式，具体而言，动态激活专家网络对多源证据进行针对性挖掘与语义重构，并自适应分配融合权重。在三个主流基准数据集上的大量实验表明，HSA-HER达到领先性能，能够准确描绘复杂的影像细节和关键诊断信息。

summary: Artificial intelligence enables computational agents to represent political preferences and take part in collective decision-making. In this thesis, I investigate the opportunities and challenges of digital twins (DTs) based on Large Language Models (LLMs) as intermediaries in augmented democracy, focusing on individual preference representation, collective representation of political organizations, and the vulnerability of those representations to attackers. First, using data from an online experiment in Brazil, I examine whether personalized DTs can predict citizens' preferences for unseen policy proposals. Second, I extend the DT framework from individuals to political organizations. Using Swiss parliamentary data, I build topic-specific knowledge graphs from lawmakers' legislative records and connect them to LLM-based lawmaker agents, which are organized into party-level DTs representing collective positions. Agentic deliberation among these agents tests whether aggregated party representations capture a broader range of intra-party perspectives than official party communications. Finally, I study the vulnerability and robustness of LLM-mediated deliberation against prompt-injection attacks that amplify viewpoints, suppress opinions, or redirect consensus. Using data from a 2023 deliberative experiment in the United Kingdom, I analyze how attack effectiveness varies with the distribution of opinions and rhetorical strategies, and evaluate a pipeline combining injection detection, structured opinion representations, and reinforcement learning to improve resistance. These findings characterize the opportunities and challenges of LLM-based digital twins in augmented democracy, stressing accurate preference representation, faithful aggregation, and robustness to strategic interaction.
title: Large Language Models and Augmented Democracy
